items.title: Marketing Data Scientist
items.summary: Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide! Why this role matters: We are looking for a Data Scientist to own our demand and revenue intelligence capabilities. You will sit at the intersection of marketing strategy and commercial outcomes, building the predictive models and analytical frameworks that tell us where growth is…
items.description: Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide! Why this role matters: We are looking for a Data Scientist to own our demand and revenue intelligence capabilities. You will sit at the intersection of marketing strategy and commercial outcomes, building the predictive models and analytical frameworks that tell us where growth is coming from before it arrives. Your work will directly shape how we reach the right audiences, invest in the right channels, and accelerate pipeline - turning marketing activity into a measurable, forward-looking revenue engine. Your key responsibilities: Analyze and model the relationship between marketing investment, channel performance, and revenue outcomes, connecting spend to growth Design and maintain reporting views and self-serve analytics assets for internal stakeholders and marketing partners; making model outputs and performance data accessible, consistent, and actionable across teams Identify high-value market segments and audiences through data modeling to inform how and where we compete Develop personalization models and frameworks that enable tailored customer experiences across channels, from dynamic content and offers to next-best-action recommendations Collaborate with Marketing and Sales teams to define forecasting methodologies and embed models into operational workflows Translate complex model outputs into clear, actionable narratives that drive strategic decisions at the executive level Contribute to the development of AI-ready data structures in Snowflake, including clean feature tables, scoring outputs, and audience segments that serve as reliable inputs for marketing automation and AI-driven decisioning What you'll bring: Strong understanding of the full B2B revenue funnel - from awareness and demand generation through pipeline to closed revenue - and how data flows across it Strong business acumen with the ability to connect predictive model outputs to strategic marketing and revenue decisions The ability to influence RevOps, Sales, and Marketing stakeholders through data-led storytelling A rigorous yet pragmatic approach to forecasting - knowing when to build a sophisticated model and when a well-structured regression is enough A proven self-starter comfortable operating in fast-moving, commercially-driven environments A working fluency with AI tools and LLM-based workflows — able to leverage AI to accelerate analysis, prototype models, and operate effectively in an AI-first data environment Required: 8 years of experience in Data Science, Revenue Analytics, or a related field Salesforce data experience: proven hands-on experience with Salesforce data across the full object model (Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Opportunities, Campaigns), and a deep understanding of how marketing and sales data interconnects within Salesforce Snowflake data warehouse experience: demonstrated experience querying, modeling, and working with data in Snowflake, including SQL-based data modeling and working with structured analytical data sets Experience modeling pipeline generation, conversion rates, and revenue velocity across the full funnel Tools & Technologies: Salesforce - full object model (Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Opportunities, Campaigns), SOQL, Salesforce administration, Salesforce Einstein Analytics / Tableau CRM Python - scikit-learn, statsmodels, Prophet, pandas, NumPy for forecasting and modeling SQL - advanced querying across CRM and marketing data sources Data Visualization - Tableau, Power BI, Salesforce-native dashboarding Marketing Automation Platforms - Marketo, HubSpot, or Pardot (data structure familiarity) Cloud Data Platforms - Snowflake, AWS, GCP, or Azure for data extraction and model deployment Version Control - Git/GitHub or GitLab Spreadsheet & Presentation Tools - Excel, Google Sheets for stakeholder-facing outputs What we consider a plus: Experience with customer lifetime value (LTV) modeling and churn prediction Familiarity with marketing automation platforms and how they feed into Salesforce (e.g., Marketo, HubSpot) Experience with lead-to-revenue funnel analytics in a B2B SaaS environment Working knowledge of digital marketing platforms and their underlying data structures Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, or Computer Science #LI-JS3 Disclaimer: The posted range represents the good faith salary for this role at the time of posting. Final compensation is determined by factors including (but not limited to) geographic location, relevant experience, specific skill sets, and internal equity. There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you. To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice . Who we are: Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today. Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

items.summary: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. We’re looking for a curious, driven professional to join our Revenue Analytics team. This builds and owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations,…
items.description: At Affirm , we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. We’re looking for a curious, driven professional to join our Revenue Analytics team. This builds and owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that power Affirm’s Revenue organization. As a Senior Analyst, Revenue Analytics, you’ll build scalable data products that power day-to-day decision-making - owning end-to-end work across data modeling, metric definitions, dashboards, automation, and enablement. You’ll also help strengthen our semantic layer and data governance, laying the foundation for reliable AI. The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well-tested data infrastructure. What you'll do Develop dbt data models, dashboards, metrics, and automation processes for the revenue field team and revenue analysts Build and maintain critical reporting data models that power external merchant reporting Build the semantic, metadata, and context layers that allow AI systems to accurately understand Revenue data, metrics, and business definitions Partner with Business Systems, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable, well-tested data products Contribute to the team’s best practices in version control, code review, documentation, and release hygiene (GitHub-based workflows) Develop processes, governance, and foundations to scale the impact of analytics within Revenue. What we look for 3+ years of work experience in an analytics engineering or business intelligence role Strong working knowledge of SQL, dbt, Python, data modeling, and data visualization Hands-on experience with BI tools (Sigma/Looker/Tableau), Databricks, and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake) Understanding of the data foundations required for reliable AI, including semantic layers, metadata, evals, metric definitions, documentation, and data quality Demonstrated experience integrating AI tools into day-to-day analytics engineering workflows to improve development speed, quality, and scalability Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial areas of the business Ability to identify user needs and translate them into robust, scalable data products Ability to start with an ambiguous problem, deconstruct it into tangible steps, and work toward an impactful solution Ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Total rewards We believe the people building honest financial products at Affirm should share in its success. That's why our total rewards are designed to support your health, growth, financial well-being, and future. In service of our mission, we reward employees through a combination of base pay, equity (from parent company), and comprehensive benefits. Base Pay Grade - K 226 000 zł - 346 000 zł Base pay ranges and placement within those ranges are determined based on several factors, including role, experience, and job-related skills. In addition to base pay, all employees in this role are eligible to receive equity from the parent company each year. This means as Affirm’s parent company grows, employees have the opportunity to share in that growth financially. Equity Grade - 2 (awarded in US Dollars) Affirm Holdings, Inc. Equity Grade example Equity grade: 2 New hire equity: $16,000-$24,000 Annual Refresh: $5,000 Reward equity: $0-$75,000 Affirm also provides flexible spending wallets to all employees for technology and wellbeing related needs, which are reimbursable up to 1390 zł per month. In addition to your compensation, our comprehensive benefits are designed to support you and the people who matter most. Benefits include: Competitive paid time off, paid public holidays, and additional paid Away Days to rest and recharge. Comprehensive private healthcare through Lux Med's Platinum package. A MultiSport card to support your health and well-being. Learning and development programs to help you grow professionally. Family healthcare support through Maven and parental leave support through Parentaly. Mental well-being support through Lyra, including up to 12 confidential counseling or coaching sessions each year for you and your household members. Financial well-being support through Northstar, with unlimited access to Certified Financial Advisors and planning tools at no cost to you. Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection and inclusion. Eligibility for creative tax benefits, subject to applicable law, role, and company policy. Location - Remote Poland The majority of our roles can be located anywhere in Poland. **This job description is not a contractual document, and is not intended to have binding force.** #LI-Remote Remote-first with flexibility built in Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience. Benefits designed for you Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to. Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount. We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

items.title: Revenue Operations Analyst (CX)
items.summary: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.…
items.description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role We're looking for a GTM Operations Analyst to join our CX Operations team at Pleo. In this role, you'll drive operational excellence across customer experience, retention, and lifecycle workflows, manage CRM systems and data integrity, build reporting dashboards, and translate operational data into actionable insights for proactive retention strategies. If you're excited about building scalable customer-facing processes and are passionate about customer experience and SaaS operations, then this is the opportunity for you! Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our GTM Operations Manager and work closely with teams in Customer success & Sales teams. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to operational health and data integrity. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across GTM to ensure success. What you’ll be doing As a GTM Operations Analyst, you will: Operational Reporting & Dashboards – Design, build, and maintain comprehensive operational dashboards in Looker, Vitally, or Power BI to track customer health, onboarding progression, risk signals, and lifecycle renewals. CRM Administration & Data Management – Manage HubSpot or Salesforce systems including field configuration, custom objects, data mapping, and user access management. Churn & Risk Analytics – Analyze customer usage patterns and behavioral indicators to identify at-risk accounts early and support proactive retention interventions. Process Optimization – Map and evaluate post-sales and CX workflows to identify bottlenecks and implement improvements across CX platforms. Stakeholder Collaboration & System Hygiene – Partner directly with CX leadership, Sales Operations, and GTM teams while conducting regular platform audits and workflow automations. You can expect to work with the following tech stack: HubSpot, Vitally, Salesforce, Freshworks, Looker, Power BI, and SQL/Python tools. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: 3+ years as a CX Operations Analyst, Operations Specialist, Business Analyst, or similar role in B2B SaaS. Hands-on experience administering CRM platforms (HubSpot or Salesforce) and Customer Success tools (Vitally, Gainsight). Proficiency in building and maintaining business intelligence dashboards in BI tools (Looker, Power BI, Tableau). Strong analytical skills, execution focus, and communication skills to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Nice-to-have: Proficiency with SQL or Python, workflow automation tools (Zapier/Make), and background in data governance. A strong background in customer success, sales operations, or customer analytics. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You're comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy building structure and process where none exists yet, rather than waiting for a fully defined playbook. You're happy fielding ad-hoc requests and shifting priorities without losing momentum, and you don't need every task pre-defined to get moving. You get energized by digging into messy, complex problems and finding the root cause rather than settling for a quick patch. You're flexible and adaptable, comfortable working across multiple systems, stakeholders, and shifting priorities at the same time. You're naturally curious about data and genuinely enjoy translating numbers into a clear story that drives a business decision — a core trait of strong CX/Sales Ops talent. This role is not a good fit for you if: You need clearly defined, rigid action items and step-by-step direction to feel comfortable, rather than figuring out the approach as you go. You prefer priorities to stay fixed and find frequent context-switching between projects and stakeholders draining rather than energizing. You'd rather go deep on a single system or process than work across multiple CRM and CX platforms and stakeholder groups at once. You need a fully built-out process before you can start executing, rather than building the process as part of the work. How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll: Lead reporting/dashboards to drive impact in Revops. Collaborate with the CX team to improve processes or systems. Grow your skills in Revops, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale. We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in Revops function. Show me the benefits Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. Hiring Manager Interview - 45 mins - To understand your experience, skillset, team fit and general alignment for the role. Pleo Challenge - 60 mins - An opportunity to showcase your knowledge and skillset, this will be with 2-3 leaders across the business. Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! When reviewing applications for the CX Operations Analyst role, here is what we really care about: We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background. Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

items.summary: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance…
items.description: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means. About Binance Accelerator Program Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE . Who may apply Current university students and recent graduates. *Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws We are looking for a motivated Product Data Analyst Intern to join our Product DA team. You will work alongside senior analysts on real product analytics projects — including conversion funnel analysis, A/B experiment evaluation, and dashboard building. This is a hands-on role where you'll gain exposure to product strategy, experiment-driven decision making, and large-scale data infrastructure. Responsibilities: Assist in building and analyzing user conversion funnels, identifying drop-off points and improvement opportunities Support A/B experiment evaluation: pull experiment data, validate cohort allocation (sanity checks), calculate uplift metrics, and summarize results Build and maintain dashboards for key product metrics (CTR, conversion rate, UV/PV) Respond to product team ad-hoc data requests — user segmentation, feature adoption tracking, campaign performance analysis Write and maintain SQL queries for scheduled data pipelines; assist in data quality monitoring Translate data findings into clear summaries and visualizations for product teams Requirements: Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's/Master's degree in a quantitative discipline (Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science, or related field) Internship experience in product analytics or related data analysis roles preferred A natural curiosity to identify, investigate and explain trends and patterns in data Bilingual English/Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Understanding of A/B testing fundamentals (hypothesis testing, p-value, confidence intervals) Strong logical thinking, attention to detail, and ability to work independently Fast learner with curiosity about product strategy and user behavior Competency in one or more of the following: SQL (able to write complex queries with CTEs, window functions, subqueries) Programming (Python/R for data manipulation) A data visualization tool (e.g. DataWind, Tableau, PowerBI) Nice to Have Experience with event tracking / behavioral analytics (Sensors, Mixpanel, GA) Familiarity with Airflow or data scheduling tools Interest in crypto/fintech industry Prior experience with large-scale data (Hive/Spark environment) Compensation Additional Information Why Binance • Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem • Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure • Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning • Competitive salary and company benefits • Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team) Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success. By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice .

items.description: From Fivetran ’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. About the Role This is a unique role that sits at the intersection of economics, analytics, product, and strategy. You’ll combine rigorous quantitative analysis with customer research and commercial thinking to shape how Fivetran prices, packages, and monetizes its products. What You’ll Do Analyze product usage, deal, financial, and billing data to model pricing, packaging, and monetization scenarios. Design frameworks to assess willingness to pay, customer value, and price realization across customer segments and product lines. Conduct research on pricing strategies, packaging models, and monetization approaches across comparable and adjacent markets. Lead pricing and packaging strategy for new product launches, partnering with Product, GTM, and Finance to define commercial models Build value-based pricing and econometric models to quantify elasticity, customer ROI, and lifetime value. Design and execute pricing experiments Synthesize quantitative analysis, customer research, and competitive intelligence into executive recommendations that influence pricing strategy. Drive customer and prospect research to understand purchasing behavior, value perception, and pricing friction. Partner closely with Product, Analytics, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Legal to deliver end-to-end pricing initiatives. Define KPIs and dashboards that measure pricing performance and identify optimization opportunities. Continuously evolve our pricing and packaging strategy to improve ARR growth, customer adoption, and value realization. Skills We’re Looking For 5–8 years designing or operating SaaS or sophisticated B2C pricing models, preferably with usage‑based or behavioral pricing experience Deep quantitative chops—an advanced degree (PhD/MSc) in Economics, Statistics, Operations Research, Applied Math, or similar Fluency in SQL and Python for large‑scale data analysis; proficiency with BI tools such as Looker or Tableau; bonus for dbt Hands‑on experience with conjoint, MaxDiff, Gabor-Granger, or Van Westendorp surveys and causal experiment design Strong attention to detail and data analysis skills – including interpreting results and recommending actions Proven record of turning complex models and analyses into recommendations and shipping changes that moved ARR, gross margin, or NRR Collaborative mindset with Product, Analytics, Finance, Sales, and Legal; you can navigate from whiteboard to contract terms with ease Strong communication and presentation skills with ability to influence at the executive level #LI-DJ1 #LI-Remote The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role. Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, business need, market demands. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process. items.description: Tiger Analytics is an advanced analytics consulting firm. We are the trusted analytics partner for several Fortune 100 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our consultants bring deep expertise in Data Science, Data Analytics, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Machine Learning and AI. Our business value and leadership has been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner. Seeking a Power BI/BI Consultant to design and deliver scalable analytics solutions for global business teams, with a focus on commercial pharma (sales, field force, and HQ reporting). Candidates should have experience in Power BI development, PBI migrations, and leveraging tools like Alteryx for automated reporting. Responsibilities: Design and develop Power BI dashboards and reports for commercial pharma (sales, field force, HQ reporting) Translate business requirements into data models, data flows, and scalable BI solutions Lead/assist in Power BI migration initiatives and reporting automation (Alteryx or similar tools) Ensure data quality, validation, and governance across reporting layers Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders; manage Agile delivery and support enhancements, including chatbot/AI integrations Requirements 10-16 years of professional work experience in Commercial Pharma / Life Sciences analytics, insights, or consulting roles 5-7 years of experience in a BI Manager/Consultant or related role Strong stakeholder engagement across Commercial, Medical Affairs, and Market Access functions Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with analytic tools like R & Python & visualisation tools like Power BI Strong understanding of standard data sources—especially pharmacy, HUB, CRM, IQVIA, alignments, and related datasets—along with the nuances and quality controls required to ensure accuracy Experience with tools and concepts related to data and analytics, such as data modelling, dimensional modeling, ETL, reporting tools, data governance, data warehousing, structured and unstructured data Ability to engage with executive/VP-level stakeholders from client’s team to translate business problems to high level analytics solution approach Experience in managing large accounts and active involvement in account growth. P&L ownership in the past would be an added advantage Graduate in Business Analytics or MBA or equivalent work experience Benefits Significant career development opportunities exist as the company grows. The position offers a unique opportunity to be part of a small, fast-growing, challenging and entrepreneurial environment, with a high degree of individual responsibility. This role ensures accurate client-facing analytics, maintains analytical tools, and drives data-driven improvements across client and internal initiatives. Key responsibilities Collaborate with program management office to ensure the accurate and timely production of monthly, quarterly, and annual client reports. Complete complex ad-hoc reports to support client requests. Learn and apply effective use of Vendor Management Systems (VMS) such as Fieldglass, Beeline, VNDLY, and Coupa, including report preparation and data utilization. Analyze data from multiple sources to deliver meaningful insights, recommendations, and conclusions that drive client’s business decisions. Maintain and update team tools and documentation to ensure consistency and accuracy of information. Stay informed on industry trends and customer benchmarks to provide relevant analysis on a quarterly basis within assigned verticals. Design and enhance client-facing Power BI dashboards using API integrations to improve data visualization and accessibility. Manage and update client-facing Microsoft Power Pages to ensure current and accurate content. Design and implement automation for client production reports and related workflows to reduce manual effort. Create rate cards for new clients Run market rate analysis requests Skills required for the role Power BI expertise SQL and/or Python proficiency Data visualization capabilities Analytical and critical thinking Attention to detail and accuracy Advanced Excel skills Organizational and problem-solving skills Time management Data gathering from various sources Team collaboration Verbal, written, and presentation skills Educational Requirements Bachelor’s Degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics or Mathematics Experience Minimum of 3 years of experience in business intelligence, data analysis, or market research roles. Proven hands-on experience with Power BI and SQL for data visualization and querying. Familiarity with data warehouse technologies, data modeling concepts, and working with diverse data sources and APIs. Preferred - At least 2 years of experience working with relational and multidimensional database schemas, including writing complex queries. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Product Analyst
items.summary: StellarTech is a rapidly growing company at the forefront of innovation in the EdTech industry.
items.description: StellarTech is a rapidly growing company at the forefront of innovation in the EdTech industry. Our team is focused on building scalable products and sustainable business models that shape the future of education. We are looking for a Product Analyst to join our Platform Development Team. Working hand-in-hand with the Product Manager, you will build product analytics for our core platform from the ground up - and become the person who understands user behavior on the platform better than anyone else. What You'll Do: Build product analytics for the core platform together with the Product Manager: define key metrics, events, funnels, and approaches to evaluating user experience. Design and maintain the event tracking framework - ensuring data is complete, consistent, and trusted across product and technical teams. Identify insights across user journeys, segments, and platform usage scenarios - and automate their regular discovery. Create and evolve dashboards, alerts, and analytics infrastructure used by product and engineering teams for day-to-day decisions. Support product hypotheses with data: validate ideas, evaluate feature impact, and help prioritize the roadmap with evidence. Translate user behavior into clear, actionable recommendations and help teams across the company make data-driven decisions. We're Looking For: 6-8 years of experience as a Product Analyst / Data Analyst in a product IT company (B2C platforms, SaaS, or marketplaces are a plus). Strong SQL skills and confident work with large datasets. Hands-on experience with product analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4, or similar) and BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar). Solid understanding of product metrics: activation, retention, conversion, funnels, cohorts, and unit-level user behavior. Experience designing event taxonomies and setting up tracking from scratch or significantly evolving an existing setup. Experience with A/B testing and a working knowledge of statistics for experiment evaluation. Ability to turn ambiguous product questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations. Nice to Have: Python or R for analysis and automation of recurring insights. Experience working with platform/infrastructure products or technical stakeholders (engineers, architects). Experience building analytics processes in a team where analytics did not exist before. Strong communication skills: ability to articulate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proactive, problem-solving mindset - comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Why You'll Love Working With Us: Innovative Environment: We're all about trying new things and pushing the envelope in EdTech. We are global remote. Health: company-provided medical expense compensation. AI solutions: AI subscription and other tools. Balance: Flexible paid time off - 21 days of annual leave + 10 bank holidays. Collaborative Culture: Work alongside passionate professionals who are as driven as you are. --- Hiring Process: 1. Recruiter screen 2. Technical Interview 3. Hiring Manager Interview Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Payments Data Analyst
items.summary: Our team is developing a payment gateway for accepting funds from users on behalf of merchants, as well as sending funds from merchants to users.
items.description: Our team is developing a payment gateway for accepting funds from users on behalf of merchants, as well as sending funds from merchants to users. The system involves storing user payment data and is subject to PCI DSS compliance. It contains multiple integrations with payment systems, providers, and other gateways and processors, including 3DS.We're looking for a Payments Data Analyst to join our Product team and transform payment and product data into actionable insights that improve merchant success, platform performance, and business decisions. As a Payments Data Analyst, you will be a strategic partner to the Product, Merchant Solutions, Processor Integrations, and ML teams, helping drive data-informed decisions across our payment platform. You will analyze payment performance, identify trends and optimization opportunities, evaluate the impact of product initiatives, and provide recommendations that improve approval rates, payment efficiency, and merchant experience. Job Responsibilities: Monitor, analyze, and optimize payment performance across merchants, processors, payment methods, and markets. Analyze approval rates, decline patterns, payment routing performance, retry and cascading effectiveness, 3DS performance, and transaction success. Perform deep-dive analyses to identify trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities across processors, card schemes, BINs, countries, merchants, and payment methods. Measure the impact of new product features, processor integrations, routing changes, payment optimization initiatives, and A/B experiments. Build and maintain dashboards and reports that provide actionable insights for Product, Merchant Solutions, Executive, and other business teams. Define, monitor, and improve key product and payment KPIs. Investigate merchant and processor performance to identify root causes and recommend improvements. Collaborate with Product Managers to support product discovery, feature prioritization, and success measurement. Work closely with Solution Engineers, Integration Analysts, and the ML Specialist to improve payment performance and operational efficiency. Support continuous monitoring of payment performance by identifying anomalies, emerging trends, and opportunities for optimization. Present analytical findings and recommendations in a clear, business-oriented manner to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Requirements You’ll thrive here if you have 4+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst, Payments Analyst, or in a similar analytical role. Advanced SQL skills, including complex queries and window functions. Experience with BI tools such as Metabase, Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar. Experience with Python (Pandas, Jupyter Notebook) for data analysis. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Experience working with large datasets. Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations. Nice to Have Experience in FinTech, Payments, SaaS, or E-commerce. Understanding of payment processing, payment orchestration, or PSP integrations. Knowledge of payment routing, retries, cascading, and 3DS authentication. Familiarity with payment KPIs such as approval rate, conversion rate, authorization rate, and decline analysis. Understanding of fraud-related metrics, chargebacks, RDR, and risk signals. Experience working with product analytics, experimentation, and feature adoption metrics. Basic understanding of Machine Learning concepts. Conditions We know that great talent deserves great conditions, so here’s what you can expect when joining us: Full remote work. Competitive compensation with a service contract. Transparent performance reviews twice a year, with bonus opportunities and salary adjustments. An annual allowance that you can use for home office improvements, sports activities, equipment upgrades, and more—tailor it to what benefits you most. Investment in your development: paid language courses, access to various learning platforms, and a mindfulness benefit, including psychological support with 50% coverage. Career growth in a fast-scaling project with opportunities to influence technical decisions. A culture of recognition: our peer reward program celebrates contributions from across the team. This opportunity is also available for those who already live in Limassol, Cyprus. EU-based employment contract and a 3-year Cyprus work visa. Private medical insurance for you and your family, a corporate mobile plan (unlimited in Cyprus with roaming included), and interest-free support for car purchases. 50% coverage of school and kindergarten fees for your children. Fully covered sports benefits, and also access to in-house electric scooters and bike rentals. A fully equipped office in Limassol’s city center, with everything you need for deep work and collaboration. Free catering in the office and an in-house coffee bar with high-quality drinks and a health bar stocked with nutritious snacks. Benefits are provided in accordance with the company’s policies and eligibility criteria. Recruitment process HR interview (40 min); Technical interview (1 hour); Final interview (1 hour); Recommendations check; Job Offer. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
items.summary: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life.
items.description: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at . The Opportunity 🚀 Carrot is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our BI function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is an executional role providing essential analytics support across the company: you will gather requirements, field ad hoc and recurring data requests, and build the reporting dashboards that leaders across Carrot rely on to make decisions. You will work hands-on with modern data tooling, including SQL, dbt, and enterprise BI platforms, and partner with teams across the business to translate their questions into clear, trustworthy answers. The BI team is highly cross-functional and sits alongside Data Engineering, making this a strong opportunity to sharpen technical skills while building broad business context in a mission-driven environment. What You’ll Own 💼 In this role, you will: Design and build data models in SQL with a focus on correctness, clarity, and reusability Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track key business metrics and inform decision-making across the company Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer high-priority business questions from stakeholders across the organization Collaborate with teams across Carrot to understand their data domains, reporting needs, and success metrics Contribute to data quality, documentation, and self-service BI capabilities as the function scales What Success Looks Like 📈 In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Delivered accurate, well-documented dashboards and reports that stakeholders across the company trust and use regularly Fully ramped on Carrot's data stack and core data domains, independently owning recurring and ad hoc reporting requests Built strong working relationships with cross-functional partners and established yourself as a reliable analytics resource Improved turnaround and consistency of reporting by creating reusable data models and reducing manual work About You ✨ You likely have: A Bachelor's Degree Intermediate-to-advanced SQL experience: ability to write advanced queries using joins, common table expressions, and window/analytic functions Experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Looker, DOMO, or Power BI) to bring data insights to life for broad audiences Basic statistics proficiency: experiment design, hypothesis testing, statistical significance, probability, and distributions Ability to translate business intelligence needs from a variety of stakeholders into technical execution and clear presentation Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical information to non-technical audiences Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Experience using dbt to transform, test, and document data Experience working with healthcare industry data or in other complex, regulated data environments Experience in a high-growth environment Familiarity with version control systems (Git preferred) Understanding of effective data modeling strategies and implementations Why This Role Matters 🧡 Data is central to how Carrot operates and grows. Leaders across the company depend on accurate, timely reporting to serve members, support customers, and make sound business decisions. As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will be the connective tissue between raw data and those decisions, ensuring the organization runs on insights it can trust. Your work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Better data means better decisions for the members and customers who rely on Carrot every day. Interview Process 🤝 We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team. For this role, candidates can expect: Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes Performance Task — 60 minutes Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role. Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍 Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation 💰 Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $98,000.00- $125,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Data Analyst
items.summary: We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst to join our growing team.
items.description: We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst to join our growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to provide actionable insights that support business decisions and drive operational improvements. The ideal candidate has strong analytical skills and enjoys working with large datasets to identify trends, measure performance, and solve business problems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop reports, dashboards, and data-driven recommendations that help optimize processes and achieve business objectives. If you are passionate about data, problem-solving, and turning information into meaningful insights, we'd love to hear from you. items.title: KPI Architect
items.summary: The KPI Architect Role in Exelab’s Tailor-Made SolutionsAt Exelab, we don’t sell a single off-the-shelf product – we build custom, innovative solutions that directly target our clients’ unique business objectives.
items.description: The KPI Architect Role in Exelab’s Tailor-Made Solutions At Exelab, we don’t sell a single off-the-shelf product – we build custom, innovative solutions that directly target our clients’ unique business objectives. Each client engagement is essentially treated as a mini product development cycle: we start from a specific business goal or problem and craft a tailor-made solution (which might involve software, AI models, systems integration, etc.) to deliver measurable business impact. In Exelab’s methodological framework, performance and measurability of results become central elements of every project. The KPI Architect is the cross-functional figure who ensures rigor, consistency, and depth in performance analysis across all Value projects – the high-impact strategic initiatives at the core of Exelab’s offering. This role is not a traditional data analyst: it's a professional who combines advanced analytical skills with deep business understanding. Someone who knows that numbers tell stories, but only when you ask the right questions. The mission : ensure every project starts with clear objectives, defined measurement criteria, and a monitoring system that reveals whether actions are generating expected impact. The KPI Architect operates across multiple projects, intervening during discovery phases to define measurement frameworks, supporting Value Builders on complex analytical challenges, and verifying the impact of deployed solutions. Reporting directly to the General Manager, maintain an overview of performance across the entire project portfolio. In day-to-day operations, Value Builders must be autonomous in analyzing their project data. The KPI Architect intervenes when defining methodological frameworks, tackling complex analytical challenges, or ensuring client alignment on success criteria. Key Responsibilities The KPI Architect will ensure measurability and objectivity across our AI-enabled solutions. Core responsibilities include: Measurement Framework Definition: Collaborate with Value Builders and Project Managers during discovery phases to define how each project’s success will be measured. Translate vague business objectives into concrete, measurable, and actionable KPIs. Establish baselines, targets, and evaluation criteria that enable objective determination of whether an initiative has generated value. Create reusable templates and methodologies that accelerate this phase on future projects. Client Alignment on Objectives: Facilitate structured conversations with clients to ensure clarity and alignment on success criteria. Clients often have implicit or poorly defined expectations: the KPI Architect makes them explicit, quantifies them, and transforms them into shared agreements. This alignment prevents misunderstandings and creates the foundation for partnerships based on objective results. Complex Analytical Challenge Support: Intervene when Value Builders face analytical problems requiring specialized skills or advanced methodologies. This may involve multi-touch attribution analysis, predictive modeling, advanced segmentation, or interpretation of particularly complex datasets. Bring methodological expertise and work directly on the data alongside the Value Builder. Solution Impact Verification: After deployment, dive into the data to verify whether solutions are generating expected impact. Build the analyses personally, distinguish correlations from causality, identify confounding variables, and build rigorous analyses that enable correct attribution of results. When numbers don’t add up, propose course corrections based on concrete evidence. Purpose-Driven Analysis: Every analysis has a clear purpose and consequent action. Don’t produce reports for the sake of producing them: every insight must translate into a decision or action. Know when data is sufficient to decide and when deeper investigation is needed. Avoid analysis paralysis while maintaining focus on business value. Knowledge Building & Methodological Standards: Build and maintain Exelab’s analytical standards. Document methodologies, create templates, develop best practices that enable the organization to continuously improve analysis quality. Train Value Builders on fundamental analytical competencies, raising the team’s overall level. Portfolio View & Pattern Recognition: Thanks to the cross-functional position, identify patterns emerging across multiple projects. Recognize recurring problems, reusable solutions, reference benchmarks. This portfolio view feeds Exelab’s knowledge base and accelerates future projects. In summary, the KPI Architect is the guardian of measurability and objectivity at Exelab. This role ensures every project starts with clear objectives, proceeds with rigorous monitoring, and concludes with impact verification. The work transforms the promise of "measurable value" from a marketing claim into demonstrable reality. Requirements Ideal Candidate Profile – Skills and Experience Our ideal candidate is a professional with a rare combination: technical excellence in data analysis combined with deep understanding of business dynamics . It’s not enough to know how to manipulate data – you need to know which questions to ask and how to translate answers into valuable actions. Below are the key characteristics and qualifications we expect: Advanced Analytical Skills: Mastery of data analysis tools and methodologies: SQL, Python/R for statistical analysis, BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI). Comfort with statistical analysis: significance testing, regression analysis, cohort analysis, A/B testing methodology. Ability to work with large datasets and heterogeneous sources. Experience building dashboards and monitoring systems. Business Acumen & Strategic Orientation: Deep understanding of how businesses work and which metrics truly matter. Experience with KPIs typical of customer-facing contexts: conversion rate, customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, churn, NPS. Ability to link operational metrics to financial impact. Skill in translating vague business objectives into concrete, measurable indicators. Critical Thinking & Methodological Rigor: Scientific approach to analysis: formulate hypotheses, test them, evaluate evidence with constructive skepticism. Distinguish correlation from causality and identify biases and confounding variables. Don’t settle for the first interpretation: dig until finding the correct explanation. At the same time, know when data is “good enough” to decide. Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional ability to communicate complex insights clearly and actionably. Adapt the message to the audience: executive summary for C-level, methodological detail for technical teams. Skill in facilitating difficult conversations about success criteria, managing expectations and building alignment. Consulting or Multi-Project Experience: Background in environments involving multiple projects/clients in parallel. May come from consulting firms, agencies, or analytics roles in strongly data-oriented companies. Experience across diverse contexts develops pattern recognition and adaptability. Familiarity with CRM and marketing technology is a significant plus. Autonomy & Proactivity: Ability to operate with minimal supervision, proactively identifying where their intervention can create value. Don’t wait for problems to arrive: anticipate analytical needs and step forward. Manage own time across multiple projects, prioritizing based on impact. AI Openness & Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and use AI tools to enhance analytical activities. Intellectual curiosity and drive for continuous improvement. Data analysis evolves rapidly: we’re looking for someone who embraces this change as opportunity. Native Italian and at least B2-level English required. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Marketing Data Analyst
items.summary: We are looking for a Marketing Data Analyst to join the Marketing team at MD Finance.
items.description: We are looking for a Marketing Data Analyst to join the Marketing team at MD Finance . In this role, you will help us move from manual reporting and reactive analysis to reliable data, faster decisions, and forward-looking growth planning. The position combines technical data ownership with business analysis: from collecting data through APIs, exports, tracking systems, and internal sources to cleaning, transforming, validating, visualizing, and turning it into clear recommendations. If you enjoy building clean data foundations and turning complex marketing performance into decisions that directly influence CAC, new-deal volume, and channel scale, we'd love to see how you can contribute to our growth. Main Responsibilities: Own the end-to-end marketing data flow, including ingestion, transformation logic, data cleanup, quality assurance, dashboarding, analysis, and documentation. - Create and maintain a single source of truth for marketing decisions, connecting campaign performance, customer quality, funnel results, and business outcomes. - Set up and maintain offline conversion uploads to Google, Meta, and other advertising platforms so campaigns can optimize toward verified business results. - Own affiliate measurement, including postback API setup, conversion tracking, and complete reporting on leads, applications, approvals, new deals, repayments, and payouts. - Collect and structure marketing costs across all channels, with accurate CAC, ROI, and ROMI reporting by campaign, source, partner, keyword, landing page, source ID, and creative. Improve and standardize cross-channel attribution, and synchronize Singular data with internal dashboards, BI reports, and marketing visualizations. - Build and maintain product and marketing dashboards covering acquisition, funnel performance, user behavior, conversion rates, repayment behavior, campaign quality, and customer value. - Create a complete website and product tagging framework, visualize every key funnel step, and clearly separate new and repeat deals across channels, campaigns, affiliates, and traffic sources. - Support landing-page experiments and A/B tests by defining tracking, measuring results, analyzing performance, and recommending what should be improved, stopped, or scaled. - Help the team launch and evaluate marketing tests across campaigns, creatives, landing pages, sources, keywords, and traffic segments. - Analyze customer and traffic quality at keyword, landing-page, source-ID, creative, campaign, affiliate, and channel level. - Build cohort and repayment analyses to track retention, repeat usage, repayment patterns, risk signals, customer value, and long-term quality by acquisition source. - Deliver ROI/ROMI and LTV/CAC analyses that support budget allocation, channel scaling, and commercial planning. - Create dedicated SEO reporting with brand and non-brand traffic splits, plus separate dashboards for satellite websites and projects. - Take full ownership of the Marketing planning workbook: automate recurring work, improve its structure, and reduce manual effort and human error. - Work closely with Marketing, Product, IT, Affiliate, and Risk teams to keep data reliable, accessible, and useful for daily decisions. Expected Results: Establish reliable marketing reporting that serves as the trusted basis for daily, channel, and management decisions. - Reduce CAC and increase new-deal volume by identifying and scaling the campaigns, partners, and traffic segments that bring the highest-quality customers. - Improve budget allocation through consistent attribution, cost, repayment-quality, ROI/ROMI, and LTV/CAC analysis. - Reduce manual reporting, human error, traffic-launch delays, and Marketing's dependency on IT for recurring data tasks. - Enable faster, more structured experimentation with clear measurement and actionable recommendations. Professional Qualifications: 4+ years of experience in marketing analytics, performance analytics, product analytics, or a similar role. - Strong SQL skills and the ability to work confidently with large datasets. - Strong Python skills for automation, data cleaning, API integrations, and recurring reporting tasks. - Comfortable owning the full path from raw data to business decision: ingestion, transformation, cleanup, validation, dashboarding, analysis, and recommendation. - Hands-on experience with BI and visualization tools such as Power BI, Metabase, Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar. - Practical experience with marketing and tracking tools such as Singular, Google Ads and Google APIs, Meta Ads, GA4, GTM, Affise, affiliate platforms, postbacks, and ad-platform conversion tracking. - Experience building attribution logic, funnel reporting, cohort analysis, CAC/ROI/ROMI reporting, and LTV/CAC analysis. - Ability to move from campaign-level reporting into keyword, creative, landing-page, source-ID, affiliate, and channel-level quality analysis. - Strong business communication skills and the ability to translate complex analysis into clear actions for technical and non-technical stakeholders. - FinTech experience is a significant advantage, especially in lending, repayments, repeat customers, or risk-related marketing analysis. What We Offer: Join a fast-scaling FinTech company where your decisions shape the business and your contributions truly matter. - Enjoy 20 paid days off annually, flexible scheduling, and a supportive, people-first culture. - Partial compensation for medical insurance, sports activities, and foreign language. - Work in an international, agile team with ambitious goals, modern tools, and a strong sense of purpose. With $30M+ ARR, 100% YoY growth, and a newly expanded product suite (ad network, website builder, paid tiers), we’re entering our next phase of hypergrowth. You will be driving insights and data pipelines that help us grow and optimize our network for both publishers and advertisers. You will work cross-functionally with Business Leaders, Engineering, and Machine Learning Engineers to identify friction points and surface opportunities and actionable insights. You will help build the data model to power all of this. This is a hybrid role between a Product Data Analyst who works closely with business stakeholders and senior leadership, and someone who can own the Ad Network Data Stack across data modeling, reporting, analysis, and some machine learning. Compensation will be based on skill set, experience, and location. Ideally, this candidate can work EST hours. Ideally, you will have: 3+ years of experience as a highly technical Data Analyst, Data Scientist, or Data Engineer Excellent SQL skills and experience working with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Mode, Metabase, or similar). Experience with R or Python, conducting data-driven research and statistical analysis ( linear regression, k-means clustering) Experience with experimentation methodologies (A/B testing, multivariate testing). Experience with database data modeling to power reporting and analysis Experience with SQL ETL tools to define and materialize KPIs Exceptional ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences. Nice-to-Have: You have worked in Ad Tech or Marketing before ClickHouse or another OLAP database Experience building Entity Resolution systems or models Experience with Graph Databases Creator economy or SaaS experience is a plus What you'll be responsible for: Partner with Product Managers and Business Leaders to proactively define and track key success metrics and KPIs (CPC, CPA, CPM, etc.). Build and maintain dashboards and reporting to track campaign performance, network adoption, and impact of new advertisers and campaigns. Own and build out our Clickhouse data model with respect to the ad network. Design and implement aggregation tables to support ML, reporting, and in-app dashboarding. Recommend tweaks to improve this balance. Collaborate with Engineering and Data teams to improve event tracking, instrumentation, and data quality. Build out a beehiiv universal entity resolution system in collaboration with other engineers Maintain and expand our advertiser conversion attribution logic Design and build a potential 1st-party subscriber enrichment product using interaction data across beehiiv products. Work with ML on running Brand Lift A/B test studies Why this role might be for you: You're a strategic operator with hands-on executional chops. You're comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-paced environments. You're obsessed with customer outcomes and accelerating company growth. You're a clear, concise communicator and can develop cohesive, data-driven narratives verbally and in writing. Why this role might not be for you: Not a traditional 9-to-5 position Need to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders Not comfortable with rapid iteration and frequent context switching High expectations for both speed and quality Must navigate complex organizational dynamics Why beehiiv ? Our values aren't a poster on the wall — they're the bar. It’s how we operate, publicly and privately, and what we should return to when making decisions. That’s how we keep our team's momentum. That’s how we hire and keep A players. beehiiv ’s values. There's no room for B players ⭐: the best makes everyone better. Maniacal sense of urgency ⚡: speed is our superpower. Say what you think with positive intent 💬: disagree openly and give hard feedback directly, with the intent to help someone improve. User-obsessed 🐝: every decision starts with one question: how does this add value for the user? Ego comes second, winning comes first 🏆: we're here to create the best outcome; the team comes before the individual. We'll take care of you: Competitive salary Stock options Health, dental, and vision Insurance 401(k) employer match Unlimited PTO (mandatory 10 days per year minimum) Annual in-person team offsite Unlimited book budget Monthly Wellness Days (every third Friday of the month) Salary: USD 120,000-220,000 (dependent on experience) Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations & Analytics Parsley Health · Finance · Remote US, with a preference for Eastern or Central time zones and NYC metro · Full-time About Parsley Health Parsley Health is rebuilding primary care around root-cause, whole-person medicine. Our members get board-certified clinicians, health coaches, advanced testing, and a care platform that connects the dots across all of it. We are a mostly virtual medical practice with care available across the country, and we recently expanded in-network access nationwide. As we grow, we are continuing to improve how we connect growth, care delivery, member experience, and financial performance so we can make better decisions and scale sustainably. About the role We are hiring a Senior Manager, Revenue Operations & Analytics to help us understand and improve the full revenue engine at Parsley Health. Our revenue model extends well beyond a traditional sales funnel. Marketing creates demand, Sales converts prospective members, Member Experience influences engagement and retention, clinician capacity affects how much care we can deliver, and billing and collections determine how effectively that care translates into revenue. This person will look across that entire system. You will help us understand what is happening, why it is happening, and what we should do next. That means digging into the data, reconciling situations where different teams or metrics are telling different stories, challenging assumptions, improving forecasts and reporting, and bringing the right people together when an issue crosses functional lines. This is a senior individual contributor role. You should be highly analytical and technically capable, including strong SQL skills and enough understanding of modern data infrastructure to investigate when the numbers do not look right. You do not need to be a data engineer. Deeper backend and infrastructure work will be supported by our Technology team and specialized partners. The role reports to Finance, with a strong dotted-line partnership to the CTO, and works closely with nearly all department leaders. This role is remote by default, with a preference for candidates in Eastern or Central time zones. Candidates in the New York City area will have opportunities to collaborate in person with executives, physicians, and other leaders at our Manhattan headquarters. What you’ll do Own the view of our revenue engine: Connect performance across marketing, sales, member engagement, clinician capacity, visits, billing, collections, and financial results so leaders understand where revenue is growing, slowing, or leaking. Turn analysis into action: Investigate business questions, identify root causes, recommend what should change, and follow through with the relevant teams. Sometimes the right answer will be a reporting change. Other times it may be a process, forecast, operating assumption, or business decision. Reconcile conflicting stories: When Marketing, Sales, Clinical, MX, or Finance are seeing different versions of what is happening, dig into the underlying data and help the company get to a shared understanding. Improve forecasting and planning: Partner with Finance and functional leaders on forecasts across revenue, membership, conversion, clinician capacity, visit volume, retention, and collections. Challenge assumptions when operational data suggests a different outcome. Own BI and key business metrics: Maintain and improve our dashboards and recurring reporting, establish clear metric definitions and sources of truth, and change reporting processes when they are creating confusion or no longer helping the business make decisions. Improve growth analytics: Partner closely with our SVP of Marketing and Growth Product Manager to connect acquisition, lead quality, sales conversion, activation, engagement, retention, and downstream revenue. Connect care delivery and RCM to revenue: Help us understand how clinician capacity, utilization, visits, payer performance, billing, denials, collections, and other revenue cycle factors interact with the rest of the business, including data from our RCM and clinical systems. Handle practical RevOps and BizOps needs: Own or triage recurring analytical and operational work such as commissions, KPI reporting, ad hoc business analysis, and other cross-functional questions that need a clear owner. Work directly with the data: Use SQL and our BI environment to investigate questions, validate assumptions, identify data quality issues, and chase down discrepancies before they become business decisions based on bad information. What success looks like Within your first year: Leadership has a clearer and more trusted view of revenue performance and the operational drivers behind it. Material risks and opportunities surfaced earlier, with clear recommendations about what to do next. Teams spend less time reconciling conflicting numbers and more time acting from shared metrics and assumptions. Revenue forecasts better reflect what is happening across acquisition, conversion, capacity, retention, billing, and collections.
