items.description: Data and Analytics SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars. GATEWAY FLEET SPECIALIST: Starlink is building the world’s largest fleet of satellite ground stations. These gateways are the critical link between our satellites and the global internet backbone, and their reliability directly determines the quality of service for millions of users. We are seeking fleet specialists to own the reliability, growth, and sustainment of our fleet of Gateway antennas and sites across a region of the world. This is a true owner-operator role, managing everything from technical troubleshooting and spare parts strategy to international logistics, contractor performance, and field execution. This role is ideal for someone who excels at building operational excellence in fast-moving and internationally complex environments. You must be equally comfortable managing heavy equipment deployments in remote locations as you are negotiating with customs authorities and coaching contractors toward higher performance standards. RESPONSIBILITIES: Own the maintenance, operations, health, and growth for our fleet of Starlink Gateway Antennas and Sites for a region of the world Manage spare parts strategy, inventory planning, and materials movement across the region, to maintain rapid response readiness for both planned and emergency maintenance Monitor fleet health using dashboards and telemetry data to identify issues, diagnose software and hardware failures, drive timely repairs, and identify emerging degradation trends. Partner with engineering teams to execute fleetwide campaigns and perform root cause analysis on antenna and site failures across electrical, fiber optic, radiofrequency, and mechanical systems Coordinate with logistics providers, customs authorities, and regional partners to ensure timely and compliant international shipping of critical parts and equipment Manage relationships with contracted labor in the region, including training and capability development Analyze operational data and field feedback to identify systemic pain points and drive improvements in processes and tools Share ownership of the team’s growth: work with engineers and specialists to build scalable organizational structures that can support the rapid expansion of the world’s largest fleet of satellite ground stations. Basic Qualifications: High school diploma or equivalency certificate 2+ years of experience operations, logistics, technical support, field service, data analytics, project management, or a similar role involving distributed assets PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: 1+ years of experience in a customer support associate, technical support associate, quality specialist, process planner, business analyst, or leadership role Hands on experience with satellite ground stations, antennas; electrical, fiber optic, radiofrequency, or mechanical systems Experience supporting geographically distributed technical equipment or infrastructure Experience querying and analyzing data using SQL and/or other data visualization tools Background in root cause analysis and cross-functional collaboration with engineering teams Experience managing contractors or third-party vendors, particularly in international or remote environments Familiarity with MRP/ERP systems and spare parts/inventory management Proficiency in one or more of the following languages (in addition to English): Portuguese, French, Punjabi, Hindi, Japanese, Bengali, Kazakh, Arabic, Urdu, Vietnamese, Swahili, Sesotho, Swati, Tagalog. Knowledge of local business culture is a plus Experience troubleshooting or working with IT/network infrastructure (UPS, PDUs, servers, or networking equipment) Demonstrated ability to design efficient processes and systems, especially defining requirements for software tools Experience autonomously managing projects with minimal supervision ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS: Willing to travel 10-15% of the time Willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed Willing to work outside of normal business hours 20-40% if the time COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: Pay Range: Level 1: $27.00 - $40.00 Level 2: $31.00 - $45.00 Level 3: $36.00 - $51.00 Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience. Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday. ITAR REQUIREMENTS: To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here . SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status. Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com .

items.description: Who We Are: Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more. Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts. Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it. Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator. Our Team Members: We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond! We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca 's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. About the Role: We are seeking an Analytics Engineer to own and execute the vision for our data transformation layer. You will be at the heart of our data platform, which processes hundreds of millions of events daily from a wide array of sources, including transactional databases, API logs, CRMs, payment systems, and marketing platforms. You will join our 100% remote team and work closely with Data Engineers (who manage data ingestion) and Data Scientists and Business Users (who consume your data models). Your primary responsibility will be to use dbt and Trino on our GCP-based, open-source data infrastructure to build robust, scalable data models. These models are critical for stakeholders across the company—from finance and operations to the executive team—and are delivered via BI tools, reports, and reverse ETL systems. What You'll Do: Own the Transformation Layer: Design, build, and maintain scalable data models using dbt and SQL to support diverse business needs, from monthly financial reporting to near-real-time operational metrics. Set Technical Standards: Establish and enforce best practices for data modelling, development, testing, and monitoring to ensure data quality, integrity (up to cent-level precision), and discoverability. Enable Stakeholders: Collaborate directly with finance, operations, customer success, and marketing teams to understand their requirements and deliver reliable data products. Integrate and Deliver: Create repeatable patterns for integrating our data models with BI tools and reverse ETL processes, enabling consistent metric reporting across the business. Ensure Quality: Champion high standards for development, including robust change management, source control, code reviews, and data monitoring as our products and data evolve. What You Need (Must-Haves): 4+ years of experience in analytics engineering or data engineering with a strong focus on the "T" (transformation) in ELT. Proven track record of owning data products end-to-end, applying analytics and data engineering best practices to ensure data quality, scalability, and robust data models. Comfortable working with ambiguity and collaborating with stakeholders to define requirements; able to take ownership with minimal oversight in a fast-paced environment. Experience proactively identifying and implementing improvements to data warehouse performance and ETL efficiency. Technical Versatility: Expert-level SQL and DBT skills for complex queries and data transformations. Proficiency in Python for transformations that extend beyond SQL. Hands-on experience with query optimization across OLTP and OLAP systems (e.g., Postgres, Iceberg). Proficiency with Semantic Layer modelling (e.g. Cube, dbt Semantic Layer). Experience owning CI/CD workflows and establishing team-wide standards for version control and code review (e.g., Git). Familiarity with cloud environments (GCP or AWS). Nice to Haves: Experience with data ingestion tools (e.g., Airbyte) and orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow). Domain experience for brokerage operations or a passion for financial markets and modelling financial datasets. How We Take Care of You: Competitive Salary & Stock Options Health Benefits New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500 Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce. Recruitment Privacy Policy Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Customer Manager - Quality & Insights
items.summary: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world.
items.description: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically. Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space — ready to join us? What's the position? As Customer Quality & Insights Manager, you will build and lead how Hard Rock Digital understands and acts on customer sentiment. This is a zero-to-one role: the function doesn't exist yet, and you will be the one to organize various efforts into one cohesive strategy — the reporting, the process, and eventually the team. At the center of the role is a closed loop, and running that loop well is the actual job: identify where sentiment is slipping, diagnose what's driving it, get the finding to the team who can fix it, and then track what happens after the fix ships to confirm it actually moved the needle. Anything short of closing the loop is just reporting; closing it is what makes the role valuable. You will organize diagnosis around three pillars that drive customer sentiment: Person (how interactions are handled), Product (how our app and platform perform for customers), and Policy (how our processes and rules affect the experience). Your job is to find the story in the data and hand stakeholders something specific they can act on — not to audit or score individual performance. When a finding touches an individual interaction, your role is to surface the pattern and hand it to the team that owns coaching or process change, not to run that conversation yourself. This role reports directly to the Senior Manager, Operations Strategy & Insights. There are no direct reports today, but as the function grows, so will this team. You will work alongside the existing BI Operations function — the two teams are parallel, and you'll partner closely with them on shared data and stakeholder context. Responsibilities Building the function Stand up the customer sentiment/insights function: the reporting, the classification taxonomy, and the closed-loop process end to end. Define and own how the loop works across the org — from issue identification through post-implementation impact tracking — so stakeholders know how to engage with findings and recommendations. Build the case for future headcount and, if approved, onboard and manage a Quality & Insights Analyst. Represent the Insights function in cross-functional forums as the org's point of contact for customer sentiment. Sentiment measurement & reporting Build and maintain CSAT and sentiment reporting that gives stakeholders a clear, ongoing view of customer sentiment trends. Design and evolve a sentiment taxonomy that reliably classifies feedback into the Person, Product, and Policy pillars. Mine reviews, support tickets, surveys, and other qualitative feedback sources for sentiment signal, using AI tools to accelerate classification and pattern detection. Track sentiment trends over time and proactively surface emerging issues before they show up as escalations. Diagnosing what's driving sentiment When sentiment dips or a pattern emerges, dig into the underlying story: is it how an interaction was handled, a product friction point, or a policy/process design issue? Distinguish one-off incidents from systemic patterns, and prioritize investigations toward the issues with the greatest sentiment impact. Turn what you find into a clear, specific narrative stakeholders can act on — the goal is to explain what's driving the pattern, not to audit or score any individual's performance. Closing the loop Route findings to the team best positioned to act on them (people leadership, product, policy/process owners) with a specific, actionable recommendation. Maintain a running view of every open issue's status in the loop: identified, diagnosed, routed, and resolved. Track outcomes after a fix ships to confirm whether it actually moved sentiment, and close the loop back to the original finding. Present findings and loop status clearly to stakeholders, including team leads and cross-functional partners who own the Product and Policy pillars. Build data-backed business cases when a recommendation requires investment, prioritization, or a change to an existing process. Data foundation Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate sentiment and CSAT data across large, complex datasets. Validate data integrity and ensure sentiment classifications and diagnostic findings are grounded in accurate, well-understood sources. Create and maintain clear documentation for sentiment definitions, classification methodology, and recurring reports. Collaborate with the BI Operations team on shared data, metrics, and stakeholder context to ensure consistency across functions. Requirements What are we looking for? 6–9 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, customer experience, or a related field, including experience owning a function, workstream, or reporting capability with significant ambiguity. Proficient SQL skills, including the ability to write and join queries across multiple data sources (CSAT, NPS, support systems) to build reporting independently. Experience building and maintaining dashboards or reporting (Tableau or similar) that stakeholders rely on directly. Demonstrated ability to diagnose the underlying driver behind a pattern in customer feedback and turn it into a specific, actionable recommendation. Experience using AI tools within an analytical workflow, including sentiment classification, text analysis, or LLM-assisted review of qualitative feedback. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn analysis into a recommendation and land it with stakeholders who don't report to you. Comfort working across both quantitative data (CSAT scores, trend lines) and qualitative material (reviews, transcripts, case notes). Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Business, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Nice to have Prior experience building or standing up a new reporting function or capability from the ground up. People management experience. Familiarity with contact center or customer support operations and workflows. Familiarity with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse. Python experience, particularly for text/sentiment analysis (pandas, NLTK, or similar). Experience in iGaming, online sportsbook, casino, or a regulated industry environment. What’s in it for you? We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include: Competitive pay and benefits Flexible vacation allowance A hybrid / remote working environment Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand Roster of Uniques We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer). Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Frontend Web Application Developer
items.summary: Location: Remote Availability: 35-40 hours per week Working hours: US East business hours Reporting to: Lead developer KoboToolbox has an immediate opening for a Frontend Web Application Developer to fill a full-time position of approximately 35-40 hours per week, for a commitment of at least 1 year. As a member of our team, you will share in the challenge and excitement of writing code used by over 32,000 organizations around the world. These organizations create data-driven change through the collection and analysis of more than 20 million surveys per month. Only candidates who already have experience working on large web applications will be considered. Beyond technical acumen, we are seeking a team member who demonstrates curiosity, initiative, and a cooperative approach to problem solving and decision-making. If you're passionate about leveraging technology to make a positive impact, we want to hear from you! Responsibilities Searching and reading an extensive, long-lived code base to understand existing behavior and conventions. Recognizing when existing conventions may no longer be the best approach and suggesting improvements aligned with contemporary best practices. Writing robust, concise, and reusable code with accompanying tests and documentation. Reviewing other developers' code and providing constructive feedback. Incorporating feedback from code reviews to improve your skills and align with team standards. Using AI-assisted development tools effectively while maintaining responsibility for code quality and correctness. Efficiently investigating bug reports from the support team, creating well-scoped fixes or actionable plans for resolution. Scoping, prioritizing, estimating, and organizing work into manageably sized tasks. Attending regular video-conference check-ins with other members of the technical team. Communicating with the public in conjunction with our support staff or directly through forums, issue trackers, etc. Contributing to discussions about design and architecture collaboratively with the larger team. Performing other related duties as directed by the lead developer. Requirements Required Qualifications Professional experience writing, deploying, and maintaining client-side code for real-world, API-driven single-page applications. Proficiency with TypeScript, React, and related technologies, including styling, state management, and efficient data exchange over HTTP. Unflinching ability to work with legacy technologies such as Backbone and CoffeeScript. Recent experience giving and receiving code reviews. Ability to independently set up and troubleshoot a local development environment, knowing when to ask for help on genuine roadblocks. Interest in data collection (surveying), particularly in humanitarian emergencies and other challenging contexts, and a desire to improve our platform for our users. Proficiency with spoken and written English. Fluency with Git. Overlap with working hours in the Eastern time zone. Average availability of at least 30 hours per week, preferably 35 hours or more. Preferred Qualifications Experience with the following is preferred but not required to apply: Using Docker and Docker Compose in a development environment. Programming in Python, ideally with Django (and particularly Django REST Framework). Building user-facing LLM integrations. Surveying with XLSForm, ODK XForm, and OpenRosa. Integrating with Stripe for payment processing. An added note on qualifications... We know that people from underrepresented groups including women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, and others are less likely to apply for a role if they don't meet every qualification listed. We're more interested in your potential and growth mindset than a perfect checklist match. If this role excites you and you meet many, but not all, of the qualifications, we'd still love to hear from you. Equal Opportunity Employer Kobo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Benefits Genuine Impact: Contribute directly to projects that impact millions of people around the world globally, working alongside the largest international humanitarian organizations as well as thousands of national and small community based partners in 200 countries. Meaningful Work Environment: Join a team that believes work should be meaningful as well as fun, tackling global challenges through innovative data collection and management tools with a proven impact for lasting change. Diverse Team: Be part of an amazing, progressive, and globally diverse team that values diversity, equity, and inclusion across all spectrums. Flexible Work Culture: Enjoy mutual flexibility supported by a culture that prioritizes work-life balance. Professional Development: Benefit from generous professional development options. Full Time Employee Benefits (U.S. candidates only) : Health & Wellness : 5 medical insurance options, dental, and vision (up to 80% premium covered), plus life insurance and Long Term Disability. Financial Security : 401(k) retirement plan with 100% match up to 2%. Work-Life Balance : 20 days paid time off, 12 floating holidays, unlimited sick days, and paid parental leave. *Please note, if based in the US or Canada this is a full time employee position. In other locations full time employment or contractor positions are options depending on individual circumstances.

items.title: Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher
items.summary: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher.
items.description: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher. Your core mission will involve a deep dive into the complex internals and mechanics of various blockchain networks, reverse engineering of sophisticated Decentralized Finance (DeFi) protocols, and translating these complex systems into actionable, structured data. Develop new derivative data models and datasets for client insights and competitive advantages. Map, cleanse, and normalize raw, disparate blockchain data (transaction logs, smart contract events, state changes) into consistent, structured relational and non-relational schemes for consumption by analytics, machine learning, and AI tools. This role requires a unique blend of expertise in distributed systems, data engineering best practices, and a profound understanding of the crypto and decentralized ecosystem. What You’ll Do Maintain an AI-native and blockchain-forward mindset, proactively leveraging emerging trends and generative technologies to stay at the vanguard of the crypto revolution while maximizing work efficiency and uncovering novel, high-alpha data opportunities. Architect Intuitive Data Models: Turn the messiness of on-chain data into elegant, unified abstractions. You'll build the models that provide our users with granular, high-integrity insights across various protocols. Deconstruct DeFi Mechanics: Get under the hood of DeFi protocols. You'll reverse-engineer smart contracts and on-chain events, translating complex interactions into clean, production-grade SQL/dbt models. Scale Our Ecosystem Coverage: Lead the charge in indexing new blockchains. You’ll design the schemas that transform raw chain data into our internal "source of truth," ensuring every block is captured with 100% accuracy. Engineer Signal from Noise: Define the metrics that matter (TVL, Volume, Fees). You’ll be the gatekeeper of data quality, proactively identifying and filtering out wash trading, bot activity, and Sybil attacks. items.summary: Orchid Software Solutions | Remote, Latin America | Full-time contract About usOrchid Software Solutions builds and operates software for healthcare and family-building services.
items.description: Orchid Software Solutions | Remote, Latin America | Full-time contract About us Orchid Software Solutions builds and operates software for healthcare and family-building services. Our products cover escrow for surrogacy and egg donation, agency management for fertility clinics, medical records retrieval, insurance risk management, and independent dispute resolution for healthcare payments under the federal No Surprises Act. Our engineering team is distributed across the United States and Latin America, with a few colleagues further afield. We work remotely, in writing, and across time zones. About the role This is our first dedicated data and business intelligence role. You will own reporting end to end: the data model, the metric definitions, the dashboards our operations teams run on, and the reporting our enterprise clients see. You will start with our healthcare payments dispute resolution product, which has the largest data footprint and the most immediate reporting need. Once that reporting is running, the role expands across our other products, bringing one set of definitions to metrics that are currently produced product by product. The interesting part of this job is not the dashboards. Much of what our applications display is calculated at read time by application code rather than stored in a column, so the same question can be answered several ways. Your job is to decide what each metric means, document it, prove it reconciles against the systems of record, and defend that definition when someone wants a different number. If you like being the person whose figures nobody argues with, you will like this role. You will work alongside an engineering team of senior fullstack engineers and QA, a product manager, and business leadership in the United States. You will present your numbers directly to executives and to client counterparts, so this is a role for someone comfortable in front of an audience, not only in a query editor. What you will do Build and maintain internal reporting for operational volume, case status and stage, cycle and resolution time, throughput, and service-level metrics. Own payment reconciliation reporting, where the tolerance for an approximate answer is zero. Design and ship scoped, self-service reporting for enterprise clients, so they can answer their own questions without going through our support team. Model data in our analytics warehouse: dimensional models, incremental transformations, and tested, documented pipelines. Own the metric layer. One definition per metric, the query that produces it, the business rule behind it, and a data dictionary anyone can read. Reconcile reporting against the source systems and keep it reconciled as the applications change. Work with role-scoped access and data minimization as a matter of routine. We handle regulated healthcare and payment data, and reporting is built to keep sensitive fields out of it. Improve data quality. Find the defects that make reporting wrong, quantify them, and drive the fixes with the engineering team. Turn ambiguous questions from executives and clients into defined metrics, and say so when a question cannot be answered from the data we hold. Extend the same patterns and definitions to our other products as the function grows. What we are looking for Expert SQL. Complex analytical queries, window functions, and query performance work. You can tell the difference between a number that is surprising and a number that is wrong. Hands-on warehouse experience. ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks. You have modeled data in one, not only queried someone else’s models. Dimensional and semantic modeling. You have built a reporting layer over a normalized transactional schema and owned the definitions that sat on top of it. Client-facing reporting, shipped. You have built reporting that external customers used, with the scoping and access controls that requires. You write code, not only queries. Production-quality work in Git, code review in both directions, and the ability to build and run your own transformation jobs. Stakeholder judgment. You can sit with an executive or a client, work out what they actually need, and push back when the ask does not hold up. Data governance in a regulated setting. Practical experience with role-based access, handling of personal or health data, and producing evidence for an audit. HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI, or similar. Clear written communication. Our team is distributed and most decisions happen in writing. Professional English, written and spoken. You will present to United States executives and to client counterparts. Fluency is required and is assessed in the first conversation. Time zone overlap. A minimum of four hours of daily overlap with United States Eastern time, 9:00 to 13:00 ET. Able to contract independently. You can invoice and contract as an independent professional in your country of residence, and accept confidentiality and data-handling terms covering regulated healthcare data. Nice to have Healthcare payments, claims, or payer and provider data. Experience with No Surprises Act dispute resolution is a real advantage. dbt or a comparable transformation framework, in production, with tests. Change data capture pipelines and the failure modes that come with them. Financial reconciliation reporting. Python for data work. Enough TypeScript to read an application and trace how a value is calculated. An embedded analytics or BI tool taken to production with external users, including row-level security. AWS, particularly RDS, S3, and IAM as it applies to data access. Prior work with a United States company in a regulated industry. What this role is not It is not a ticket queue for dashboard requests. You own definitions and you are expected to have opinions about them. It is not platform or infrastructure engineering. We have a platform team and you will partner with them. It is not machine learning or model development. That work sits with a separate team. Tech you will work with TypeScript and Next.js applications, MySQL and PostgreSQL as operational stores, ClickHouse as the analytics warehouse, change data capture between them, Python for data work, and AWS throughout. Our older products run on Python and Flask. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior Manager, Business Performance & Analysis
items.summary: ABOUT ALUALU provides higher education for a higher purpose.
items.description: ABOUT ALU ALU provides higher education for a higher purpose. Our students declare missions, not majors.They develop the real-world skills to take on the world’s most pressing challenges. And they take ownership of their learning from day one through our peer and student-led approach – because ALU believes in the power and agency of young people to start shaping the future right now. Together with a world-class faculty and staff, our students are igniting a ripple of positive impact across Africa and the world. We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities. HOW WE WORK The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new. The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding. ABOUT THE TEAM The Business Performance & Analysis team is one of ALU ’s core performance intelligence functions, providing the insight, analysis and challenge required to help leaders understand performance, make informed decisions and improve institutional outcomes. Working across academic and professional functions, the team goes beyond reporting what has happened to understand why it happened, what it means, what is likely to happen next, and what action is required. It brings together performance data, analysis and external benchmarks to identify trends, risks, opportunities and areas for improvement. The team connects strategy, performance and execution by strengthening performance measurement, supporting decision-making and helping leaders translate insight into action. Its impact is measured not by the volume of reports produced, but by the quality of decisions informed and the improvements in institutional performance that follow. ABOUT THE ROLE The Senior Manager, Business Performance & Analysis will lead the analysis, interpretation and management of institutional performance information to support evidence-based decision-making across ALU . The role will translate complex business, financial, operational, academic and student data into clear insights, identify performance trends and gaps, assess their underlying drivers, and provide actionable recommendations to improve institutional outcomes. The role will also strengthen ALU 's performance management and business intelligence capabilities, ensuring that leadership has timely, reliable and forward-looking information to guide strategic and operational decisions. Working across functions and with senior leaders, the role will connect institutional strategy, performance targets and operational results, providing the analysis and challenge required to improve execution and organisational performance. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Institutional Performance Management Lead the development, implementation and continuous improvement of ALU 's institutional performance framework, including KPIs, targets, scorecards and performance measures. Monitor performance against strategic and operational objectives, identify material variances, emerging risks and areas of underperformance, and recommend appropriate interventions. Lead periodic performance reviews and provide analysis that enables leadership to understand not only what is happening, but why it is happening and what action is required. Analyse performance across key institutional areas including enrolment, recruitment, retention, student progression, programme performance, revenue, costs, resource utilisation and other strategic priorities. Establish appropriate performance benchmarks and support leadership in setting meaningful, measurable and outcome-focused objectives and targets. Business and Strategic Analysis Identify trends, patterns, performance drivers and root causes across multiple sources of institutional data. Develop business cases, investment analyses and decision papers, including assessment of financial, operational and strategic implications. Undertake scenario analysis and modelling to assess the potential impact of strategic and operational decisions. Conduct complex business and institutional analysis to support strategic planning, operational decisions and strategic initiatives and prioritization. Provide objective analysis and constructive challenge where data, assumptions or proposed interventions require further scrutiny. Conduct internal and external benchmarking to assess institutional performance against relevant peer institutions, competitors, sector standards and market trends. Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations, implications and actions for senior leadership. Performance Intelligence and Reporting Lead the development of high-quality management information, executive performance reports, dashboards and analytical products for senior leadership and governance forums. Establish standards for performance reporting, data interpretation, and analytical storytelling. Ensure management reports focus on material performance issues, drivers, trends and decisions rather than simply presenting data. Develop forward-looking analysis and forecasts to support proactive management of institutional performance. Work with data and technology teams to improve access to, integration of and confidence in institutional data. Ensure the accuracy, consistency and appropriate interpretation of performance information used for management decision-making. Analytics Capability and Continuous Improvement Develop clear standards for analytical quality, delivery and stakeholder service. Coach team members in analytical thinking, problem solving, business partnering and effective communication of insights. Develop and continuously improve analytical methodologies, tools and processes. Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and improve performance reporting and analysis. Promote a culture of evidence-based decision-making and stronger use of data across ALU . Partner with other functions to develop integrated views of institutional performance. Executive Stakeholder Engagement Establish and maintain data supply arrangements with the functions that own the underlying data: agreed definitions, cut dates, quality standards, and named counterparts. Resolve definitional inconsistency across campuses, programmes and systems so that the institution reports a single number for each institutional metric. Build effective working relationships with senior leaders, Deans, Directors and functional teams across ALU . Present complex analysis clearly to non-technical audiences and translate findings into practical business implications. Facilitate performance discussions and support leaders in identifying appropriate responses to performance gaps. Influence decisions through evidence, insight and constructive challenge, including where findings may challenge established assumptions or practices. Provide analytical support to strategic, executive and governance forums as required. Maintain a strong understanding of the ALU ’s operating environment, priorities and strategic objectives to ensure analysis remains relevant to institutional needs. Ensure the safety and well-being of all young persons and vulnerable adults with whom we deal, by adhering to ALU ’s comprehensive safeguarding policy, maintaining a zero-tolerance approach to any violations of safeguarding standards REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 10+ years of relevant professional experience in business performance, institutional research, strategy, business intelligence, analytics, planning, consulting, financial analysis or a related field. Demonstrable experience leading, developing and managing organisational or institutional performance frameworks, including KPIs, targets, scorecards and performance reporting. Proven experience analysing complex datasets and translating findings into actionable recommendations for senior decision-makers, forecasting, scenario modelling, business case development and quantitative analysis. Experience producing executive-level performance reports, dashboards and decision-support materials. Experience using data to identify performance drivers, diagnose problems and support measurable improvements in organisational outcomes. Demonstrated experience delivering analytical or performance improvement initiatives that resulted in measurable business, operational, financial or institutional impact. Experience benchmarking organisational or institutional performance against external peers, competitors or sector standards is desirable. REQUIRED COMPETENCIES Functional Competencies Strategic and Performance Analysis: Analyse complex institutional issues, identify performance drivers and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Data & Business Intelligence: Analyse complex datasets and develop clear dashboards, management information and performance insights. Financial & Commercial Acumen: Understand the financial, operational and institutional implications of decisions. Forecasting & Modelling: Develop forecasts, scenarios and business models to support planning and decision-making. Problem Solving: Diagnose root causes, test assumptions and develop practical, evidence-based solutions. Executive Reporting: Distil complex information into clear insights, implications and recommendations for senior leaders. Analytics Tools: Advanced Excel and strong proficiency in Power BI and uses digital and AI-enabled tools effectively to accelerate analysis, improve productivity and generate insight, while independently validating outputs and exercising sound judgement. Behavioural & Leadership Competencies Strategic Thinking: Connect performance trends and analysis to broader institutional priorities. Critical Thinking: Question assumptions and assess evidence objectively. Influencing & Challenge: Build credibility with senior stakeholders and challenge constructively using evidence. Executive Communication: Communicate complex findings clearly and persuasively to varied audiences. Collaboration: Work effectively across academic and professional functions. Leadership & Coaching: Develop people, set high analytical standards and build team capability. Delivery Orientation: Focus on turning insight into action and measurable institutional improvement. Match the ALU Archetype: Alignment with the ALU Archetype, including ownership, courage, and stewardship. Originally posted on Himalayas

We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes our commitment to being an inclusive workplace, attracting and developing exceptional talent, supporting our teammates' physical, emotional, and financial wellness, recognizing and rewarding performance, and how we make an impact in the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture with specific requirements for office-based attendance and which allows for an appropriate level of flexibility for our teammates and businesses based on role-specific considerations. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us! Job Description: This job is responsible for supporting analytical work efforts for various projects within a Line of Business or business discipline. Key responsibilities include leveraging databases to acquire client and performance data, transforming extracted data into meaningful insights and trends, and delivering those insights to leaders to make complex business decisions. Job expectations include working with business partners to understand, coordinate, and deliver agreed upon priorities while communicating complex data outputs and delivering the appropriate summary and data required. Responsibilities: Supports the extraction of data using a variety of a programming languages, such as SQL, SAS, Python, or Spark/Scala, and applies knowledge of relational and non-relational database systems housed on both on-premise and off-premise (hybrid) platforms Connects provisioned data across multiple sources and performs necessary transformations utilizing both technical, business, and process knowledge to transform data into meaningful values and insights Performs quantitative techniques and analysis on customer, transaction, and performance data with the guidance from other analysts and supervisors, based on questions provided by business partners, and provides actionable insights for business partners to make informed decisions. Follows requirements developed by other analysts and supervisors to perform required research, analytics, and exploration on appropriate and accurate data sources to provide appropriate deliverables Communicates complex subjects in a simple and engaging manner to non-technical and technical business partners using software such as Power Point, Word, Excel, and Tableau Assists with conducting quality comparison checks on analysis output and escalates data inconsistencies, gaps, or issues to leadership Follows quality workflow process and documentation requirements to adhere to standards and provide business continuity As a Client Quantitative Analyst, your main responsibilities will involve: Clearly documenting and effectively communicating quantitative methods as part of ongoing audiences Ability to manipulate data from structured and unstructured sources Experience extracting and merging data from different database environments, including Hadoop Ability to work effectively items.title: Senior UX Research and Design Specialist
items.summary: Cambium Learning® Group is an award-winning educational technology solutions leader dedicated to helping all students reach their potential through individualized and differentiated instruction.
items.description: Cambium Learning® Group is an award-winning educational technology solutions leader dedicated to helping all students reach their potential through individualized and differentiated instruction. Using a research-based, personalized approach, Cambium Learning Group delivers SaaS resources and instructional products that engage students and support teachers in fun, positive, safe and scalable environments. These solutions are provided through Learning A-Z® (online differentiated instruction for elementary school reading, writing and science), ExploreLearning® (online interactive math and science simulations, a math fact fluency solution, and a K–2 science solution), Voyager Sopris Learning® (blended solutions that accelerate struggling learners to achieve in literacy and math and professional development for teachers), and VKidz Learning (online comprehensive homeschool education and programs for literacy and science). We believe that every student has unlimited potential, that teachers matter, and that data, instruction, and practice are the keys to success in the classroom and beyond. Job Overview: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior UX Research & Design Specialist with a dual passion for user advocacy and tangible web design. In this role, you will lead end-to-end qualitative and quantitative research cycles within our K-12 educational data and assessment platforms. Beyond traditional data synthesis, you possess a strong sense of visual and layout design, allowing you to translate raw researcher findings directly into clean, interactive, and tangible UI prototypes. You will act as a critical bridge between educator insights and production-ready web design. Job Responsibilities: Advanced User Research & Methodology Execute End-to-End Research: Lead qualitative and quantitative research initiatives (focus groups, structured interviews, surveys, and usability testing) involving teachers, instructional coaches, and school administrators. Conduct Market & Competitive Analysis: Perform targeted market and competitive research to evaluate industry trends, benchmark rival EdTech solutions, and identify strategic positioning opportunities for our platform features. Drive Feedback Syntheses: Design and facilitate educator panels to capture nuanced workflows, translating feedback into clear product design opportunities. Iterate and Track Perceptions: Build systematic, iterative research loops to measure shifts in user perception and long-term platform adoption. Manage Diverse Recruitment: Orchestrate participant recruitment strategies across varied K-12 demographics (elementary, middle, and high school tenures). Tangible Web Design & Interactive Prototyping Translate Insights into Mockups: Convert user pain points and research metrics into high-fidelity web designs, intuitive screen flows, and interactive layouts. Bridge Design and Engineering: Collaborate directly with front-end web designers by delivering design specifications that map closely to web structure realities. Refine Interface Hierarchy: Evaluate and rapidly iterate on layout sequences, visual hierarchies, UI text labeling, and main navigation structures. K-12 Assessment & Data Literacy Demystify Student Data: Apply deep knowledge of K-12 grading architectures and standards-based reporting to build accessible teacher dashboards. Align with Classroom Realities: Design specifically for time-constrained educators who need immediate visual data displays for student remediation and administrative groupings. Data Visualization & Web Usability Apply Visualization Best Practices: Craft clean, visual progress bars, color-coded matrices, and grouping indicators tailored for non-technical users. Enforce Digital Accessibility: Ensure all generated data visualizations and interface layouts meet inclusive, accessible design guidelines. Job Requirements: Experience: 7+ years of dedicated professional experience in UX research, interface design, or digital analytics architectures. Preferred Degrees: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Interaction Design, Human Factors, Cognitive Psychology, Computer Science, or a related behavioral/technology-focused discipline. Design Stack Literacy: Mastery of contemporary UI wireframing and prototyping ecosystems (e.g., Figma). Cross-Functional Communication: Proven ability to present research artifacts (personas, journey maps, insight decks) to technical development squads and leadership. Preferred & Technical Qualifications: Classroom & Instructional Experience: Prior experience as a K-12 classroom teacher, instructional coach, or school-level educator, providing firsthand empathy for school schedules, administrative burdens, and classroom data usage. Front-End Development Frameworks: Functional technical understanding of front-end development, specifically the ability to read, interpret, and write HTML5 and CSS3 code to facilitate seamless developer handoffs. AI Tooling Efficiency: Demonstrated proficiency leveraging AI productivity systems and predictive tools to generate user scripts, synthesize large datasets, and build rapid UI prototypes. EdTech Domain Experience: Direct familiarity with standards-based grading metrics, formative assessment patterns, and large-scale district or state educational technology rollouts. Compliance Standards: Working familiarity with compliance rules governing K-12 web ecosystems, including WCAG accessibility benchmarks and FERPA privacy guardrails. To apply for this opportunity, simply click on the “Apply” button and submit a cover letter and resume. An Equal Opportunity Employer We are dedicated to fostering a culture that celebrates unique backgrounds, ideas, and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world. We're looking for a Data Analyst Intern to join the Risk/Data team. The intern will support data pipeline development, SQL-based analytics, and data standardization initiatives under the guidance of senior team members. This is a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience with large-scale data processing in a real business environment. Responsibilities: Assist in developing and maintaining SQL-based data pipelines and analytics workflows Support data standardization and normalization projects (e.g., address parsing, entity resolution) Help build and optimize data models, dashboards, and reports Conduct ad-hoc data analysis under mentorship and present findings to the team Assist in monitoring data quality and implementing validation logic Collaborate with team members on cross-functional data projects Requirements: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related field Solid SQL skills, familiarity with Hive/Spark SQL is a plus Basic proficiency in at least one scripting language (Python preferred) Strong interest in data analytics, risk control, or fraud detection Good communication skills, eagerness to learn and take initiative Available for at least 3 days per week, minimum 3-month internship duration Compensation Additional Information Why Binance • Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem • Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure • Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning • Competitive salary and company benefits • Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team) Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. items.description: The Role We Need PadSplit runs on data, from Growth and Operations to Product and Finance, and we need someone who can turn that data into clear, trustworthy decisions. We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to own analyses end to end, build durable reporting infrastructure, and help shape how the company measures its business. This person will work daily across our modern data stack (Snowflake, dbt, and Hex) to answer high-impact questions and raise the analytical bar across the team. The Person We Are Looking For We're looking for someone with 5+ years of analytics experience who is equally comfortable writing expert-level SQL and translating ambiguous business questions into rigorous, well-documented analysis. This person is a strong communicator who can defend their methodology to technical and non-technical audiences alike, and who brings sound judgment about when to lean on AI tools versus when to verify. They're curious, detail-oriented, and take ownership seriously, from scoping a question through to following up on the outcome. Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day: SQL & Analysis: Write, optimize, and maintain complex SQL against our Snowflake warehouse to answer business questions accurately and efficiently. dbt Modeling: Build and maintain dbt models that transform raw data into well-documented, tested, and reusable datasets. Dashboards & Reporting: Build dashboards, apps, and reporting in Hex that leaders trust and use to run the business. Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with teams to define metrics, scope analyses, and translate ambiguous questions into clear analytical work. Anomaly Investigation: Investigate anomalies in key metrics, identify root causes, and communicate findings with clear recommendations. Documentation: Maintain documentation across dbt and Hex so metric definitions stay consistent across teams. Data Quality: Validate sources, pressure-test assumptions, and flag gaps before they reach decision-makers. AI-Assisted Work & Mentorship: Use AI tools to accelerate analysis and reporting while verifying outputs, and mentor other analysts on best practices. Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful: Analytics Experience: 5+ years of experience in data analytics or a closely related field. Expert SQL: Advanced skills in window functions, CTEs, query optimization, and large, complex datasets. Snowflake Expertise: Hands-on experience with Snowflake as a primary data warehouse. dbt Experience: Building and maintaining dbt models in a production analytics environment, including tests and documentation. Hex/Notebook Reporting: Experience building reporting in Hex or a similar notebook-based analytics platform. End-to-End Ownership: A track record of owning analyses from scoping through delivery and follow-through. Strong Communication: Ability to explain technical findings to non-technical audiences and defend your methodology. AI Fluency & Judgment: Working familiarity with AI tools in analytics, paired with sound judgment on when to verify outputs and how to handle sensitive data. The Interview Process: Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by a real human being from the PeopleOps team. If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a video interview with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes. If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Head of Business Intelligence for forty-five (45) minutes. If warranted, the next step would be an SQL assessment through Coderbyte. If warranted, the next step would be a video panel interview with key stakeholders at PadSplit for one and a half (1.5) hours. If warranted, we move to offer! Compensation, Benefits, and Perks: Fully remote position - we swear! Competitive compensation package including an equity incentive plan and company-wide bonus opportunity National medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans Company provided life insurance policy Optional accidental insurances, FSA, and DCFSA benefits Unlimited paid-time (PTO) policy with eleven (11) company-observed holidays 401(k) plan Twelve (12) weeks of paid time off for both birth and non-birth parents The opportunity to do what you love at a company that is at the forefront of solving the affordable housing crisis Compensation Additional Information

items.description: Data and Analytics Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. The Team Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers. The Role As a Lead AI Consultant (Field) (known internally - Lead Deployment Engineer) of the Iberia & LATAM region, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance. You will lead the team of junior Consultants and team with experts (AI, Product, Functional) to make sure the customer achieves value and adoption. As a strategic driver in the pre-sales stage, you will partner closely with Account Teams to shape and position our Services solutions. You won't just present offerings—you will architect the foundation for long-term customer success, ensuring rapid adoption and value realization. This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are Product expert and an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, to ensure the platform delivers measurable impact and adoption. The Work You’ll Do Pre-Sales: Designing tailored deployment roadmaps and implementation strategies aligned with the customer's maturity. Estimating project timelines, team structures, and overall professional services effort to support commercial proposals. Partnering with Account Executives and Value Engineers to translate business cases into actionable deployment plans. Drafting clear Statements of Work (SOW), defining project scope, deliverables, assumptions, and acceptance criteria. Aligning client expectations with operational feasibility to prevent post-sale scope creep. Post-Sales: Initiate and Connect Define the strategy and oversee junior Consultants covering - Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required Build & Value Direct AI deployment agents to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements – do we make this less of a must have? Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance Rollout, Adoption, and Handover Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff Domain & Industry Depth Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually – still hands on technical? You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable The Qualifications You Need Experience: 7+ years in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators. Consulting pre-sales experience Platform skills: Track record in complex IT/SAP transformations, process optimization, and PQL/SQL/Python technical capability AI fluency: Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus. Business and process domain expertise : Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus. Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences. Analytical mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with a value-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact. Learning agility: Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools. Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field. Languages: Fluency in English and Spanish required. Portuguese beneficial. Travel : Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases. What Celonis can offer you: Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations. Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants. Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment. Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration. Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform. Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance. Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually. Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued. Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision. About Us: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide. Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video . Celonis Inclusion Statement: At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. Your Privacy: Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process . Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here .

items.description: The Workplace Engineering function sits at the intersection of traditional HR analytics and modern Product Engineering. We transform raw workforce data into a suite of "People Products" that drive high performance. We don’t just "report" on what happened; we engineer the tools and insights that determine what happens next. This new role will report directly to the Global Head of Workplace Engineering, and sits within our Data discipline inside of our People department. Experienced data professionals at Canonical live at the intersection of software, data, and the business. They don't just help surface analytic artifacts; they help transform them into a strategic asset that elevates decision making and innovation across our global operations (e.g., sales, marketing, engineering, and human resources). They balance technical precision with business pragmatism, designing and iterating on experiments, automations, and products that transform insights into valued outcomes. They shape tomorrow's AI/Data stack in open source, ensuring that Canonical remains at the forefront of data-driven excellence. Their curiosity is contagious and has an amplifying effect on data literacy and stewardship across the business teams they support. Location: This is a remote role based in the AMER or EMEA Region. The role entails Multi-Disciplinary Leadership: Lead and mentor a specialized squad of People Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and UX Designers. You aren't just managing analysts; you are leading a product squad. Product Ownership on People Science: Bridge the gap between "HR-speak" and "Dev-speak", ensuring engineers understand the human behavioral intent behind the code. Strategic Insight & Business Outcomes: Move beyond descriptive metrics (e.g., turnover rate) to predictive and prescriptive insights (e.g., predicting attrition risk based on "Time-Product" engagement data). Data Stewardship & Product Storytelling: Act as the "Translator-in-Chief". Take complex data models and turn them into compelling narratives. Lead the development of AI Agents that can surface insights to managers in real-time. Ensure the "People Data Stack" is secure, GDPR/privacy-compliant, and acts as a "Single Source of Truth" across all People related offerings, products and services. “Effectiveness at Work” Strategy: Identify opportunities to leverage “High Tech” solutions in our People offerings, and free up more time for “High Touch”, human involvement, thereby maximizing human value. What we are looking for in you Background in data science, mathematics, or engineering, skilled in advanced statistics, data wrangling/science, databases (SQL, etc.) or software engineering. Strength in coding/scripting languages (Python, R, JavaScript, etc.), software engineering, visualization (e.g. Superset, Tableau), and automation. Ability to translate business questions to key research objectives. Ability to identify the best methodology to execute research, synthesize and analyze findings. Proven ability to lead and drive others to execute against well planned roadmaps, with a strong mentor/coaching mindset. Willingness to examine the status quo and be resilient in the face of challenges. Ambition to build tomorrow's AI/Data stack in open source. An exceptional academic track record from high school and university. Business level written and spoken English. Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission. International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long. In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being: Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity. Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence. Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable. Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character. Nice-to-have skills Experience with Airbyte, Ranger, Superset, Temporal, or Trino Basic understanding of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes Agentic Engineering Product management User experience and design What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Bi-annual compensation review Company recognition rewards 40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods Maternity and paternity leave Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing. Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
