items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.) Commercial Data Scientist Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients. At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you. This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S. As a Commercial Data Scientist , you’ll work within cross-functional delivery teams alongside other analysts, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in discovering data insights to help improve healthcare. How you’ll make an impact: Deliver novel and impactful insights for client organizations using machine learning and AI technologies. Work closely with our Product, Platform Data, Insights & Strategy, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses. Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates and future projects. Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform. Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced environment to exceed client expectations The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team. Collaboration —The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth. Passion for Data —You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights. Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success. Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight. Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals. About you: At least 4 years of professional experience as a Data Scientist or other related roles working with complex, high-volume, structured and unstructured datasets. Prior experience in a data science consulting role at firms such as ZS, Trinity, IQVIA, BlueMatter, etc., where you thrived in a fast-paced environment Advanced knowledge of statistical concepts — particularly exploratory data analysis, experimental design, and probability theory. Deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques Proven ability to design, train, and evaluate large-scale production models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. Advanced SQL proficiency — skilled at writing and optimizing complex queries across multiple tables and data relationships. Advanced Python skills, including understanding of object-oriented programming, production-grade code design, and modern data science libraries. Hands-on experience with distributed data processing tools and concepts for scalable analysis and model training. Excellent data visualization and storytelling abilities, with the capacity to translate technical insights into clear, compelling narratives for internal and client stakeholders. Curious, fast learner with a demonstrated passion for data, continuous learning, and staying current with advances in machine learning research. Fun Facts About the Client Intelligence team We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections. Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights. The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds. We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events! Compensation The anticipated total compensation for this role is $119,333 - $172,800 depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity. Our total compensation package may include: Base salary Equity (where applicable) Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable) Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process. Benefits In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance 401(k) with company match Flexible paid time off and company holidays Paid parental leave Professional development and learning opportunities Wellness and mental health resources Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable) Why You'll Love Working Here At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work. Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care. Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning. Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work. Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development. Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated. Our Hiring Process & AI Tools Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws. Equal Employment Opportunity Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Phoenix, Arizona URL: https://adventuretravel365.com/ Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform We have a big idea, and we’re looking for a top-notch Senior Full-Stack Developer to help us bring it to life. We’re building a new contractor referral and services marketplace, think Thumbtack or Angi , where clients can easily find and connect with contractors and service providers. The vision includes both an interactive web platform and mobile app, with everything from user accounts and referrals to job tracking, payments, advertising, and more. This is a fully remote, full-time, ongoing position, and we’re open to applicants worldwide. There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us. What You’ll Help Us Build The platform will have two main sides: clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business. Some of the functionality we’re planning includes: Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management Job and project tracking Client and vendor dashboards Online payments and transaction tracking Reviews and ratings Notifications and communications Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities Admin tools for managing the platform Reporting and analytics Secure management of user, job, and transaction data And probably more! We have a strong vision for where we want this to go, but we also want the right developer to help us determine the smartest way to build it. This will be an evolving platform, so we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with it, not simply complete a checklist of features. Who We’re Looking For We’d love to find someone with strong experience in full-stack web and mobile development , especially someone who has worked on a marketplace, booking platform, service-provider network, or another multi-user platform. You should be comfortable with: Full-stack web development Mobile or cross-platform app development Strong front-end and back-end development Multi-user marketplace platforms User authentication and account management Payment gateway integrations Databases and APIs Third-party integrations Dashboards and reporting Secure, scalable application architecture Cloud hosting and deployment Testing, maintenance, and optimization Using modern AI-powered development tools and integrating AI capabilities into web and mobile applications If you’ve worked on something similar to Thumbtack, Angi, TaskRabbit, Upwork, or another two-sided marketplace , we definitely want to hear about it. More Than Just Coding We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of instructions and starts coding. We want someone who can look at the big picture, ask the right questions, recommend the best technical approach, flag potential challenges, and help turn our ideas into a platform that’s intuitive, scalable, and built to grow. You’ll also be expected to study established platforms like Thumbtack and Angi , understand how their user journeys and marketplace functionality work from both the client and service-provider sides, and use those learnings to help us determine the best approach for our own platform. You should be able to take the project through planning, architecture, development, testing, launch, and beyond , while communicating clearly with a non-technical team along the way. Strong spoken and written English communication skills are important. You should be comfortable discussing ideas, explaining technical decisions clearly, and communicating regularly with a non-technical team. This is not a short-term build-and-leave project. We’re looking for someone who can stay with the platform as it grows, helping us continually improve, expand, and maintain it over time. Interested? Tell Us About Yourself Please send us: A quick introduction Your resume or LinkedIn profile Your portfolio and links to websites/apps you’ve built Examples of marketplaces, booking platforms, referral systems, or payment-enabled platforms you’ve worked on What you personally worked on for those projects Your experience using AI in development What technologies/frameworks you’d recommend for a project like this and why Your availability A short video introduction would be great, too! Nothing overly formal, just a quick introduction so we can get to know you, hear about your experience, and get a feel for how you communicate. Most importantly, show us what you’ve built. If you’ve helped create a multi-sided marketplace similar to Thumbtack or Angi, tell us about it. We’d love to see it. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/adventure-travel-365-senior-full-stack-developer-marketplace-web-mobile-platform

items.description: Software Engineering Job Requisition ID # 25WD93193 English posting follows 25WD93193 Architecte logiciel, Plateforme de données AEC Aperçu du poste Chez Autodesk, nous sommes des pionniers dans le domaine des logiciels de conception 3D, d'ingénierie et de divertissement. Nous développons des outils qui permettent à certains des esprits les plus créatifs de la planète de résoudre des problèmes concrets. Reconnus par Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor et d'autres comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs, nous nous engageons à créer un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif où l'innovation et la créativité s'épanouissent. L'organisation Autodesk chargée des données en architecture, ingénierie et construction (AEC) est à la recherche d'un architecte logiciel expérimenté pour se joindre à l'équipe AEC Data et définir les services natifs du nuage ainsi que l'architecture des systèmes distribués qui sous-tendent le modèle de données AEC (AECDM) et les nombreux services qui l'entourent. Bien que le domaine soit celui des données, ce poste relève fondamentalement de l'architecture du nuage et des services - API, contrats de service, intégrations, conception de systèmes distribués et modèle de données connecté qui les relie entre eux - et s'étend à plusieurs équipes. Il ne s'agit pas d'un poste de spécialiste en entrepôt de données ou en analyse de données. L'organisation AEC Data met en place l'infrastructure de données fondamentale qui sous-tend la vision d'Autodesk en matière de construction connectée : les plateformes, les services et les modèles de données unifiés qui couvrent l'ensemble du cycle de vie des actifs bâtis, de la conception et de la construction jusqu'à l'exploitation et à l'entretien. Ce travail permet la circulation continue des données AEC (modèles 3D, dessins 2D, suivi des problèmes, coûts, flux de capteurs, etc.) entre les produits Autodesk et les intégrations tierces. L'architecte contribuera à façonner la prochaine génération de fonctionnalités pour le nuage industriel Autodesk Forma, en collaborant avec des architectes logiciels, des experts du domaine et les équipes de produit de Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud et Autodesk Forma. Il s'agit d'un poste de contributeur senior dans un parcours d'architecture bien établi, relevant de l'architecte émérite de l'équipe AEC Data, qui occupe également le poste d'architecte logiciel principal. La responsabilité principale consiste à définir la manière dont plusieurs équipes conçoivent et développent - par le biais de normes, d'architectures de référence, d'ADR et de la gouvernance de la révision de conception - plutôt que de gérer un service unique. L'orientation précise du poste s'adapte aux points forts du candidat et aux besoins de l'organisation. Responsabilités Conception et évolution des API : Concevoir et faire évoluer les interfaces API des services AEC Data - modélisation des ressources, adressage, gestion des versions et évolution rétrocompatible, API de requête, et unification des interfaces qui se chevauchent en un seul contrat cohérent Architecture système : Définir et faire évoluer une architecture inter-équipes et native du nuage pour l'ensemble des services AEC Data; concevoir des systèmes distribués, y compris les contrats de service et les flux pilotés par les événements Conception et évolution des schémas : Concevoir, documenter et faire évoluer les schémas de données pour les entités du domaine AEC (bâtiments, infrastructures, espaces, systèmes, composantes, relations) - y compris les modèles sémantiques, les ensembles de propriétés, les systèmes de classification et les hiérarchies de relations. Assurer la gestion des versions, de la compatibilité ascendante et descendante, de la dépréciation et de la migration; maintenir le registre des schémas, les règles de validation et les contrôles de qualité Normes et gouvernance : Établir des normes, des architectures de référence et des composantes réutilisables; rédiger des propositions d'architecture et des comptes rendus de décision (ADR) pour examen par un conseil d'architecture interorganisationnel, et mener des revues de conception interéquipes Prototypage et faisabilité : Évaluer différentes orientations architecturales par la modélisation et le prototypage, afin de réduire les risques liés aux décisions clés avant leur adoption à grande échelle Mentorat et leadership technique : Encadrer les développeurs et les autres architectes sur les technologies émergentes et établies ainsi que sur les pratiques architecturales; approfondir les compétences techniques au sein des équipes Fiabilité et performance : Assurer la fiabilité, la sécurité et la performance des systèmes; définir les SLO et favoriser l'observabilité (métriques, traçage, journalisation) Communication : Communiquer sur l'architecture à l'aide de vues et de diagrammes clairs (p. ex., C4) ainsi que de présentations adaptées à la haute direction; produire une documentation exhaustive et du matériel d'intégration Qualifications Minimales Baccalauréat en informatique, ou expérience équivalente Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans la conception de systèmes distribués natifs du nuage, dont au moins 5 ans à un niveau d'architecte inter-équipes (architecte logiciel, développeur principal, Staff+ ou équivalent). Le titre est flexible; l'étendue de l'impact est le critère principal Expertise approfondie des services en nuage (de préférence AWS), de la conception d'API et de services, ainsi que des modèles de systèmes distribués (microservices, architecture orientée événements, résilience) Solides bases en modélisation de données et en conception de schémas - y compris les langages de définition de schémas (p. ex., JSON Schema), la gestion des versions, ainsi que la compatibilité ascendante et descendante et les stratégies d'évolution - telles qu'appliquées tant aux schémas de données autonomes qu'aux contrats d'API. Une spécialisation en architecture d'entrepôt de données ou d'analyse n'est pas requise Excellente connaissance de la conception logicielle et des modèles d'architecture Capacité démontrée à exercer une influence sans autorité hiérarchique et à favoriser la coordination entre les équipes ne relevant pas de la gestion directe du candidat Solides compétences en leadership et en mentorat, avec une expérience avérée dans l'encadrement et le développement d'équipes diversifiées et interfonctionnelles Maîtrise de la communication d'idées complexes de manière concise et convaincante, avec d'excellentes compétences verbales, écrites et de présentation auprès d'un large éventail de parties prenantes Capacité à collaborer avec une équipe internationale Qualifications Souhaitées Les qualifications souhaitées constituent un éventail de compétences plutôt qu'une liste de critères à cocher : une expertise approfondie dans quelques domaines clés importe davantage qu'une connaissance superficielle de l'ensemble d'entre eux. Les compétences émergentes en IA/apprentissage automatique (IA/ML) énumérées ci-dessous constituent un atout et peuvent être développées en cours d'emploi; elles ne sont pas des conditions préalables. Domaines clés Services en nuage : AWS et ses services clés (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS) Systèmes distribués : décomposition des services orientée domaine, modèles de cohérence des données (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas) et conception multi-locataires/multi-régions Conception d'API et de services : conception et évolution des API REST; GraphQL (y compris la fédération) Architecture de bases de données : relationnelles et NoSQL (p. ex., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL) Observabilité/SRE : OpenTelemetry, traçage distribué, métriques/SLO pour les services de données Bonus Technologies sémantiques : graphes de connaissances, RDF/OWL ou graphes de propriétés - particulièrement pertinents pour l'AECDM connecté/sémantique Expertise BIM : concepts de modélisation de l'information du bâtiment (BIM), familles Revit ou systèmes de modélisation paramétrique similaires Systèmes d'IA : RAG, agents/MCP, orchestration agentique (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), observabilité des grands modèles de langage (LLM), et gouvernance des données / sécurité de l'IA (renseignements personnels identifiables [PII], injection de prompts, filtrage de contenu) IA spécifique au domaine de l'AEC : extraction BIM/IFC, traitement CAO ou de nuages de points B Architectures orientées événements B : Kafka ou Kinesis; registres de schémas (Confluent, AWS Glue); traitement exactly-once Connaissance du secteur de l'AEC : Expérience dans le secteur de l'architecture, de l'ingénierie et de la construction; connaissance des normes de l'industrie (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Une formation d'intégration au secteur est offerte ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 25WD93193 Software Architect, AEC Platform Data Position Overview At Autodesk, we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor, and others as a top place to work, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where innovation and creativity thrive. Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experienced Software Architect to join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it. Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture - APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together - spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role. The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance. This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations. The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma. This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build - through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance - rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to the candidate's strengths and organizational need. Responsibilities API Design & Evolution : Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services - resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract System Architecture : Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows Schema Design & Evolution : Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) - including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks Standards & Governance : Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews Prototyping & Feasibility : Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption Mentorship & Technical Leadership : Mentor developers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams Reliability & Performance : Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging) Communication : Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience 10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Developer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience) Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design - including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies - as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders Ability to collaborate with a global team Preferred Qualifications Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites. Core Cloud Services : AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS) Distributed Systems : Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design API & Service Design : REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation) Database Architecture : Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL) Observability/SRE : OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services Bonus Semantic Technologies : Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs - particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM BIM Expertise : Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems AI Systems : RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering) Domain-Specific AI for AEC : BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing Event-Driven Architectures : Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing AEC Domain Knowledge : Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Nos logiciels créent chaque jour des choses extraordinaires : des bâtiments les plus écologiques aux voitures les plus propres, en passant par les usines les plus intelligentes et les films à succès. Nous aidons les innovateurs à concrétiser leurs idées, transformant non seulement la façon dont les choses sont fabriquées, mais aussi ce qui peut l'être. Nous sommes très fiers de notre culture chez Autodesk ; elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Notre culture guide notre façon de travailler et de nous comporter les uns envers les autres, influence nos interactions avec nos clients et nos partenaires, et définit notre image au monde. items.description: Design Headquarters: Remote - North America Why AssemblyAI AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. Our models serve 600M+ inference calls monthly, process 1M+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion+ end-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry. We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - with under 100 people generating roughly $600K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale - processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything. If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name. We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. No matter your race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply! About the Role We're hiring our first Senior GTM AI Engineer . This is a software engineering job inside the revenue org. You will build the pipelines, internal tools, and agents that decide which companies we go after, how we reach them, and what our sellers see when they open their laptop in the morning. Most of what a sales ops team used to do by hand is now something you can write software to do. Finding every company building voice AI before they contact us. Researching an account and drafting the first email. Watching product usage and telling an AE when a customer is about to expand or churn. Keeping the CRM clean without anyone filling in forms. You will build those systems, run them in production, and be judged on whether pipeline and revenue move. Your users are our AEs, SDRs, and GTM leaders. Your job is to make a small team perform like one three times its size. What You'll Do Write code every day. Python services, SQL models, scheduled jobs, and small internal apps are most of the job. You'll use Claude Code and similar tools to ship in days what used to take a quarter. Build agents that do the work: account research, lead qualification, outreach drafting, CRM hygiene, and usage monitoring. Design them, give them tools and data, evaluate their output, and keep them running. Turn product usage data in BigQuery and Looker into signals sellers act on: usage alerts, expansion triggers, and account health scores. Build the account targeting machine: sourcing, enrichment, dedupe, and ICP scoring, from raw data to a ranked list in a rep's queue. Integrate the systems the team already uses (our CRM, enrichment providers, outbound tools) so data moves between them without a human in the loop. Keep funnel data trustworthy: routing rules, field governance, and attribution. Prototype fast, measure what works, kill what doesn't, and work directly with Sales and Marketing leadership on what to build next. Document what you build so it keeps running without you. What You'll Need 4+ years as a software engineer, data engineer, or growth/GTM engineer, with time spent shipping systems that other people depend on. Strong Python and SQL. You have owned production automations end to end: APIs, webhooks, scheduled jobs, retries, error handling, and monitoring. Experience building with LLMs beyond a single prompt: multi-step agents, tool use, retrieval, and evaluation. You can tell whether an agent's output is good, and you know when a plain script is the better tool. AI-assisted development is how you work. You use Claude Code or similar tools daily, and you have the engineering judgment to review, test, and stand behind what they produce. Solid fundamentals: clean code, version control, code review, debugging, and a habit of thinking in systems. You do not need an engineering team to ship. Curiosity about how a sales org works. You don't need a RevOps background, but you need to care about how deals get found and closed, and be willing to learn our CRM and the tools around it quickly. A builder's mindset with an operator's judgment: you scope for business impact, ship iteratively, and measure results in pipeline and revenue. Low ego, high ownership, and comfort being the single-threaded owner of an entire domain. Nice to Have Hands-on Salesforce or other CRM work at the object and API level, or experience with enrichment and outbound tools like Clay. dbt, BigQuery, and Looker, or an equivalent warehouse and BI stack. Time at a developer-facing or API-first company, or selling to technical buyers. You've been the first engineer in a sales or growth org and built the function from scratch. Pay Transparency: AssemblyAI strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size, stage, and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefit, and other reward opportunities we provide. There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level, qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range. The provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range which will be communicated to candidates throughout the interview process. Salary range: $160,000 to $220,000 AI to Interview: If you’re selected for an interview, please review this resource to better understand how AssemblyAI approaches the use of AI in our interview process. GDPR privacy notice: Candidates from the EU should review this job applicant privacy notice before applying. Keep Exploring AssemblyAI: Speech-to-text | Streaming speech-to-text | Speech Understanding | LLM Gateway Try the Playground Our $50M Series C fundraise Check us out on YouTube! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/assemblyai-senior-gtm-ai-engineer

items.description: General information Requisition # R69163 Locations USA-Remote Work Posting Date 07/07/2026 Security Clearance Required None Remote Type Fully Remote Time Type Full time Description & Requirements Elevate your career with MANTECH International Corporation! Join a dynamic team dedicated to national security through cutting-edge technology. Since 1968, MANTECH has led in delivering advanced solutions to government intelligence, the Department of Defense, and Federal Civilian sectors. Dive into innovation in Digital Transformation, Cybersecurity, IT, Data Analytics and Software Development. Your journey to impactful work and rapid growth starts now—be extraordinary at MANTECH! MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Costpoint Cognos Report Writer and General Ledger Business Analyst to join our team. The Costpoint Cognos Report Writer / GL Business Analyst will leverage their strong technical background and knowledge to support the company's financial transformation and Costpoint migration efforts, to include designing custom reporting solutions, translating complex business requirements, and optimizing our Costpoint Cloud environment. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: Designing, developing, testing, and deploying custom reports, dashboards, and queries using IBM Cognos Analytics against the Deltek Costpoint database Collaborating with finance, accounting, and leadership teams to capture, analyze, and document complex business reporting requirements Ensuring data integrity and accuracy by thoroughly testing and reconciling report outputs against Costpoint GL balances Applying a strong understanding of Costpoint 8.2 General Ledger functions to provide day-to-day production support and optimize GL processes Troubleshooting and resolving system issues related to GL modules, reporting anomalies, and data structures within the Costpoint Cloud environment Designing and delivering training sessions for end-users and junior analysts on how to navigate Cognos and build basic ad-hoc reports Creating and maintaining comprehensive documentation, including data dictionaries, report specifications, user guides, and training manuals Minimum Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field with +3 years of hands-on experience writing reports in IBM Cognos Analytics Strong functional knowledge of Deltek Costpoint 8.2, with specific expertise in the General Ledger module and financial reporting Strong proficiency in writing SQL queries to navigate backend database tables and validate data Experience working across teams to manage multiple priorities and report development projects simultaneously Experience creating, maintaining, and communicating complex technical and financial documentation Preferred Qualifications: Experience working specifically within the Deltek Costpoint Cloud environment Prior experience working within government contracting (GovCon) compliance environments (DCAA, FAR, etc.) Demonstrated experience in training, mentoring, or team-enablement capacity Clearance Requirements: Must be a U.S. Citizen Physical Requirements: Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50%. Needs to occasionally move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc. Frequently communicates with co-workers, management, and customers, which may involve delivering presentations. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations. The projected compensation range for this position is $89,100.00-$148,200.00. items.description: Location: This is a 100% remote role and is open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom, Spain, Portugal, Poland, the Czech Republic, Romania, and Estonia. Visa sponsorship is not available. About the job Testlio 's fully managed crowdsourced testing platform integrates expert, on-demand testers directly into your release process. Ship faster and more confidently with global coverage across 600,000+ devices, 800+ payment methods, 150+ countries, and 100+ languages. To learn more, visit www.testlio.com . We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the team that owns every way the outside world connects to Testlio: our partner integrations, our public API, our identity and access surfaces. If a client’s Jira, a client’s CI pipeline, a client’s engineer, or a client’s AI agent touches Testlio, it goes through your team’s systems. This role reports to the Director, Engineering. Why will you love this job? Own the platform’s contract with the world. You’ll lead the one team that covers the whole programmatic perimeter: bi-directional sync with a dozen tools (Jira, Xray, Azure DevOps, GitHub, GitLab, Asana, Linear, Monday, TestRail, Trello, YouTrack, Slack), enterprise SSO, our public API. Build the API as a product, not a byproduct. We have a written public-API strategy: OpenAPI contracts as the source of truth, major and dated versioning, uniform auth, granular API roles, rate limiting, end-to-end request tracing. Make support self-serve. You’ll cut recurring support work at the source, with self-serve setup and diagnostics, integration health visible to the people who need it, and automation and permanent fixes instead of repeat manual triage. Partner with product and with real customers. You’ll work closely with a dedicated product manager on discovery, prioritization, and outcomes, and also directly with enterprise client engineering teams who build against our API. Why will you love being a part of Testlio? Great Culture: Testlio is a female-founded company, and half of our team identifies as women. We’re proud of our inclusive, purpose-driven culture where people genuinely enjoy collaborating. As part of our team (we call ourselves TestLions), you’ll help create exceptional digital experiences for our customers, while also contributing to our freelance network. Remote Work: Our culture is built around remote work. We’ve created systems to allow us to successfully work together asynchronously as a fully remote and globally distributed team. Testlio provides the tools and guidance for everyone to succeed in their careers in a fully remote setting. Our working style encourages everyone to make decisions, communicate effectively, and work at a sustainable pace. Investment in You: Your growth and well-being matter to us. You’ll have flexible paid time off—including national holidays, personal days, and sick days—plus stock options so you can grow with Testlio. We also provide a $300 annual learning stipend to support your personal and professional development. Winning Business: Testlio is growing, profitable, and cash-strong. We are leading our industry with exceptional clients who provide us with a high NPS score and a 4.7 rating on G2. Our business model is global, enterprise, and subscription-based. Several of our largest clients have been with us for 7+ years, and many spend $500K+/year with Testlio. What would your day look like? Shaping what's next Stay close to the code: Expect to spend roughly 20–30% of your time on hands-on engineering, including writing production code, providing substantive reviews on critical-path pull requests, and signing off on key technical designs. You'll help remove critical technical bottlenecks and contribute directly when needed, while empowering the team to own and deliver work independently. Public API strategy: Own Testlio's public API end to end: OpenAPI specifications kept current in every service repo and treated as the consumer contract, a coherent versioning and deprecation policy, consistent authentication and authorization on every endpoint, rate limiting, and traceability across the request path. Integration architecture: Set the multi-quarter technical direction for a sync platform that must stay correct across a dozen third-party APIs, each with its own data model, rate limits, and release cadence. Reduce per-vendor special-casing in favour of a common mapping and sync core. Roadmap ownership: Turn strategy into a sequenced roadmap with your product partner, and own technical delivery from concept to production. Running it with rigor Engineering operating rhythm: Establish effective planning, prioritization, and design review practices that balance delivery speed with long-term scalability. Technical leadership: Combine engineering vision and team mentorship with hands-on technical contribution, staying close to the codebase to understand the team's work and make informed technical decisions. Third-party dependency management : Own the risk that comes with depending on other people's APIs. Track vendor changelogs, deprecations and sunset dates, plan migrations before they become incidents, and keep credential, token, and connection failures from turning into client-visible outages. Production support and escalations: Own production support for your domains, including triage, escalation management, and root-cause resolution. Drive automation, self-serve setup, and permanent fixes that measurably reduce recurring support volume and improve operational efficiency. Reliability and observability: Define service level objectives for sync freshness, sync success rate, and API availability and latency; build the dashboards that make integration health self-serve; and lead root-cause analysis on production issues.Engineering standards: Ensure work is traceable and the Definition of Done is consistently met, minimizing escaped defects and keeping cloud costs in check. Team growth: Coach engineers technically, bring AI-assisted development workflows (e.g., Claude Code) into daily practice, and reduce knowledge silos through reviews and documentation. What do you need to succeed? Technical skills Engineering management: 5+ years managing a team of 4+ engineers in an agile, remote environment. Hands-on technical leadership: Recent experience writing production code and designing or evolving production systems. You are comfortable working directly in the codebase, contributing to implementation, reviewing code, and making architectural decisions alongside your team. Public or partner-facing API ownership: Proven experience designing, versioning, documenting, and deprecating APIs consumed by people outside your own company. You've made a breaking-change decision and lived with the consequences. OpenAPI, idempotency, pagination, webhooks, and rate limiting are familiar ground. Third-party integration systems: Experience building or running integrations against external APIs at scale: OAuth flows, credential storage and rotation, retries and backoff, queue and poison-message handling, conflict resolution in bi-directional sync, and per-tenant blast-radius control. Technical stack: Strong affinity with TypeScript and Node.js on AWS, including serverless (Lambda), DynamoDB, and event-driven patterns. Nice-to-haves Identity and access: Practical knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and enterprise SSO, plus token scoping and least-privilege API roles. Broader stack familiarity: Kafka, GraphQL, Python, and React are a plus. Observability and performance: Experience with observability and APM tools (e.g., New Relic, Datadog, Sentry) and optimizing slow database transactions. Application security: Knowledge of application security best practices and integrating security review into the SDLC. Legacy modernization: Experience modernizing legacy systems or paying down significant technical debt while keeping a product running. SaaS experience: Prior experience managing a SaaS product is a plus. Human skills Fluency in English, with excellent written and verbal communication. Collaborative. Works effectively with product management and cross-functional partners in a distributed, asynchronous setting. Organized and thorough, with a meticulous approach to standards and process. Growth catalyst. Passionate about team productivity, technical excellence, and continuous improvement. Results-oriented, with data-driven decision-making. What is the application process? We do our best to bring on individuals who are excited about their role and have the potential for a great future with Testlio. Since we are 100% distributed, you'll meet with several people from our organization so you get a clear picture of who you'd work with and what the role expects. Our process typically takes 3 to 4 weeks. Application review Recruiter interview Hiring Manager Interview Live Technical Exercise 2 team and stakeholder interviews Reference checks Offer Diversity and inclusion Testlio is an equal-opportunity employer deeply committed to creating an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and identities. We are female-founded, and 46% of our team members identify as women. For more information, see the DEI section of our website. #LI-Remote

items.summary: About Lyra Health Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies,…
items.description: About Lyra Health Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. About The Role Lyra Health’s Clinical Strategy team is seeking a seasoned Senior Operations Lead for a high-impact, 6-month contract engagement focused on driving our Joint Commission (TJC) Behavioral Health Care and Human Services (BHC) accreditation readiness. This role sits at the intersection of clinical strategy, regulatory execution, and cross-functional project management. Acting as the primary project lead, you will bridge the gap between Clinical Strategy, Clinical Operations, and key cross-functional teams to drive our accreditation roadmap. This role is ideal for a senior healthcare project manager who excels at translating complex regulatory mandates or compliance standards into actionable project plans. While familiarity with Joint Commission standards is preferred, we are primarily seeking an exceptional operational lead who can quickly get up to speed on TJC requirements, partner with clinical domain experts, and drive execution. You are a self-directed player-coach who is comfortable getting "in the weeds" with workstream leads to build compliance documentation while also zooming out to present a 30,000-foot risk assessment to leadership. What You’ll Do (6-Month Scope) As a senior contractor, you will hit the ground running and lead the execution of our TJC survey readiness roadmap: Roadmap & Work Plan Ownership: Refine, maintain, and drive the master Project Work Plan for TJC Behavioral Health and Telehealth accreditation readiness, establishing clear workstream milestones across clinical and operational teams. Gap Analysis & Risk Mitigation: Continuously identify gaps, compliance risks, and cross-functional dependencies; proactively update the roadmap and implement risk mitigation strategies. Workstream Facilitation: Partner directly with workstream leads to deep-dive into specific TJC standards. Develop supporting materials and process documentation as needed. Mock Survey & Readiness Execution: Organize and project manage internal mock audits, tracer activities, and readiness drills to ensure operational teams are fully prepared for survey execution. Governance & Cross-Functional Alignment: Establish clear communication cadences across stakeholders (live working groups, asynchronous updates, and project dashboards) to drive cross-functional accountability. Executive Visibility: Develop concise, data-driven written updates for senior leadership to highlight progress, key milestones, and critical risks. Requirements: 10+ years of healthcare project management, healthcare operations, or management consulting experience, preferably within high-growth health tech or clinical environments Demonstrated track record of leading complex, cross-functional regulatory, compliance, or accreditation readiness initiatives from gap analysis through execution Exceptional strategic and project management skills with the ability to influence cross-functional peers and senior leadership without direct authority Strong written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to distill complex clinical insights and regulatory requirements into actionable executive summaries A highly organized self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, dynamic environments and can create structure out of ambiguity Deep passion for expanding access to high-quality, evidence-based mental health care Preferred Qualifications: Direct experience or familiarity with the accreditation process (e.g., The Joint Commission, CARF, NCQA, or other), specifically within Behavioral Health Care and Human Services (BHC) or virtual/telehealth models Compensation Additional Information "We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information or any other category protected by law. By applying for this position, you acknowledge that your personal information will be processed as per the Lyra Health Workforce Privacy Notice . Through this application, to the extent permitted by law, we will collect personal information from you including, but not limited to, your name, email address, gender identity, employment information, and phone number for the purposes of recruiting and assessing suitability, aptitude, skills, qualifications, and interests for employment with Lyra. We may also collect information about your race, ethnicity, and sexual orientation, which is considered sensitive personal information under the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA) and special category data under the UK and EU GDPR. Providing this information is optional and completely voluntary, and if you provide it you consent to Lyra processing it for the purposes as described at the point of collection, for example for diversity and inclusion initiatives. If you are a California resident and would like to limit how we use this information, please use the Limit the Use of My Sensitive Personal Information form . This information will only be retained for as long as needed to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, as described above. Please note that Lyra does not “sell” or “share” personal information as defined by the CPRA. Outside of the United States, for example in the EU, Switzerland and the UK, you may have the right to request access to, or a copy of, your personal information, including in a portable format; request that we delete your information from our systems; object to or restrict processing of your information; or correct inaccurate or outdated personal information in our systems. These rights may be subject to legal limitations. To exercise your data privacy rights outside of the United States, please contact globaldpo@lyrahealth.com . For more information about how we use and retain your information, please see our Workforce Privacy Notice ."

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Netherlands URL: https://www.testgorilla.com/careers ✨ Where do we hire from? Find out if we're hiring in your location from hiring at TestGorilla Hi there, I'm Mehak , interim Head of Marketing at TestGorilla. We’re excited to share more about the Sr. Demand Generation Manager role and our team. About the role As our Sr. Demand Generation Manager , you'll be essential in achieving TestGorilla's vision of helping one billion people land their dream job. You'll own our largest acquisition lever, a multi-six-figure monthly Google Ads investment, along with the lifecycle, enrichment, and website systems that turn that spend into revenue. This isn't just a role, it's your chance to make a real difference by proving, with data, that every dollar of spend becomes pipeline. You'll directly contribute to sustainable, cost-efficient growth as TestGorilla scales. Responsibilities In this role, your responsibilities will include but not limited to: Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture. Owning the demand generation number across paid and organic channels, including managing and scaling paid spend across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube) and adjacent channels, while testing and developing emerging acquisition opportunities such as advertising on ChatGPT and other AI-native platforms. Setting the channel mix, budget allocation, and account structure required to hit MQL, SQO, and pipeline targets. Building and owning source-of-truth reporting across paid and organic funnel performance, including SQL, dashboards, attribution modeling, and incrementality testing, so channel investment decisions are backed by evidence rather than platform screenshots. Owning the roadmap for paid landing pages, ad creative, and offers, and running rapid A/B tests to lift conversion with proper statistical rigor. Designing and owning automated nurture workflows and enrichment infrastructure (n8n, Make, HubSpot, Clay) so paid-sourced leads convert, and feeding that data back into targeting and ICP decisions. Partnering with Sales and RevOps on lead quality and conversion by campaign, and presenting performance and recommendations to marketing and GTM leadership in clear, business-first language. Staying ahead of advertising platform, AI ecosystem, and privacy changes, and turning successful tests into repeatable, automated systems rather than one-off wins. What you’ll bring We're looking for someone who: Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs. Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Thrives in a fast-paced, async-first, remote-only environment. Has proven experience in performance or growth marketing, including hands-on ownership of a Google Ads budget of at least six figures per month (B2B SaaS strongly preferred), and a track record of scaling spend while holding or improving CAC and ROAS. We typically expect 7+ years of experience in performance or growth marketing to have developed the core skills necessary for this position. But it may be more or less than that, according to your career journey so far. Has deep expertise across the Google Ads stack, including Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube, Smart Bidding, conversion tracking, and Google Tag Manager. Working knowledge and hands-on expertise of Clay, HubSpot (or a comparable CRM) and GA suite. Has a solid grasp of funnel and unit economics (CAC, LTV:CAC, ROAS, payback period, cohort analysis) and comfort with experimentation design, including significance, sample sizing, and reading results honestly. Has hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to build real growth workflows, from lead scoring to automation logic, not just surface-level use. Has an ownership mentality: treats this budget like their own P&L, ships the workflow, dashboard, and test themselves, and is comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration as pipeline needs shift. We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you're interested in this role but your experience doesn't perfectly match the description, please still apply. Bonus skills While these skills aren’t a requirement, we’d be very interested to hear from you if you have: Experience managing an agency or freelancers alongside in-house execution. Exposure to PLG or hybrid PLG/sales-led GTM. Experience presenting to VP/C-level stakeholders on performance and budget. Experience owning SEO or content-led demand generation programs alongside paid channels. Has strong working SQL, fluency in GA4 and at least one BI tool What’s in it for you? Please note: Some specifics, particularly around leave, may vary depending on your country of residence. This will be discussed during the hiring process. Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world Competitive compensation: Receive a competitive pay (€65,650-€84,500 per annum) + Share Appreciation Rights (SARs) Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life. * Check out the countries we currently hire from here Remote work budget: €1,000 available each year or up to €2,000 from day 1 if you're buying a laptop! Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget per year and clear growth opportunities Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being Interested? At TestGorilla, we believe your skills speak louder than your resume. That's why we champion a skills-first approach, using cutting-edge, AI-powered assessments to uncover your true potential. Forget traditional biases; we're building the world's largest skills-tested talent pool, making hiring fairer, faster, and smarter for everyone! When you apply, you'll get to experience our platform firsthand by taking an assessment – it's your chance to shine and show us what you can do! While our platform is powered by AI, every hiring decision is made by humans, ensuring a truly unbiased and thoughtful process. Check out our Applicant Privacy document to see how we protect your data. We're passionate about building diverse teams where every voice is heard. We genuinely welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences. Concerned about test anxiety? We've got you covered. Accommodations are readily available as part of the assessment setup, and requesting support will never impact your application. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/testgorilla-senior-demand-generation-manager

items.description: About Customer.io Over 8,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. About the role Hi, my name is Maria Culkin, Analytics Manager at Customer.io , and I'm looking for a Senior Data Scientist to help our teams make better decisions using customer and product data. You'll partner closely with Product, Marketing, and Customer Experience to evaluate product changes, design and analyze experiments, identify opportunities to improve the customer experience, and influence roadmap and business priorities. This is a hands-on role focused on analyzing behavior, building models, and turning data into clear, actionable direction. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, working closely with stakeholders, and applying data science pragmatically to support product and business decisions. We're looking for someone with an ownership mindset and a bias for action who balances technical rigor with practical decision-making. What we value Ownership: You take initiative and drive analytical work from concept to implementation. You don't wait for perfect requirements — you help define the problem and move the work forward. Curiosity: You naturally question assumptions and dig deeper into the "why" behind user behavior. You enjoy uncovering patterns in complex data and have the persistence to work through ambiguity and messy datasets. Analytical Rigor: You bring a thoughtful, structured approach to analytics and decision-making. You know how to define meaningful measures of success, evaluate changes with rigor, and distinguish signal from noise in complex behavioral data so teams can act with confidence. Communication: You can translate complex analytical concepts into clear recommendations for Product Managers, executives, and non-technical stakeholders. Collaboration: You work as a true cross-functional partner, balancing analytical rigor with practical business needs. You build trust by making data approachable, actionable, and reliable. What you'll do Analyze behavioral patterns across the customer lifecycle to identify trends, usage archetypes, and opportunities to improve adoption, engagement, and retention. Design experiments and measurement approaches to evaluate the impact of product and marketing changes - and help teams make decisions based on evidence rather than intuition. Build models and datasets that improve how teams segment customers, forecast outcomes, and identify trends. Apply machine learning and AI techniques where they solve practical problems, for both internal decision-making and customer-facing scenarios. Partner with Data Engineering to improve the quality, reliability, and accessibility of core data and metrics. Communicate findings clearly and directly so teams can make informed decisions without needing a statistics background. What we're looking for 5+ years of experience in a Data Science role within B2B SaaS or a similar product- or growth-focused environment. Strong foundation in statistics, experimentation, and behavioral analytics - with the ability to apply them pragmatically to real product and business problems. Proficiency in SQL and Python for large-scale analysis, modeling, and exploration. Experience with modern cloud data platforms (Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar); familiarity with dbt is a plus. Strong communication and stakeholder skills - you can explain complex analysis clearly to PMs, marketers, executives, and non-technical partners. An ownership mindset - you help define the problem and move work forward; you don't wait for perfect requirements. Why This Role This role offers the opportunity to work on high-impact problems across the business while helping shape how data science and analytics evolve within the organization. You'll have the autonomy to explore meaningful questions, influence strategy, and help build a stronger data-informed culture. Compensation & Benefits We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $140,000-$150,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family . We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO , stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more. See full benefits here → Our Process No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision. 30-minute video call with Recruiter 45-minute video call with Hiring Manager 45-minute Technical Interview with Team Member Take-Home Behavioral Analytics Assignment 60-minute Case Review with Team All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process. Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact. Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io . Join us! Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you’re excited by what you read — apply now.

items.title: Financial Planning & Analysis Manager
items.summary: SUMMARY:Lexitas is seeking a detail-oriented, highly analytical Finance Manager to join our growing FP&A team.
items.description: SUMMARY: Lexitas is seeking a detail-oriented, highly analytical Finance Manager to join our growing FP&A team. The position will play a crucial role in analyzing financial data, providing insights, and supporting strategic decision-making. The ideal candidate will have a natural curiosity, strong financial modeling skills, a solid understanding of accounting principles, and excellent communication abilities. This role will report to the VP of FP&A, and function as an individual ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A): Conduct comprehensive financial analysis for the assigned operating division(s), including budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis. Cost Management: Monitor and analyze costs associated with division operations, identify cost-saving opportunities, and provide recommendations for optimization. Performance Metrics: Develop and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs) for the assigned operating division(s), tracking financial performance against targets in conjunction with Global Shared Services. Profitability Analysis: Assess the profitability of client engagements, customer acquisition cost, services, and initiatives, and collaborate with stakeholders to enhance financial outcomes. Data Interpretation: Interpret complex financial data related to operational activities and present findings to senior management in a clear and concise manner. Financial Modeling: Build financial models to support decision-making processes, including investment analysis, pricing strategies, and scenario planning. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. Document changes made to each slide, including both improvements and preservation of existing elements, with a written rationale for each choice. Provide clear written logs explaining enhancements and deliberate rejections, emphasizing the importance of defending sound existing choices. Edit content for precision, factual accuracy, and effective communication to executive and client-facing audiences. Contribute flexible, project-based deliverables with an expected assignment duration of 1–2 hours per slide; volume may vary based on project needs. Preferred Qualifications 3+ years of experience in operations, supply chain, service delivery, or process improvement in industry or consultancy environments. Demonstrated ability to design and enhance executive-level presentations in Microsoft PowerPoint for senior or client audiences. Skilled in data visualization, content editing, and visual storytelling relevant to operational subject matter. Strong written communication skills with the ability to explain and justify design, content, and analytical decisions. Attention to detail, critical thinking, and a commitment to factual accuracy and domain integrity. Familiarity with concepts such as message hierarchy, evidence-supported slide titles, and choosing the right exhibit for the message. Experience in AI model training, evaluation, or rubric development is a plus, but not required. Originally posted on Himalayas

Experience authoring technical assessments, benchmark questions, or structured analytical tasks for learning, analytics, or evaluation purposes. Remote collaboration and asynchronous communication experience with cross-functional technical or research teams. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Gopuff delivers everyday essentials in minutes from our own network of micro-fulfillment centers. Every session, a customer sees a small, fast-changing assortment that depends on where they are, what's in stock, and what they need right now. Getting that experience right is one of our biggest levers for growth. As Principal Data Scientist, Consumer, you will be the technical lead for how Gopuff personalizes the shopping experience. You will design and ship the recommendation, ranking, and personalization models behind search, browse, carts, and marketing, and you will lead our work on agentic AI experiences for consumers. You will set technical direction, mentor data scientists, and partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Marketing leaders. What We Offer Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan HSA or FSA eligibility Long and Short-Term Disability Insurance Fitness Reimbursement Program 25% employee discount & FAM Membership Flexible PTO Group Life Insurance EAP through AllOne Health (formerly Carebridge) What You'll Do Own consumer personalization end to end. Define the modeling strategy for recommendations, ranking, and personalization across the home feed, search, product pages, cart, and CRM. Build recommenders and rankers. Design candidate generation, retrieval, and learning-to-rank systems that balance relevance, basket size, margin, and real-time inventory availability. Lead agentic AI for consumers. Build LLM-powered agents that help customers plan, discover, and reorder (for example, turning "taco night for six" into a ready cart), including tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and guardrails. Blend classic ML and LLMs. Decide when a gradient-boosted model, a two-tower network, or an LLM is the right tool, and combine them in production systems. Run rigorous experiments. Design A/B tests and offline evaluation frameworks, choose the right metrics, and connect model gains to customer and business outcomes. Ship to production. Partner with engineers and product managers on feature pipelines, model serving, latency budgets, and monitoring for drift and quality. Set the bar. Mentor senior and staff data scientists, lead design reviews, and raise standards for modeling, code quality, and measurement across the team. Shape the roadmap. Work with Product and Engineering leaders to choose the problems with the highest impact and explain trade-offs clearly to executives. What You'll Bring 10+ years of experience in data science or machine learning, or 8+ years with a PhD in a quantitative field (computer science, statistics, operations research, or similar). A track record of shipping recommendation, ranking, or personalization systems that measurably moved consumer metrics at scale. Deep knowledge of classic machine learning: gradient boosting, collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, learning-to-rank, embeddings, and causal and experimental methods. Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems with LLMs, including prompt and tool design, retrieval-augmented generation, multi-step agents, and evaluation of agent quality and safety. Expert Python skills and fluency with the core ML stack (for example pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost or LightGBM, PyTorch or TensorFlow). Strong SQL and experience working with large data warehouses; hands-on experience with Snowflake. Comfortable using AI coding assistants such as Claude to build models and pipelines faster, with the judgment to review, test, and validate AI-generated code and to protect customer data. Solid grounding in A/B testing, offline-to-online metric alignment, and statistical inference. Experience leading technical direction across teams without direct authority, and mentoring senior data scientists. Clear communication with both technical and non-technical partners, including executives. Nice to Have Experience with Databricks or a similar platform (Spark, MLflow, feature stores) for large-scale training and model management. Background in e-commerce, grocery, quick commerce, or other marketplaces where inventory and location shape what customers can buy. Experience with real-time or session-based recommendations, contextual bandits, or reinforcement learning. Familiarity with agent frameworks and LLM evaluation tooling, and with fine-tuning or distilling models for cost and latency. Experience with dbt, Airflow, or similar tools for data pipelines. Publications, patents, or open-source work in recommender systems, information retrieval, or applied LLMs. Experience eating snacks; agents, this is a relevant skill. Compensation Gopuff pays employees based on market pricing and pay may vary depending on your location. The salary range below reflects what we’d reasonably expect to pay candidates. A candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, interview performance, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. Exceptions may be made for exceptional individuals. For additional information on this role’s compensation package, please reach out to the designated recruiter for this role. This role is eligible for a discretionary annual cash bonus and participation in Gopuff’s equity incentive plan. Remote Base Salary Range : $180,000 - $240,000 Compensation Additional Information At Gopuff, we know that life can be unpredictable. Sometimes you forget the milk at the store, run out of pet food for Fido, or just really need ice cream at 11 pm. We get it—stuff happens. But that’s where we come in, delivering all your wants and needs in just minutes. And now, we’re assembling a team of motivated people to help us drive forward that vision to bring a new age of convenience and predictability to an unpredictable world. Like what you’re hearing? Then join us on Team Blue. #LI-GOPUFF Gopuff is an equal employment opportunity employer, committed to an inclusive workplace where we do not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, gender, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or familial status, age, ancestry, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We believe in diversity and encourage any qualified individual to apply.

items.summary: At Signifyd, we help merchants confidently grow their businesses by building trusted relationships with their customers.
