items.description: Role: Global Business Development Manager Location: Remote (Applicable only for Global candidates) Who You Are You are a commercially focused business development professional with UK and global student recruitment expertise, strong agent networks, CRM experience, and a proven ability to lead teams and drive growth. About Us Regent College London is a leading independent higher education provider, offering flexible and inclusive learning across multiple London campuses. We are student-focused, digitally forward, and committed to academic excellence. The Role Lead UK and global student recruitment by managing agent partnerships, developing new business, improving conversion and compliance, and supporting teams to achieve growth targets. Key Responsibilities 1. Key Activities and Responsibilities Report management – ensuring that daily reports are up to date and sent out to all partners/agents daily or until the SLA set with partner. Manage between 12-18 agent/accounts and ensure they are meeting expectations and are providing the quality of learners that is expected. Identifying potential new agents/accounts/businesses to further develop UKBDL and UKDL student recruitment and any other global remit. Managing junior business development executives and supporting teams – Ensuring their activities support the objectives of student recruitment. Providing a smooth journey for both the agent/account and students, ensuring the application process is efficient to support improved conversion. This can include getting feedback from relevant parties to continuously improve processes. Have a detailed understanding of all systems used by both agents and students to ensure advice and guidance in this area is clear Ensuring KPI’s set by the Head of Business Development are met. This includes delivery of targets set via agents/account, onboarding new business, improving conversion rate from application to enrolment, and improving brand awareness in existing and new markets. Proactively support all colleagues in pursuit of the University’s central objectives and values within the business at all levels. Gathering intelligence and data to propose new initiative to further develop new and existing UK and global opportunities. This will include – interpreting of data, and articulating key messages, and publishing papers for relevant committees. Ensure that the University’s reputation is protected by getting all agents/accounts to adhere to the University’s processes and acting with integrity internally and externally. Part of this to ensure existing and new agents/businesses recommended have a good track record in HE Adhere to the universities admissions processes and regulations ensuring a clear audit trail for training and compliance purposes. Ensuring all students recruited through agent meets the required levels of progression/AU benchmark, this will include the continuous auditing of students referred via agents. 2. Analysis and Reporting Identify gaps or shortfalls in recruitment strategies and identifying how to solve these issues. Analyse data/statistics, interpreting and reporting patterns and trends and highlighting and prioritising any issues for further investigation to support informed decision making. Provide daily reports on student activity to agents and partners. Provide reports and updates to key commercial leads within the business. Analysing agent performance not only from a recruitment perceptive but from a student engagement perceptive as well. 3. Customer/Service Support Provide advice to peers and partners to respond and independently resolve a range of standard and unforeseen issues, within pre-determined operational limits. Support and lead Business development Executives, support teams, and other relevant departments. Advise and update the team on regulatory/compliance/product/process changes providing appropriate training as needed. Ensuring the partner/agent is receiving the best support and is being provide the best service to the standard the University requires. Diagnose and rectify any problems with sales processes and systems. Feedback to the agents/ Partners on performance of students. Planning and organising Plan and organise own activities to ensure that routine operations and ongoing KPI’s deadlines are continuously met. Support in the development of team structures. Prepare a plan agent/partner training both face to face and online. Ensuring SLA’s are met and that partners are happy with service being provided. Participate in or co-ordinate student recruitment projects or development activities. Make recommendations about resource planning. 5. Liaison Communicate and build working relationships with agents/partners to ensure they are happy with the service being provided and that they grow within the business. Attend meetings, as requested by manager, to support departmental activities and to report back on main discussion points. Liaising with key stakeholders, such as admissions, quality assurance and student support. Regular communication with the Business Development Team, providing feedback on Agent documents that are being submitted. 6. Continuous Improvement Advise on and propose changes in procedures, planning and systems to improve operational efficiency to improve quality of service in student recruitment. Keep skills up to date and develop depth or breadth of knowledge in student recruitment practice by learning from colleagues and exposure to a range of activities, training and networking opportunities. Continuing to improve conversion rate and enrolled numbers coming from each partner. Make recommendations on how to improve the University’s brand and make it more commercially attractive. Look at ways of improving current processes, especially when looking at growth within the team and recruitment numbers. 7. People Management Co-operate with other colleagues (either individually or in a team setting) to contribute to the achievement of departmental objectives. Train and develop junior staff members, and ensure direct reports are performing their duties and meeting their KPI’s. Managing the agent/partnership relationships, ensuring they are clear on all admissions procedures and are meeting their quality requirements. Show sensitivity and consideration and emotional support to other people’s/student’s needs and feelings, which often include dealing with signs of obvious distress. Dealing with culture differences, for example when dealing with overseas staff remember they may be used to a different working environment than we are in the UK or other global countries Deliver guidance and support in a calm, discreet, diplomatic and professional manner. Support agents/partners and provide referral and signposting pathways for students in crisis to internal and external support function and organisations. 8. Personal and Professional Development and Training Identify and address development needs to ensure continuing professional development. Communicate and share best practice. Proactively identify new opportunities and work with management to develop solutions. Work in accordance with the University’s Values Framework. Maintain strong empathy for the university's commitment to equality of opportunity and equality of treatment for colleagues and students. 9. Other Responsibilities Any other duties as appropriate to seniority and role. The post-holder will be required occasionally to travel to other locations for meetings or training. Attendance at appropriate internal working parties as required. To always ensure the University’s name and brand is never brought into doubt and that externally we are seen as professional and a pleasure to work with. Essential: Analyse market data and trends, to assist and advise faculties, departments and senior management within the University on the development of UK and global recruitment strategies, new programmes, or policies on UK activities where appropriate. Liaise and engage with key stakeholders and internal and external contractors to influence opinion, delivery and reputation of services. Influence and contribute to the scoping and resource planning across a range of activities at operational level to meet organisational objectives, including contributing to business plans and strategy documents where required. Implement processes to manage the integrity and security of all commercially and professionally sensitive and personal data. Analysis & problem-solving capability Well-developed written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal skills Ability to manage partners expectations and provide training sessions to ensure quality Ability to prioritise tasks and delegate tasks to direct reports. Represent the University at education expositions, Universities, schools, and colleges, as a University Influencing Senior Colleagues/external partners. Develop external relations, identify and develop opportunities for communities of practice, employers, alumni and donors via extra-curricular activities and increased levels of participation with a view to positively impact student recruitment. Build and sustain an influential network of contacts both internally and externally to influence and promote reputation, including relevant education institutions, Embassies, Consulates and sponsorship bodies. Keep well informed about the University in all relevant aspects of its work through engagement with relevant committees, attendance at workshops and events, and networking with University colleagues. This will include submit committee papers helping to aid UK recruitment. In collaboration with finance business partners create business cases to validate commercial opportunities for the university Contribute to operational leadership teams and decision making to shape the nature and level of support services. Provide expert professional subject and/or managerial expertise at an operational level to support UK/Domestic student recruitment, including achievement of UK/Domestic student application targets, increasing the quality of the student intake, increasing conversion rates from application to registration, and increasing diversity in terms of ethnicity, subject of study and recruitment from under represented community groups. Experience of working with complex sales processes and CRM software Experience of working/responding independently and dealing with unforeseen problems and circumstances Comprehensive knowledge of the work practices, processes, and procedures relevant to the role. Clear understanding of the standards and regulations set for the conduct and output for the role. Understanding of the activities of other areas of the University relevant to the student recruitment function. Experience in successfully managing partners/ agents. Experience pulling reports and providing them to key stakeholders. Ability to analyse reports and sales figures to identify trends within the agent market, and share/articulate intelligence to drive change. Desirable: Extensive UK and global network including agents, institutions (i.e. British Council, QS, local education ministries, etc) Post Grad/PhD (or candidature), Previous account management experience. Working Hours & Flexibility 40 hours per week 100% Remote - Working from any other country apart from UK Compliance Statement Successful applicants will be required to complete pre-employment checks, including a criminal records check, two references, ID and Right to Work verification, and education confirmation. items.description: ABOUT OUTRIGHT INTERNATIONAL Founded in 1990, Outright International strives to help lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, intersex, and queer (LGBTIQ) people live safer, healthier, and more empowered lives worldwide. With staff in 18 countries and global headquarters in New York City, Outright documents human rights violations, helps resource LGBTIQ movements and allies, and advocates for the rights of LGBTIQ people. Reporting to the Senior Director of Global Programs and Grantmaking, the Program Manager will manage the program's implementation across its target regions, serving as the primary link between Outright's leadership, regional program staff, and in-country partners to ensure the program is delivered in a locally owned, demand-driven, and donor-compliant manner. Key Responsibilities Program Oversight and Implementation Lead day-to-day management of a large, multi-country grant portfolio, ensuring activities align with donor requirements and organizational strategy Coordinate across regional program staff to ensure coherent implementation in high-risk, conflict-affected, and restrictive operating environments Oversee program inception phase, including finalization of Theory of Change, MEL plan, and capacity strengthening plans with in-country partners Partner Management Manage relationships with a diverse portfolio of in-country partner organizations, including selection, risk assessment, and reassessment processes Oversee co-design and rollout of individualized capacity strengthening plans with partners, ensuring demand-driven and participatory approaches Support flexible, partner-led financing mechanisms including emergency, programmatic, and organizational development funding Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning Coordinate participatory MEL processes with partners, including outcome mapping, baselines, and qualitative assessment tools in close cooperation with Outright´s MEL team Track programmatic and contextual risk registers, escalating significant shifts and coordinating adaptive management responses Liaise with external MEL consultants and support donor-led baseline and mid-term evaluation processes Risk and Safeguarding Monitor evolving political, security, and civic-space risks across the program's regions and adjust implementation accordingly Ensure safeguarding standards (including SEAH prevention) are upheld across all partner relationships Coordinate risk-sharing arrangements and contingency planning with partners and internal compliance teams Advocacy Coordination Support in-country partners' engagement with regional and multilateral human rights mechanisms Coordinate logistics and strategic input for partner participation in international convenings and advocacy weeks Ensure advocacy priorities remain demand-driven and reflect partner-identified needs Compliance and Reporting Ensure adherence to donor financial and narrative reporting requirements across all in-country partners Coordinate with finance and grants teams on disbursement schedules, compliance checks, and sanctions screening Prepare consolidated narrative and financial reports for donor submission Qualifications Significant experience managing complex, multi-country grants in the human rights, LGBTIQ+ rights, or international development sector Demonstrated experience working with civil society partners in restrictive, high-risk, or conflict-affected contexts Strong understanding of grantmaking, localization principles, and partner-led program design Experience with MEL frameworks, particularly outcome mapping or similar qualitative approaches Familiarity with donor compliance requirements (e.g., government or multilateral funding instruments) Cultural competency and sensitivity to SOGIESC dynamics and intersectional analysis Willingness to travel to program regions as security conditions allow Language skills relevant to program regions are considered an asset. English and Spanish are mandatory. How to Apply Interested candidates should applyvia BambooHR at this link. ( Outright is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. People of color, people who are transgender, intersex, or gender-variant, and individuals originally from the Global South are strongly encouraged to apply. Only qualified candidates will be contacted. Please do not call. Originally posted on Himalayas

The Economic Security Project (ESP) is seeking a Long Term Care (LTC) Fellow to build out a new body of work situating long-term care within ESP’s broader affordability agenda. This is a half-time, two-year fellowship, estimated 20 hours a week of work, for someone who wants to develop original policy research and help shape a growing area of ESP’s platform. The Fellow will map the long-term care policy landscape, author a flagship policy paper connecting LTC to ESP’s affordability framework, and help integrate long-term care into existing campaigns. They will help advise ESP on important matters related to LTC and work to build LTC into the current landscape of economic priorities. Over the course of the fellowship, the Fellow will build relationships with coalition partners, contribute to a major convening on long-term care and the health reform fight, and produce a second, campaign-facing research product in year two. Responsibilities Research and write a flagship policy paper situating long-term care within ESP's affordability framework, with actionable policy recommendations Support development of ESP's health care platform, including policy memos, briefs, and talking points that integrate long-term care into ESP's broader health reform arguments Represent ESP in relevant coalition spaces, including the Affordability Campaigns Collaborative and other priority external tables, and build new coalition partnerships Help represent and support ESP when it comes to amplifying LTC in the popular discussion, whether that’s op-eds, social media, interviews with reporters, and more. Help plan and execute a major convening (year two) bringing together long-term care policy experts, health reform advocates, and policymakers Author a second campaign-facing research product or policy brief in year two, building on research produced in year one Logistics Commitment: 50% time (part-time), for a two-year term Compensation: $80,000/year Benefits: This is a contract position without access to benefits Location: Remote Reports to: Shafeka Hashash, Director of Cash Initiatives Requirements Experience and Qualifications Requirements Graduate degree or equivalent knowledge and experience in a relevant field (e.g., economics, law, sociology, public policy) 3-10 years of experience in policy research, analysis, or advocacy, ideally touching health care, long-term care, aging policy, and/or economic security Strong analytical and writing skills, with the ability to translate research into clear, persuasive material for policy and public audiences Comfort engaging directly with coalition partners, advocacy organizations, and policymakers Self-directed and able to manage a multi-year research project with minimal day-to-day oversight, given the part-time nature of the role Familiarity with Medicaid, Medicare, and/or long-term care policy To Apply Send a resume and one-page cover letter to . IMPORTANT: This role can only be applied for via email at . Do not submit an application through this form or through other job board websites (e.g., LinkedIn Jobs, Indeed, ZipRecruiter, etc.). Highlights ESP is seeking a Long Term Care Fellow to develop original policy research and help shape a growing area of its affordability agenda. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Role Title: Adolescent/Child Safeguarding & Exploitation Specialist Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Adolescent/Child Safeguarding & Exploitation Specialists to contribute to a customer's project focused on assessing sexual safety and exploitation risk in adolescent scenarios. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. Scope of Work Review complex adolescent cases to assess sexual safety and exploitation (CSE/CSA) risks. Produce clear, defensible written safeguarding guidance suitable for non-specialists. Apply recognised risk-assessment and safeguarding frameworks to evaluate urgency and appropriate interventions. Identify indicators of grooming, coercion, and exploitation within nuanced case details. Recommend protective actions and escalation pathways, including when mandatory reporting is warranted. Utilise a trauma-informed lens, weighing developmental, capacity, and consent factors in each assessment. Benchmark your clinical judgments against peer standards and established protocols to ensure guidance accuracy and reliability. Preferred Qualifications 3–5+ years post-qualification experience in child safeguarding, adolescent-protection, or relevant clinical roles. Specialty background in child protection, forensic child/adolescent psychiatry or psychology, or paediatric medicine with a safeguarding remit. Active clinical license or registration in good standing. Current or recent (within the last two years) adolescent caseload or safeguarding practice. Demonstrated expertise in CSE/CSA risk assessment and mandatory-reporting requirements. Strong skills in trauma-informed practice and documentation. Exceptional written communication in research-grade English (native, or IELTS 7.5+/writing 7.0+, TOEFL 100+, Cambridge C1–C2, or equivalent). Experience in a designated safeguarding or expert-witness capacity, and familiarity with ACEs and trauma frameworks, is a plus. Start Timeline & Availability We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24 – 48 hours of completing onboarding. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: External Communications Strategist
items.summary: Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference?
items.description: Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference? Make an impact. Join PMI. How will you make a difference to PMI? The External Communications Strategist III is an execution-first, senior individual contributor responsible for driving earned media opportunities and narrative enablement in support of PMI’s corporate reputation, thought leadership, and strategic priorities. This role sits within the PR + Communications team and operates with a high degree of autonomy, judgment, and ownership. As a Level III individual contributor, this role is expected to operate as a trusted advisor within Communications—anticipating opportunities, identifying risks, and independently driving work forward while ensuring alignment to broader narrative and reputational priorities. You will provide strategic counsel to senior stakeholders on external narrative direction, message discipline, and reputational considerations, and recommend narrative adjustments based on trends, current events, and performance insights. What you’ll bring to the role: Earned Media Strategy & Agency Partnership Collaborate with PR agency to identify story opportunities and develop timely, compelling pitch angles aligned to priority narrative beats for both B2B and consumer audiences. Maximize PR agency performance helping to sharpen briefs, challenge thinking, and ensure proactive, high-quality execution against PMI’s strategic communications goals. Partner with PR agency (and consult with internal stakeholders, including regional and functional leads) on developing strategy and positioning for global media house moments. Partner with the broader Marketing organization to source appropriate community or executive spokespeople; vet, prepare, and align them for earned media pitching and engagements. Use media intelligence and performance insights (e.g., message pull-through, tier-1 quality, topic traction) to identify narrative opportunities and gaps, and to refine story angles and pitching strategy. Shape earned media strategies that strengthen PMI’s discoverability and influence in search and AI-driven answer environments, ensuring coverage reinforces desired brand perception, priority narratives, and authoritative topic associations. Earned & Sponsored External Opportunities Independently or collaboratively identify and execute strategic earned opportunities for PMI executives or community spokespeople to reach unaware or new audiences (e.g., third-party events, podcasts, partner activations, key account–adjacent moments). Partner with PR agency and relevant internal teams to evaluate, secure, and execute selective sponsored opportunities (e.g., panels, conferences, tentpole events) that advance PMI’s narratives and reputational goals. Assess external opportunities for narrative fit, audience value, and reputational considerations; recommend go/no-go decisions and execute approved engagements end-to-end. Identify and shape thought leadership platforms (e.g., executive bylines, strategic reports, high-impact forums, and selective partnerships) that reinforce priority narratives and differentiate PMI’s point of view. Narrative Ownership & Enablement Lead efforts for defined corporate message houses, including maintenance of current proof points, examples, and data, ensuring they reflect evolving business priorities and external context. Own external narrative governance for assigned topics (message architecture, claims/proof points, and executive-ready guidance), ensuring consistency across earned media, executive platforms, and thought leadership moments. Define what is included in narrative-specific enablement kits (e.g., message houses, executive-ready slides, talk tracks, FAQs, supporting materials) and proactively distribute to internal stakeholders and executives ahead of external opportunities. Maintain and refresh enablement kits on a regular cadence; communicate updates clearly and ensure adoption across PR, Marketing, and regional teams. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Judgment Work closely with Director of PR & Communications, Marketing, regional teams, and agency partners to ensure narrative consistency and executional excellence across external touchpoints. Influence senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners to align on narrative, timing, and external positioning—often without direct authority—and deliver clear recommendations (including go/no-go) in ambiguous, high-visibility situations. Maintain issues readiness for assigned narratives, including rapid response positioning, Q&A, and escalation recommendations in reputationally sensitive moments. Navigate nuanced, high-visibility topics with maturity and discretion; identify risks early (misalignment, gaps, timing, tone) and recommend solutions. Independently manage multiple workstreams and deadlines; maintain clear tracking of opportunities, deliverables, approvals, and outcomes. Role Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Public Relations, or related field (or equivalent experience). 8-10+ years of experience in corporate communications, PR, or earned media–focused roles. Demonstrated experience partnering with and managing PR agencies to drive earned media outcomes. Proven track record of developing and executing proactive earned media or external engagement strategies tied to corporate narratives. Experience operating with senior-level autonomy and judgment in complex, matrixed organizations. Strong earned media instincts with the ability to translate narrative strategy into executable story angles. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to distill complex topics into clear, compelling messages. High judgment and discretion; comfortable operating in reputationally sensitive areas. Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills. Highly organized, self-directed operator with strong prioritization and follow-through. Ability to anticipate needs, proactively identify opportunities, and execute with minimal oversight. Stakeholder management is paramount; ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment on narrative direction and recommendations. Strategic, analytical mindset with the ability to use insights and reporting to optimize external communications strategy and outcomes. Proficiency in the business language for PMI (English). Possible travel up to 5% What you can expect from us We value and nurture an environment of inclusivity and diversity, and a culture of communication and collaboration. Your health, safety and well-being come first, and we believe that you should have time for your work, but you should also have time for you.. Join us and you’ll get: an excellent total package, with compensation and benefits based upon your geographic location. skill development opportunities, to help you grow now and into the future. access to a global network, to enrich your professional experience. flexible options to help balance work time and your time award and bonus opportunities. The salary offer will be based on several factors, including the candidate’s demonstrated skills, qualifications and relevant experience. Let’s help make the world work better for everyone. Apply today! Project Management Institute, Inc. is committed to providing equal employment opportunities without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. items.description: About Us Mighty Networks helps people and brands build communities, online courses, memberships, challenges, and events. Through its advanced technology, called people magic, Mighty helps the members of those networks build relationships with each other by surfacing the most relevant and interesting connections. Because of this novel approach and member-centered experience, Mighty has produced the most $1M communities and helped its Hosts earn over $500M. The Role As a Community Strategist, you’ll work with our premium Mighty Pro customers to help them create deeply engaging community experiences that lead to powerful outcomes. You will lead workshops, co-create launch strategies, and shape the early member experience for some of the world’s boldest and most influential Hosts. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in both structured systems and creative problem-solving, and is excited to model excellence, mentor peers, and scale success through repeatable frameworks. What You'll Do Serve as a strategic partner to new Mighty Pro Hosts during their onboarding phase as they set up their Network in the way that leads to maximum member adoption, engagement, and retention. Facilitate impactful workshops with Hosts and their teams that establish strong foundations in community design, content cadence, and engagement strategy. Deliver targeted training on feature utilization, member onboarding flows, and tactical programming to drive adoption, activation, and retention. Provide creative input and feedback on brand elements like landing pages, welcome experiences, email sequences, and network messaging to ensure a cohesive and compelling member journey. Own the development and delivery of strategic Community Design Plans—including network architecture, monthly themes, onboarding flows, and launch programming calendars. Collaborate closely with Launch Specialists and Implementation teams, providing timely information and handling lightweight setup tasks directly where appropriate. Ensure clarity, consistency, and excellence in the execution of space configuration, access structure, and end-to-end member experience. Maintain regular updates to internal stakeholders on Host performance, needs, risks, and outcomes—contributing to visibility and cross-functional alignment. Contribute to shared knowledge across the Customer Success team by capturing and scaling best practices, identifying emerging trends, and improving playbooks. What We're Looking For 6+ years of client-facing experience, ideally working with strategic accounts or supporting 5–6 figure engagements in a SaaS, media, or creator-focused business. 2+ years experience in a consulting, business coaching, or agency role. Strategic thinker and tactical executor—you can map out long-term plans, define metrics for success, and follow through on details to deliver. Deep understanding of community-building and digital member experiences; you’re passionate about helping others create belonging at scale. Excellent communicator and facilitator, with confidence in guiding executive teams through planning, decision-making, and feedback cycles. Master of meetings—you show up with a plan, gather input with nuance, read the room, and close with clear decisions and next steps. Adaptable and proactive, energized by growth and ambiguity, and always seeking ways to streamline and improve. Highly collaborative and cross-functional, thriving when working across CS, Implementation, Product, and Strategy to elevate outcomes. Radically curious, with a growth mindset and drive to keep learning about Hosts, their businesses, and how digital communities are evolving. What We Offer A dynamic, remote-first work culture that values creativity, autonomy, and bold thinking. Comprehensive benefits, including health, vision, dental, and generous paid time off. Clear opportunities for professional growth, including leadership pathways and skill development support. The chance to shape the future of how communities, creators, and brands thrive online—with the team that’s building what’s next. Join us in shaping the future of community-driven digital businesses with Mighty Pro! Compensation: The base salary for this role ranges from $80,000–$145,000, with exact compensation based on location, experience, and cost of living. Originally posted on Himalayas

You will then move to an On-Target Earnings model of up to $20 USD per hour, linked to agreed service and performance measures. Payment is made monthly, directly to your PayPal. We do not withhold any earnings for any regulatory requirement. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: NYC or Remote (EST or CST) About the role: Hex’s legal function has gone from zero to a fully operating system in under a year. Now we need someone to own and scale the operating layer so it holds as the company grows. This is a builder role. You’ll run contract operations end to end: CLM administration, workflow optimization, template and playbook maintenance, enablement and training for the revenue team, and first-pass review and redlining of standard agreements against our playbook. Beyond contracts, you’ll build structured intake for every legal workstream across the company, own the legal governance record (privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars), manage outside counsel relationships, and own the legal tech stack. We sit at the nexus of data, AI, and collaboration, which means our legal operations have to be as thoughtful as our product. We use AI tooling across legal operations, and you’ll work the same way: building agents and automations to move faster, not as a side project but as the default way things get done here. If you see a manual workflow and instinctively want to build it away, you’ll feel right at home. What you will do: Drive CLM adoption and enablement so the revenue team self-serves on standard deals Own workflow optimization, templates, and playbooks as deal structures and products evolve First-pass review and redlining of standard agreements; draft from templates as volume requires Build and own structured intake for legal workstreams across the company Build AI-powered workflows, agents, and automations that replace manual processes Maintain the legal governance record: privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars Train cross-functional teams on self-service tools and escalation paths Manage outside counsel relationships and the legal tech stack About You: 3-5+ years in legal operations, paralegal, or contract management, with at least 1-2 years in-house at a tech or SaaS company You’ve implemented or rebuilt a CLM (Ironclad preferred), designed intake workflows, and stood up reporting someone relied on Experience reviewing and redlining commercial agreements on both sell-side and buy-side paper You build with AI and automation as a natural part of how you work. You’re comfortable across AI-assisted legal tools, LLMs, and automation platforms, and willing to experiment with new ones as they emerge. This isn’t a nice-to-have at Hex. Comfortable operating with autonomy in a role with a lot of white space Good judgment about what you can handle and what needs a lawyer You care whether people actually use what you build Nice to have: Experience at a company navigating exponential growth Experience with corporate governance (entity management, board materials, annual filings) Has used Hex Strong opinions about the best way to organize a Notion workspace We know job posts like this can feel like a checklist, and nobody checks every box. If you’ve built legal ops infrastructure, you’re excited about AI, and this role sounds like the kind of work you want to do, we’d love to hear from you. In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary & equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness & parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. items.description: At Instructure , we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers. We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in: At Instructure, our Strategy & Business Operations (BizOps) team partners directly with executive leadership to drive growth, efficiency, and execution across the enterprise. Our mission is to connect strategy to execution — ensuring everyone knows where we’re going, why we’re going there, and how far we’ve come. We accelerate Instructure’s most important strategic and operational priorities, from defining growth opportunities and optimizing performance to building the systems, governance, and data infrastructure that scale our business. The Role As Principal, Business Operations, you will lead high-impact initiatives that cut across functions, shaping how the company sets priorities, allocates resources, and measures progress. You’ll oversee strategic planning, execution governance (OKRs, QBRs, operating rhythm), and the enterprise initiative portfolio. You’ll also mentor and lead BizOps talent, ensuring the function matures from reactive problem-solving to predictive, insight-driven operations. What You’ll Do Lead Enterprise Strategy & Planning: Own the annual strategy and planning cycle — from long-range vision to yearly investment allocation. Drive Strategic Execution: Govern the company’s OKR and business review process to ensure accountability and measurable progress toward strategy. Oversee Strategic Initiative Portfolio: Manage cross-functional initiatives that advance Instructure’s strategic priorities; align resources and resolve execution bottlenecks. Operationalize Visibility: Build and continuously evolve the enterprise “Strategy Scorecard” and shared dashboards to quantify progress and impact. Build Organizational Maturity: Establish consistent systems, processes, and decision-rights frameworks to move the company from reactive to managed to strategic. Coach & Influence: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership; lead, mentor, and scale the BizOps team; drive cultural adoption of data-informed, strategy-driven execution. What you will need to know/have: 5+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or business operations at a high-growth SaaS company. Proven success leading large-scale cross-functional programs with executive visibility. Analytical and structured problem solver who can convert insight into action. Highly skilled communicator able to influence at the executive level. Track record of building operational systems and governance models at scale. Comfortable balancing enterprise strategic thinking with hands-on execution. Get in on all the awesome at Instructure! We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect: Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success. Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location. Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs. Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth The technology and tools you need to do your best work Motivosity employee recognition program A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. items.title: Product Designer
items.summary: Shape the Future on AutopilotAt Autopilot, you won’t just design screens – you’ll design how fintech works.
items.description: Shape the Future on Autopilot At Autopilot , you won’t just design screens – you’ll design how fintech works. As a Product Designer , you’ll own product experiences end-to-end and help redefine what great UX means in a complex, data-driven industry. We’re building a high-performance, AI-native Fintech Operating System designed to optimize cost and revenue for digital businesses. Join us on a multi-year mission to build smarter infrastructure for commerce. Why Join Us? You’ll help build an ambitious product from the ground up, with a team that values speed, craft, and autonomy. If you’re ready to make an outsized impact in fintech, we’d love to meet you. About the Role You'll join a fast-moving team building modern, data-intensive web applications that help digital businesses operate more intelligently. This is a founding design role with strong emphasis on product logic, systems thinking, and end-to-end collaboration with engineers. 🛠️ What You'll Do Translate complex financial logic and backend systems into intuitive user flows Design dashboards, workflows, and visual systems for payments, orchestration, and automation Build and maintain our scalable design system in Figma (aligned with React components) Collaborate with engineers on real-world UX states — success, failure, pending, retry Prototype and validate features with real data and user context Participate in product discussions, shaping user journeys before pixels are drawn Uphold usability and domain accuracy as the standard for design quality 🎯 What We're Looking For 5+ years of experience designing digital products with complex logic (fintech, B2B SaaS, or data-heavy systems preferred) Strong product and systems thinking — you design for states and workflows , not just screens Deep Figma expertise (Auto Layout, Variants, Tokens, Components) Ability to translate backend logic, APIs, and data models into coherent user experiences Excellent communication and documentation skills (Linear, Figma, Slack) Comfortable working directly with engineers and iterating quickly without handoffs 🌟 Bonus Points Experience in fintech, payments, or compliance-related products Exposure to analytics or developer tooling Understanding of design-to-code workflows (React component parity, tokens) Strong interaction or motion design craft (Framer, ProtoPie, etc.) Our Hiring Process We focus on real-world collaboration, not design showreels. Here’s what to expect: Apply with LinkedIn Profile And Resume We’ll review based on the requirements above. If shortlisted, you’ll receive an email to schedule a 90-minute live design collaboration session once you’re comfortable with our pre-interview brief. 90-Minute Live Design Collaboration You’ll work with our product and engineering team on a small feature challenge — from user problem to Figma prototype. We’ll look at: How you think through logic and flows How you translate constraints into UX decisions Your interaction, hierarchy, and state management How you communicate trade-offs and rationale The session mirrors our actual workflow: accessible pragmatic collaborative Design Review & Feedback After the session, we’ll walk through your design decisions together. You’ll get feedback from our CTO and team, and discuss potential improvements or extensions to your solution. Culture & Alignment Chat A final call with CEO to discuss your long-term goals, how you work best, and whether Autopilot is the right fit for both sides. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: To learn the Hiring Ranges for this position, please select your location from the Apply Now dropdown menu. To learn more about our Hiring Range System, please click this link. Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. About this team and role: In the past few years, Marketing has emerged as a key vector and focus of Firefox’s growth, with Data Science playing an essential role in evaluating Marketing’s impact and developing clear strategies to ensure that success. Marketing Data Science supports Firefox through the standard fare of marketing (ongoing measurement, experimentation/lift testing, adhoc analysis, forecasting/budget optimization), and beyond that as thought leaders at Firefox in translating broad goals into clearly defined objectives and identifying the path towards succeeding in them. In this role, you will continue to build on the Marketing team’s recent successes as Firefox’s Marketing program continues to expand its footprint throughout the funnel. You’ll look to support this success in owning global data strategy for Firefox Marketing, developing new data capabilities to unlock future business growth, collaborating with Data Science counterparts in other domains domains, and working closely across marketing and adjacent cross-functional teams to translate your team’s work into practical recommendations and enablement that drive Firefox’s growth. What you’ll do: Set the strategy and roadmap for Marketing Data Science, prioritizing the highest-impact opportunities with key partners. Establish goals and measurement approaches for attribution, ROI, and campaign performance; deliver insights that improve marketing investment and outcomes. Lead and develop the team’s core capabilities across: Performance marketing: budget optimization, causal lift measurement, and conversion-signal testing Brand marketing: measurement planning and assessment of long-term and lower-funnel impact User insights: retention/LTV modeling and audience segmentation Reporting and infrastructure: build self-service dashboards, deliver ad hoc and executive reporting, and develop scalable data models and internal tools that expand our understanding of the acquisition landscape. Bring a forward-looking perspective on advertising, media innovation, and marketing analytics methods. Partner with Data Science leaders to evaluate and responsibly adopt emerging AI tools that improve team workflows and impact. What you’ll bring: 6+ years of marketing data science experience, ideally at a media agency or in-house marketing organization. Proficiency with marketing analytics tools, including Google Analytics and advertising platforms, and familiarity with modeling methods such as MMM, causal lift/synthetic control, saturation modeling, optimization, and Bayesian approaches. Proven experience leading, mentoring, and developing talent, with strong stakeholder management and the ability to prioritize multiple complex workstreams. Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to tailor data-driven insights and recommendations to different audiences. What you’ll get: Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday One-time home office stipend Annual professional development budget Quarterly well-being stipend Considerable paid parental leave Employee referral bonus program Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) About Mozilla Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla , you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online. You'll work with content creators, publishers, comparison sites, communities, and affiliate networks across Europe, while building a strong pipeline of new partners. This is a highly autonomous, hands-on role where you'll combine partner management with business development — strengthening existing relationships, sourcing and onboarding new affiliates, negotiating commercial agreements, and using data and AI to continuously improve partner performance. You'll work closely with Product, Data, Engineering, Brand, CRM, Legal, and Compliance to optimise the full journey from first click to long-term investor value. Your main responsibilities 🎯 Own and Execute the affiliate marketing channel strategy, operating plan, forecast and performance. Source, qualify and close direct partnerships with affiliates (in other words publishers: content creators, comparison sites, communities and relevant affiliate networks). Create clear segmentation, outreach, onboarding and activation routines that move partners from prospect to live Design and negotiate CPA, CPL, fixed-fee and hybrid deals Define and improve the funnel from click and sign-up through funded investor, first 30-day deposits, repeat deposits and 30/60/90-day retained value. Operate and improve Target Circle/Circlewise Build partner- and cohort-level reporting covering acquisition cost, revenue (deposits) value, retention, net revenue (net deposits) Test placements, content, landing pages, incentives, creative and localized messaging with Brand, CRM, Product and Design. Apply country-specific financial-promotion rules, execute approval workflows, required disclosures, content monitoring and documentation together with Legal and Compliance. What would ensure success in this role?💪 Expert in at least one partner management platform (Affiliate platforms such as Target Circle/Circlewise, Impact, Awin or Partnerize, CJ Advanced Excel or Google Sheets and BI dashboard experience AI fluency: Comfortable using AI tools for data analysis, partner research and qualification, and content/compliance review, with strong judgment on when human verification is essential. Fluent in English and German is a plus What can you expect at Bondora ? 🎯 Be part of Bondora ’s ambitious journey toward 1BN in revenue - your work will have a real impact. 💰 Enjoy a competitive salary and amazing benefits: 5 weeks of vacation, private healthcare compensation, hobby grant, mental health support, share options, and much more! 📈 Work in an environment that encourages growth and innovation - with resources and budget for continuous learning. items.description: Fortitude Re insurance Company Ltd. ( Fortitude Re ) is one of the world’s leading providers of legacy reinsurance solutions. They work with the world’s leading insurance companies to help them execute comprehensive, transformational solutions for legacy Life & Annuity and P&C lines. Fortitude Re manages a general account of approximately $111 billion across life, annuity, and property & casualty insurance products. The company takes a long-term view on growth and is proud to be backed by a consortium of sophisticated institutional investors led by The Carlyle Group and T&D Insurance Group. Incorporated under the laws of Bermuda on January 1, 2017, Fortitude Re ’s roots in the insurance industry and the experience of their leadership go back many decades. Fortitude Re ’s leadership team has an average industry tenure of over 20 years, and an impressive track record of successfully managing the most complex legacy liabilities. Their deep insurance experience and proprietary risk modeling capabilities allow them to structure bespoke transactions that benefit both insurance companies and their policyholders. Fortitude Re continues to strengthen its ability to pursue further growth and provide innovative solutions for the global insurance industry. Click here for more information about Fortitude Re . The AVP, Investment Operations plays a critical role in supporting the investment, portfolio management, and operations functions with a strong emphasis on data integrity, control discipline, and operational scalability. This individual will be a critical part of the investment lifecycle — from asset manager and deal onboarding through settlement and cash management — while owning the reconciliation process, proactively identifying breaks, discrepancies, and process gaps, and driving remediation and standardization across systems and counterparties. items.title: Full Stack Data Scientist
items.summary: About Discovered LabsDiscovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher and a demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR.
items.description: About Discovered Labs Discovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher and a demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR. We’re trusted by hyper-growth companies like Instantly, Granola, incident and other $10M+ ARR B2B SaaS companies who want more leads and customers from both Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT. We do this through a mixture of content marketing, technical optimisations and off-site brand amplification (PR, backlinks, Reddit marketing). View recent case studies at . High-level, our approach rests on three things: AI automation and workflows. We build marketing programs the way you’d build a product. Rather than burn hours a week on repetitive tasks, our in-house team of ML engineers builds workflows with custom tooling so we can focus on the high-impact work. Senior expertise. Everything is managed and elevated by a team of experts, so it’s done to a high standard and differentiated. We don’t let automation get in the way of quality. Full-stack. SEO and AEO rarely work as isolated tasks. We work across the entire funnel and multiple surfaces so we own the outcome and clients win. If you want to stand out, include a Loom showing a tool, system or deliverable you’ve built and are proud of. We’d love to see it. This role You analyse the data, work out why performance is moving and turn the result into a report the client can act on. You implement the fixes and improvements yourself with our internal tooling. “DS who owns data → analysis → decision → implementation end to end” Concretely, that means you: Analyse the data behind reports, strategy questions, client queries, technical issues and SWOTs — reconciling messy, incomplete sources into a clear picture of what's actually happening. QA via analysis - Is the rationale sound? Does the logic hold? Where's the unsupported claim? Run experiments. Design a falsifiable test, run it, and know when a result is noise rather than signal. Tie every finding to the client's business. You get to "so what, and why does this matter to their revenue," not just "here's what the data says." Own the report. Hand the client and the account strategist a decision-ready read the data, the diagnosis and the “so what?” never a raw data dump. Optimise for answer engines (AEO). Make client content the source LLMs and Google AI Overviews cite, using our internal methodology and tools, as one surface among many. Execute, not just recommend. You implement the findings yourself with our internal tooling. The analysis only counts once it's shipped. Improve the tactics and the systems. Turn a one-off finding into a repeatable process, and keep sharpening the tooling and methodology behind how the system works. Communicate it cleanly to clients , in writing and on calls, so your output needs no translation. This role is fully remote. Ideally your working hours overlap the GMT business day (we’re flexible within roughly ±4 hours). This is not for you if: You need heavy management, or you wait for perfect instructions before acting. If you spot a broken process, we expect you to fix it. Produce genius insights but don’t ship them. Insight with no execution is exactly the failure mode we screen for. The analyst who gets on the tools is the one we want. Lack experience and/or willingness to use advanced AI workflows. Prefer to spend weeks performing audits before implementation. B2B SaaS clients expect results fast and everything needs to tie to commercial impact. Not comfortable with data and analytics. We want someone who can diagnose the why behind performance and back it with evidence. What’s in it for you Benefits $30,000 -$50,000 annual salary depending on relevant skills and experience Fully remote position. (Ideally flexible within roughly ±4 hours GMT ) Room to grow. We’re small but growing, which means real opportunity, including a senior track with no people management required. Paid leave and autonomy to perform your role. The best in-house SEO/AEO tools i.e. ML/AI and data science tooling , built by top engineers, at your disposal. How you’ll spend your time A rough split; it flexes month to month with what each account needs. 40% — Implementing and shipping. Producing and shipping the week’s work across your accounts: technical fixes, on-page, content refreshes, internal linking, off-page and AEO, all verified at source before it goes out. 30% — Analysing, diagnosing and measuring. Getting into the numbers to understand cause and effect, designing and running experiments, and measuring what actually moved after a change. 15% — Reporting and client communication. Owning the client-facing report, being present on calls to walk through the diagnosis, staying close in day-to-day client Slack, and giving the account owner the read behind the story they lead. 15% — Building and evolving the methodology. Sharpening your own skills as search and AI assistants keep changing, and constantly improving the tooling, templates and process behind how the team works. Requirements This role owns the full loop end to end, analyse → explain → implement → report. You don't hand off execution: you analyse it, you build it, you ship it. High agency and a builder's instinct are the two traits we weight above everything, including domain knowledge. High agency covers execution and tempo; builder covers coding, AI workflows, and evolving the methodology. Strong analytical and quantitative background: you reconcile messy, incomplete data (GSC exports, rank trackers, partial client analytics not clean warehouse tables), design falsifiable experiments, and reason to a root cause with evidence, never inventing a cause where the data is silent. Demonstrated evidence of shipping a time your analysis changed what a business did, and you implemented at least part of it yourself. Insight without execution is exactly the wrong fit for this seat. You're AI-native and have built something with it: a side project, agent, scraper, or internal tool. You use AI tools daily as a workflow multiplier (briefs, clustering, audit summarisation, scraping) and still own the final, validated output. You build workflows, not just prompts and we take portfolio over claims. Experiment design and statistical rigour : you design a test, run it, and know when a result is noise. Systems thinking: you improve the tactic and improve the system colonbehind it, turning a one-off finding into a repeatable process. Commercial curiosity: you get to "so what?" unprompted, asking about the client's business model and KPIs, and land every finding as a business consequence revenue, pipeline, or cost not just a metric movement. Strong written and verbal English , with the ability to convey findings cleanly to non-technical stakeholders. Reports and QA rationale go straight to clients; the analysis only counts once a client understands it and acts on it. Nice-to-haves (not required) Experience with SEO/analytics tooling (GSC, GA4, Ahrefs, a crawler such as Screaming Frog). If you don’t have it, we’ll ramp you this is teachable. Client-facing experience, and commercial awareness. Familiarity with B2B SaaS. Culture fit You should ideally believe: Search has fundamentally changed. Google and backlinks still matter but are no longer the full picture — AI search is a new frontier and you’re excited about the shift. AI is a force multiplier, not a crutch. You’re actively using AI daily and building workflows, not just typing into a chat box. Speed and quality are both achievable. Everyone here operates at a fast pace, is reliable and takes extreme ownership. There are no passengers at Discovered Labs. You’ll thrive here if: you get energy from excellent work that makes clients successful, you see gaps in processes and fix them without being asked, and you move fast while proactively communicating. You won’t thrive here if: you need heavy management, you wait for perfect instructions, or you think SEO is still just about keywords and links. We look forward to seeing your application. items.description: ABOUT RENEW CAPITAL Renew Capital is a pan-Africa investment firm with a presence in 13 countries. We back the bold founders using technology to pursue Africa’s greatest opportunities. With more than a decade of investing on the continent, Renew Capital is among the most active investors building Africa’s thriving private sector. Renew Capital is powered by a team of investment, finance, legal, advisory and market development professionals. Our bench includes seasoned investors, analysts, operators and ecosystem experts with deep experience scaling businesses across Africa. ROLE SUMMARY The sr. financial analyst plays a critical role in evaluating, supporting and scaling high-potential ventures across Africa. This role sits at the core of Renew Capital ’s investment process, supporting sourcing, due diligence, investment decision-making and portfolio value creation. The sr. financial analyst will work closely with investment managers, portfolio company CFOs and senior leadership, building rigorous financial models and translating complex data into clear insights that inform investment decisions. Responsibilities: The sr. financial analyst’s responsibilities are focused on three core areas: 1. Investment Analysis & Due Diligence Prepare and maintain robust financial models for pipeline and prospective investment opportunities. Analyze historical financial data, forecasts and assumptions to assess risk, return, and scalability. Evaluate capital expenditures, depreciation schedules, and capital structuring scenarios. Conduct market sizing, competitive analysis and primary and secondary research to support investment theses. Support financial and commercial due diligence processes from initial screening through investment committee review. 2. Portfolio Support & Monitoring Work directly with portfolio company finance teams on budgeting, 13-week rolling cash flow forecasts, and financial controls. Monitor portfolio company performance, identify trends, calculate key ratios, and flag risks or opportunities early. Build and maintain strong working relationships with portfolio CFOs and founders. 3. Communication & Insight Generation Translate complex analysis into clear, decision-ready materials for investment managers, leadership and the investment committee. Prepare presentations, memos and dashboards that communicate insights concisely. Collaborate with a diverse, distributed investment team across Africa using digital tools. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business or a related field; MBA or Master’s in Finance preferred. 6–8+ years of progressive experience in financial analysis, investment analysis, private equity, venture capital, investment banking or corporate finance, with exposure to growth-stage companies. Advanced financial modeling expertise, including integrated three-statement models, valuation, scenario and sensitivity analysis and capital structuring. Strong experience supporting or leading financial and commercial due diligence processes. Proven ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear, decision-ready insights for senior leadership and investment committees. Excellent Excel and financial analysis skills, with experience working with large, complex data sets. Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with investment teams, portfolio company CFOs and founders across diverse markets. CFA or other recognized investment or financial modeling credentials preferred. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS As Renew Capital continues to expand its investment activity across Africa, strong financial analysis is essential to deploying capital responsibly and supporting portfolio companies through growth and complexity. This role provides exposure to venture investing across multiple sectors and markets, with the opportunity to influence real investment outcomes. Location and Travel Opportunities: This is a remote role; however, candidates must be based in Côte d'Ivoire. About Renew Capital : We invite you to learn more about Renew Capital by visiting our website:. Application Process: Renew Capital invites qualified applicants to fill out the application form on our website here. Renew Capital is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran or disability status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Further, Renew Capital supports gender-based pay equity and is committed to compensating women and men equally, for equal work. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Design Headquarters: Remote - United States About Vercel: Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. About the Role: AI Gateway gives developers one place to connect applications and agents to hundreds of models with one API key. It handles provider routing and fallbacks, unifies billing and observability, and lets teams manage spend and security controls across production AI workloads. Designing this well is a systems problem. A developer should be able to choose the right model, make and verify a first request, diagnose a failed request, and configure routing, budgets, credentials, and security controls without losing sight of the application they are trying to build. The right interface might be in the dashboard, on the public model catalog, in the CLI, in an API response, or in code. You will be the Design Engineer for AI Gateway, owning product design and frontend implementation across those surfaces. You will work with customers, a Product Manager, and engineers to understand the problem, explore solutions, build the production experience, ship it, and learn from what happens after launch. AI Gateway is live, the model ecosystem changes every week, and the team can move from an observed problem to production quickly. This is a rare chance to use your product judgment, design craft, and code to shape a developer product and ship the experience yourself. You will be the design owner embedded with a Product Manager and a dedicated engineering team. You will also have the Product Design team around you for critique, collaboration, and support. AI Gateway will be your main product area, with room to pursue design-led improvements across Vercel. You will report to the Design Team. If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team. What You Will Do: Own product design and frontend implementation for meaningful parts of the journey from discovering a model to making a first successful request and operating AI in production. Design and build production experiences across the website, dashboard, CLI, and APIs, choosing the right medium for each problem. Make models, providers, credentials, routing, budgets, logs, performance, privacy, and governance understandable, then create patterns that extend across new providers, modalities, and workloads. Talk directly with customers and use product data to understand problems, define success, make tradeoffs, and improve what ships. Own quality after launch, including visual and interaction craft, accessibility, performance, resilience, instrumentation, and edge cases. Use coding agents to explore and implement ideas quickly, while testing, debugging, and taking responsibility for what ships. About You: Your work shows what you personally identified, designed, built, shipped, and learned after launch. You build production-quality web applications with React and TypeScript and can contribute confidently in a large, existing codebase. You bring strong visual and interaction craft and have made technical or data-rich products understandable without removing the control advanced users need. You can move between graphical interfaces, CLI workflows, API behavior, and implementation details, treating accessibility, performance, failure recovery, and instrumentation as part of the design. You use customer research and product data to make decisions, communicate your reasoning clearly, challenge ideas constructively, and change direction when the evidence changes. You use coding agents in your daily work, but you can explain, test, debug, and take responsibility for the code they help produce. There is no required path into this role. You may come from product design, frontend engineering, creative development, or a career that does not fit a standard title. We care about the quality of what you have shipped and the judgment behind it. Bonus If You: Have experience with developer tools, infrastructure products, model marketplaces, or observability experiences. Have worked with AI models, providers, inference platforms, guardrails, or AI application tooling. Have experience with APIs, command-line tools, structured product content, or agent-facing interfaces. Have built an application or agent with Vercel’s AI SDK or AI Gateway. See the work: AI Gateway AI Gateway documentation Browse AI models AI model leaderboards Design Engineering at Vercel Compensation & Benefits: Competitive compensation package, including equity. Inclusive Healthcare Package. Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. Flexible Time Off. We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $208,000 - $312,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process. Disclosures: Privacy: Please review our J ob Applicant Privacy Policy for more information on how we handle your data. Equal Opportunity: Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vercel-design-engineer
