items.description: About Trafilea Trafilea is a Consumer Tech Platform for Transformative Brand Growth. We’re building the AI Growth Engine that powers the next generation of consumer brands. With over $1B+ in cumulative revenue, 12M+ customers, and 500+ talents across 19 countries, we combine technology, growth marketing, and operational excellence to scale purpose-driven, digitally native brands. We own and operate our own digitally native brands (not an agency), with presence in Walmart, Nordstrom, and Amazon, and a strong global D2C footprint. Why Trafilea We’re a tech-led eCommerce group scaling our own globally loved DTC brands, while helping ambitious talent grow just as fast. 🚀 We build and scale our own brands. 🦾 We invest in AI and automation like few others in eCom. 📈 We test fast, grow fast, and help you do the same. 🤝 Be part of a dynamic, diverse, and talented global team. 🌍 100% Remote, USD competitive salary, paid time off, and more. Job Responsibilities At Trafilea , demand planning isn’t about reacting to numbers — it’s about engineering the system that drives millions in Amazon revenue. You’ll own the engine behind our Retail Stores / Beauty operation: forecasting, replenishment, automation, and inventory performance across FBA and 3PL. This is where data, operations, and growth collide. You won’t just “plan demand.” You’ll build the infrastructure that makes it scalable. Design SKU-level demand forecasts across Amazon marketplaces Build automated replenishment systems between 3PL and FBA Maintain 60+ days coverage at FBA while optimizing stock across the pipeline Improve forecast accuracy (MAPE) and eliminate stockouts & excess inventory Lead automation projects (alerts, triggers, dashboards) with BI & Tech teams Turn Amazon data into real-time decisions that impact revenue and profitability Requirements 3+ years in demand planning (e-commerce or CPG), ideally with Retail Stores / Beauty Strong experience with Amazon Seller Central and FBA operations Advanced Excel skills (modeling, forecasting, data analysis) Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Redash, or similar) Analytical, structured thinker with strong attention to detail Builder mindset: you automate, optimize, and improve everything you touch Comfortable managing multiple SKUs, reports, and priorities simultaneously Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior Research Manager - Animal Welfare
items.summary: About the roleRethink Priorities' Animal Welfare Department produces research and strategic advice to help organizations make well-informed decisions for animals.
items.description: About the role Rethink Priorities ' Animal Welfare Department produces research and strategic advice to help organizations make well-informed decisions for animals . The Department is splitting into three teams. The AI and Animals Team helps organisations navigate an AI-transforming world. The Frontiers Team advances the field of animal welfare, focusing on neglected animals (such as shrimp) and emerging topics (such as breeding for welfare). And a new Animal Welfare Strategy Team, described below. The Animal Welfare Strategy Team (working name) will focus on supporting and accelerating funders and organizations toward achieving their core goals of accelerating the end of low-welfare farming and reducing the suffering of animals on farms , with a focus on terrestrial vertebrates. This will involve a mix of consulting work, in-house research, and other activities. Recent consulting work has included economic analysis of egg prices for a policy advocacy organization, prioritization of welfare-tech ideas for a venture studio, and research on alternative-protein regulation to guide a large grantmaker with a $10m+ portfolio. RP is independent: clients get the answers that the evidence supports, whether or not they are the ones they hoped for. In-house research might involve building data tools and resources to map where animals are suffering on farms, or strategic analysis to guide stakeholders' decisions. The team will also run the annual Animal Advocacy Strategy Forum, which brings together leaders from across the animal welfare landscape. Going forward, it may build capacity for other actions to enable the success for existing and new projects, such as regranting or talent programs. The department seeks to hire a Senior Research Manager to lead this new Animal Welfare Strategy Team . This is a leadership role in a Department that is growing and being restructured. You will need to work with the Director to set a strategy for this team covering how the team prioritizes projects, and how the team measures and maximizes impact for the animals. We are looking for someone excited to build these structures. You will also work on hiring, managing incoming consulting projects, designing research processes, and managing staff. We want to create a team with a mix of cross-cutting skills, such as economics, policy, animal welfare ecosystem knowledge, stakeholder management, M&E, and animal science. We have 1–2 economist staff ready to join this team. This role will report to Sam Hilton, Acting Director of the Animal Welfare Department. Ideal start date: Monday 4th January 2027 Key Responsibilities You are responsible for leading the team's areas of work. This includes: Manage consulting intake . Decide which requests from funders, advocacy organizations, and entrepreneurs RP takes on, reshapes, or declines. Identify opportunities and act on them . Bring forward ideas with outsized upside, research or otherwise. For research, set an agenda of priority projects. For other interventions, such as regranting or talent programs, decide whether RP should run them and launch what clears the bar. Oversee the Animal Advocacy Strategy Forum . Ensure your team: sets the agenda, decides who is in the room, and turns the movement's annual leaders' gathering into decisions and impact. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include: Set strategy. Decide how this team prioritizes, how it measures impact and what work it takes on. There is no project prioritization process, impact framework or intake system yet – you will build them alongside the Director. Hire . Decide which skills the team needs next: policy, M&E, animal science, movement experience. Run the rounds, supported by RP's in-house recruitment specialist. Manage the team . Lead economists and specialists with deeper expertise than yours in their own fields. Set the quality bar. Put in place research processes, review standards and project tracking. Deliver research that gets used . Scope clients' decisions, manage staff to deliver on deadline, and follow up on whether clients acted on the findings. Represent RP . Build the networks and relationships that generate new projects. Attend conferences where you are able to travel. Fundraise . With the Development Team's support, raise additional funds as the team grows. What We Are Looking For Essential criteria Impact first. Driven to have as much impact for animals as possible. Committed to integrity in research, to following the evidence, and to being transparent about what it shows. Decision-oriented research experience. Experience conducting or overseeing research aimed at informing or influencing a specific stakeholder's decision. Good judgment. Demonstrated judgment in prioritization and decision-making under uncertainty. Management experience. Experience managing or mentoring others, including people with deeper expertise than yours, or clear readiness to step into a people-management role. Strategy and process design. Experience of, or clear ability to set a team's strategy and build processes to deliver it where none existed. Research review skills. Ability to interrogate both qualitative and quantitative analysis you did not produce, and to "think at the margin" about cost-effectiveness. Communication skills. Excellent reasoning transparency: ability to show the assumptions and evidence behind your conclusions. Strong ability to synthesize complex information and communicate strategic insight in writing and in person. Delivery. Track record of getting projects finished, on deadline, involving other people. Works well and makes autonomous decisions in a remote, asynchronous, international environment. Desirable criteria Consulting experience. Consulting or other client-facing analytical work: identifying the decision a client is actually facing, shaping or declining work accordingly, and building relationships with clients and fundraising leads. Experience of the animal organizational landscape . Professional or voluntary experience of animal advocacy. A working knowledge of the organizational landscape, funders, and strategic debates. In-depth expertise in a relevant area. Such as economics, policy and regulation, M&E, or animal science. Events and convening experience. Running convenings or facilitating events that bring together groups with differing interests. Talent development experience. Running talent programs or fellowships. Grantmaking experience. Distributing funds and evaluating organizations for funding. We expect that even highly qualified applicants will not meet all of these criteria. We encourage you to apply even if you do not have some of these skills, knowledge and experiences. What We Offer Compensation We offer an annual salary within the following ranges for a full-time position, prorated for part-time work: $98,500 - $125,000 USD pre-tax £76,590 - £97,176 GBP pre-tax €89,459 - €113,527 EUR pre-tax Compensation is not restricted to the currencies listed above. The exact salary will be based on the candidate’s title level, and calculated using RP’s salary algorithm. Towards the upper end we would expect a track record of leading a research team to drive impact. Towards the lower end we would expect strong research judgment with a shorter management record, or management experience but weaker research skills. You do not need to say which end you think you fit; we assess this from your application. To ensure fairness across the entire organization, RP does not negotiate salaries. Other Benefits Opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, high-impact organization — our research is used by key decision-makers who influence the distribution of hundreds of millions of charitable dollars. Remote-first environment, including flexible work hours and schedule. Virtual co-working spaces, including a private Rethink Priorities Focusmate group Comprehensive global benefits program, including statutory benefits as required by local law, and supplemental benefits specific to each country (varies by location) Generous paid time off (PTO) and unpaid leave, including: Unlimited vacation with a minimum number of required statutory days off "Mandated" 3 weeks total mid- and end-year organization-wide breaks Unlimited (within reason) personal and sick paid and unpaid leave Parental leave — at least 4 - 9 months of a combination of paid and unpaid leave, available prior to and/or during the first 2 years after a child's birth or adoption Other paid and unpaid leave (e.g., bereavement) Technology stipend of $2,000 USD equivalent every 3 years for work and office equipment and an AI tools budget of $40 USD equivalent monthly Professional Development Budget of $4000 USD per year. Learning opportunities, including workshops/training sessions and up to 10% of work time dedicated to professional and personal development Paid work trips, including one annual all-staff Mega Team Retreat and relevant conferences A caring team that values respectful work relations and a healthy work-life balance. Low administrative bureaucracy. We don’t provide snacks, but we could mail you a box of Oreos if you want! Apply here Application deadline Mon 19th October , end of day (anywhere on earth). Please click the link on the sidebar / at the foot of this page to apply. Additional Information Role-Specific Work Environment and Visa Sponsorship: This role is fully remote and we are able to legally hire in many countries. In certain cases, we may be able to provide visa sponsorship to the US or UK and help candidates relocate. If you have questions about whether we can hire or provide visa sponsorship in another country and if this will influence your decision about applying, please contact before submitting your application. Time Zones and Working Hours: While we welcome applicants from all time zones, you will need to have some availability for meetings between 3pm and 5pm UK time on most weekdays, when our Europe-based and US Central time based colleagues overlap. Depending on where you are, this may mean early morning or evening calls. Full and Part Time Position: This role is open to full-time and part-time candidates who are available to work at least 24 hours per week. Candidates able to work at least 30 hours a week will be preferred. Travel: Travel is not an essential requirement for this position. Travel is not mandatory, but encouraged. A majority of our staff travel a few times per year for conferences, team and all-staff retreats, and other work-related purposes. If, for any reason, you would prefer not to travel for work, please do not be discouraged from applying. Depending on the event, we can likely make accommodations, such as allowing virtual participation when possible. Language: Professional level of English language is required for all roles at Rethink Priorities . Application process There are 4 evaluation stages. Only candidates who meet the minimum bar at a given stage will proceed to the next stage. We aim to complete assessments for each stage within a week, so you can quickly learn whether you will proceed to the next stage. Stage 1: Application Prompts We will score whether your responses to the prompts indicate: alignment with our mission ability to perform tasks that are common for the role relevant experience in similar roles Stage 2: Skills assessment You will complete a ~5-hour task that assesses core competencies for the role. You will be paid $45 USD per hour for completing this assessment Stage 3: Interviews We will ask you questions relevant to a variety of skills and experiences required for the role. Most of these questions will be sent in advance. In a few cases, we will tell you about the topic in advance, but not the specific question. You will have an opportunity to ask questions about the role, the Animal Welfare department, and RP more broadly. Stage 4: Reference checks and offers We will ask for two to three references about your job experiences. Hiring Process-Specific Anonymity : We initially assess on anonymized application prompts and test tasks. Please do not send a cover letter, and do not include your name in your responses to the longer application prompts. Extension requests: We will try to accommodate extension requests made before the deadline, up to 3 days. We generally cannot accommodate extension requests made after the application deadline, or that are longer than 3 days, and cannot accept late submissions to ensure fairness to other applicants. AI use in initial application: You may search for information online or use a free AI assistant (such as ChatGPT, free tier) to provide you with additional support in responding to the initial application questions. If you use an AI assistant, please disclose how you used it and how it changed your responses. Application materials: All application materials must be submitted in English language; otherwise, we will not be able to evaluate your candidacy. Inclusivity and fairness: RP is committed to building an inclusive, equitable, and supportive community for you to thrive and do your best work. Please don’t hesitate to apply for a role regardless of your age, gender identity/expression, political identity, personal preferences, physical abilities, veteran status, neurodiversity or any other background. We provide reasonable accommodations and benefits, including, for example, flexible work schedules and locations, mental health coverage through medical benefits (as available), as well as technology budgets and professional development time that can be used, for example, to purchase assistive technology or engage in job coaching. Accessibility: We’re committed to running an inclusive and accessible hiring process. We warmly invite you to reach out to with any questions or accessibility requests such as chat box use during interviews. Hiring Software: We use Pinpoint for our recruitment and hiring processes and all of the email correspondence is done via Pinpoint. We encourage you to add Pinpoint domain (@pinpoint.email) to your trusted contacts and/or check your 'spam', 'promotions' and ‘updates’ folders, if you don’t hear from us within the expected timeframe. Past applicant policy: We may be able to accelerate your job application if you have applied to the same or similar role within RP or a similar institution and advanced within the last 2 years. Please get in touch stating which role you applied to, when, and to which stage you were advanced at which organization if you would like to be considered for this possibility. Consideration for other roles : We sometimes identify strong candidates in one hiring round whose skills are well matched to other senior roles within the department. If you are not selected for this position, we may contact you to ask whether you would like to be considered for a related senior opening, should one arise. You do not need to indicate interest at the application stage. Other: Visit our Career webpage if you’d like to know more about our hiring process, culture, and what working at RP is like. About Rethink Priorities Founded in 2018, Rethink Priorities (RP) is a think-and-do tank. Through research and action, the organization improves the lives of humans and animals—both now and in the future. We work to identify solutions, mobilize resources, and empower our team and others to address some of the world’s most pressing problems. Our team conducts rigorous research across animal welfare, climate change, global health, international development, and other important and neglected areas. Our operations experts help high-impact organizations to improve efficiency and achieve meaningful results. RP works as all of the following: A consultancy doing commissioned work in response to demands from organizations doing high-impact work A research institute driven by research agendas we set according to our own priorities. A think tank aiming to inform public policy to improve the world. An accelerator, incubator, and base for priority projects. Accomplishments include: Bringing attention to neglected issues, such as lead exposure, fungal diseases, and shrimp welfare. Increasing the collective impact of advocates across each field in which we work through strategic coordination. Investigating potential interventions and identifying the most cost-effective options. In 2025, our research influenced tens of millions of dollars in foundation grants. Creating practical tools for philanthropists to compare resource allocations across different species and cause areas and to build giving portfolios despite uncertainties. Providing organizations with data to inform their decisions. For example, we have conducted surveys on perceptions of existential risks, AI, effective giving, and other topics. Providing fiscal sponsorship and operational support to ensure that high-impact initiatives in areas like AI safety and animal welfare can launch and grow effectively. Donor Compass - Cross Cause Fund Tool to guide philanthropic giving We welcome you to review our research database and our latest annual report. Contact Contact: Please email if you have any questions. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: AI Researcher – Multilingual Data
items.summary: About the RoleWe’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains.
items.description: About the Role We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains. You’ll own research and execution around data sourcing, curation, evaluation, and training strategies for multilingual and low-resource languages, with a strong emphasis on publishing high-quality research and translating it into production systems. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to the frontier: balancing papers, prototypes, and real-world impact in a fast-moving startup environment. What You’ll Do Design and execute research on multilingual datasets , including data collection, filtering, deduplication, and quality measurement Develop strategies for low-resource and long-tail languages (sampling, augmentation, curriculum design) Research and improve cross-lingual transfer , alignment, and robustness in large language models Build and maintain evaluation benchmarks for multilingual performance Collaborate with engineers and researchers on training pipelines and model architecture decisions Publish research at top venues (e.g., ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) and contribute to open-source when appropriate Translate research insights into practical improvements in production models What We’re Looking For Strong background in NLP / ML research , with a focus on multilingual or cross-lingual modeling Publication record at respected conferences or journals (ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.) Experience working with large-scale text datasets across multiple languages Solid understanding of: Tokenization and vocabulary design for multilingual models Data quality metrics, filtering, and dataset bias Transfer learning and multilingual representation learning Comfortable prototyping in Python with modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, etc.) Ability to operate independently and ship research in a startup pace environment Nice to Have Experience with low-resource languages or non-Latin scripts Open-source contributions in NLP or data tooling Experience training or evaluating large language models Familiarity with multilingual benchmarks (e.g., XTREME, FLORES, TyDi QA) Why Join Us Real ownership over research direction and impact A team that values papers and production Access to meaningful scale: large datasets, modern infrastructure, and fast iteration Competitive compensation and meaningful equity at an early stage Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Freelance Copywriter
items.summary: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy. About the Role Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including: Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands Skincare and beauty Tech and software Finance and investing Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability Education Home improvement Automobiles and motorcycles Health and wellness Medical and clinical fields Digital marketing SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply. Responsibilities Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team Qualifications Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content Portfolio featuring published work preferred Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred Compensation Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric. Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate Application Process Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

items.title: Content Reviewer - United States
items.summary: We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit. A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform. By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself. Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies. Service Rates The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Qualification path Qualification Process No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process. Basic Requirements • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English • Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States • Active use of Gmail and social media platforms • Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection • Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher) • Access to a personal computer Assessment You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

items.title: AI Response Evaluator
items.location: France, Japan, Turkey, Vietnam, Mexico, Norway
items.summary: iMerit is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing. Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match. What you will do Interpret conversational context and identify what the user really wanted Rate and rank responses against defined quality criteria Compare multiple answers and explain in writing why one wins Verify factual claims using approved research sources Flag tasks that cannot be reliably assessed rather than guessing What you bring: Strong critical thinking and sound judgment in ambiguous cases Solid research skills and attention to detail Excellent reading comprehension Self direction and the discipline to hit deadlines without supervision Good to know Independent contractor engagement for the length of the project. Fully remote and flexible. You choose your hours as long as volume and deadlines are met. Task volume varies with project demand.

items.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
items.summary: Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating. We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you. items.summary: About the role The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company. About Arabian Private Holdings Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets. What you will do Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment. Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations. Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies. Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals. Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates. Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized. Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews. Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports. What we are looking for A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving. Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors. Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English. Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors. Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review. A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics. How we work We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients. What the role offers A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market. Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates. Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region. The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote. Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health. Please mention the word **TRIVIALLY** and tag RNTIuMTY1LjIxMy4yMjY= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNTIuMTY1LjIxMy4yMjY=). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.description: (100% remote, anywhere in Europe) Are you excited about building ML systems that make predictions in real-time? Are you driven by building things end-to-end, from research to live systems? At GRID , we are building real-time prediction systems for competitive esports (CS2, Dota 2, League of Legends). Our models power live betting markets, producing continuously updated win probabilities, handicap lines, over/under totals, and specialty markets during matches. We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to lead the research, design, and continuous improvement of our core predictive models. You will be the driving force behind the math, statistical logic, and feature engineering that make our models highly accurate and profitable. You will tackle complex problems in high-frequency data, design rigorous backtesting frameworks, and work on bridging theoretical research and live product features. Requirements What you will do Lead Model R&D: Design, build, and optimise the machine learning models and statistical frameworks that power our real-time odds and betting markets. Advanced Feature Engineering: Extract deep predictive signals from raw, high-frequency esports telemetry, turning complex in-game mechanics into structured modelling features. Build state-of-the-art models: Focus on model performance and probability calibration. Design rigorous backtesting frameworks to prevent data leakage and evaluate performance against historical market baselines. Develop Market Logic: Create the mathematical rules and probabilistic derivations that translate baseline win probabilities into complex derivative markets (handicaps, totals, player props). Deploy real-time production systems: Ensure your models are seamlessly translated into production-grade pipelines and microservices. Your skills will include Required Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in data science, quantitative research, or statistical modelling. Advanced Mathematical Foundations: Deep, intuitive understanding of probability, statistics, and machine learning theory. Advanced Python Proficiency: Expert-level skills in the Python data stack. You write clean, production-grade code. Evaluation Expertise: Proven experience designing complex backtesting environments and defining custom evaluation metrics for unique business problems. Nice to Have Esports Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of competitive esports (CS2, Dota 2, LoL), the underlying game mechanics, and the competitive meta. High-Frequency/Real-Time Data: Experience modeling off streaming data or data that updates continuously over time. Software Engineering Basics: Understanding of modern MLOps principles and experience with tools like MLFlow, Airflow, etc. Highlights Passionate about real-time ML and esports? Join GRID as a Senior Data Scientist! Lead research and build predictive models powering live betting odds for CS2, Dota 2, and LoL. Apply now! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS - Brand Broker — IP Licensing
items.summary: Brand Broker — IP LicensingConsultancy to Broker IP Licensing Deals with Major Consumer Brands 1.
items.description: Brand Broker — IP Licensing Consultancy to Broker IP Licensing Deals with Major Consumer Brands 1. BACKGROUND & ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT Ubongo is Africa's leading edutainment company, producing educational media content loved by children and families across Sub-Saharan Africa. With a portfolio of instantly recognisable characters, Ubongo is positioned to generate significant revenue and impact through IP licensing partnerships. IP licensing presents a strategic opportunity for Ubongo to: (a) generate recurring non-grant revenue; (b) amplify brand visibility across consumer categories; (c) build long-term commercial partnerships with major regional and global brands; and (d) place educational, African-led content on everyday products that reach children in their homes, schools, and communities. Ubongo is seeking an experienced IP Brand Broker to identify, approach, negotiate, and close licensing agreements between Ubongo 's character IP and major consumer brands operating in Africa and internationally. This is a results-oriented, commission-based engagement with potential for ongoing retainer. 2. OBJECTIVES The Brand Broker will be expected to: Identify and qualify prospective licensee brands across target product categories and geographies Lead outreach and relationship development with brand decision-makers on Ubongo 's behalf Structure and negotiate licensing terms in line with Ubongo 's commercial objectives and rate card Close a minimum of 2–3 signed licensing agreements within the initial engagement period Build a pipeline of 10–15 qualified licensing prospects for ongoing pursuit Provide market intelligence on licensing trends, competitor activity, and new category opportunities 3. SCOPE OF WORK 3.1 Onboarding & Strategy Alignment (Weeks 1–2) Immerse in Ubongo 's IP portfolio, brand guidelines, character briefs, and existing commercial relationships Review and refine Ubongo 's target licensee criteria and geographic priorities Agree on target categories: apparel, toys & games, publishing, food & beverage, consumer goods, digital products, and others as identified Confirm deal structure preferences: royalty rates, minimum guarantees, exclusivity tiers, and approval processes Establish reporting cadence and deal pipeline tracking system 3.2 Prospecting & Outreach (Weeks 2–8 and ongoing) Research and develop a qualified target list of 30+ prospective licensee brands across agreed categories and geographical territories Execute proactive outreach to brand procurement, marketing, and licensing decision-makers Represent Ubongo at relevant licensing trade shows, industry events, and pitch meetings (costs agreed separately) Develop and deliver customised pitch materials leveraging Ubongo 's IP assets and audience data Track and report all prospect interactions in a shared CRM or pipeline tracker 3.3 Negotiation & Deal Closure Lead commercial negotiations on behalf of Ubongo , in close coordination with Ubongo 's legal and commercial team Secure term sheets and facilitate the finalisation of licensing agreements Ensure all agreed deals align with Ubongo 's brand guidelines, quality standards, and commercial objectives Coordinate with Ubongo 's legal team on contract execution 3.4 Pipeline Management & Reporting (Ongoing) Provide bi-weekly pipeline updates covering prospect status, deal stage, estimated value, and key next steps Submit a monthly summary report to Ubongo 's leadership Deliver a final engagement report at the end of the initial term with pipeline handover documentation 4. DELIVERABLES Deliverable 1: IP Licensing Strategy Memo: target categories, geographies, prospect criteria, and deal parameters (Week 2) Deliverable 2: Qualified Prospect List: minimum 30 brands with contact information, category, and rationale (Week 4) Deliverable 3: Pitch Deck & Materials: customised for major prospect categories (Week 3) Deliverable 4: Bi-weekly Pipeline Tracker: live updates throughout engagement Deliverable 5: Minimum 2 signed term sheets or executed licensing agreements within 6 months Deliverable 6: Monthly Summary Reports to Ubongo leadership Deliverable 7: Final Engagement Report with pipeline handover and recommendations (End of initial term) 5. ENGAGEMENT STRUCTURE & DURATION The engagement is structured as an initial 6-month term, with option to renew. Ubongo is open to the following commercial structures from proposers: Commission-only: percentage of signed deal value (typical range: 10–20% of first-year guaranteed revenues) Retainer plus commission: monthly retainer covering operational costs plus a lower commission rate Hybrid: reduced retainer with performance milestones tied to pipeline development and deal closure Proposers are invited to suggest their preferred commercial structure with full transparency on terms. Initial Term: 6 months from contract signing Renewal: Option for 6-month renewal by mutual agreement Expected Start: July 1st 2026 Operating Territories: Pan-Africa priority; diaspora markets and global considered 6. QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED Essential Requirements Minimum 8 years of experience in IP licensing, brand licensing, or commercial partnerships Demonstrated track record of successfully brokering and closing licensing agreements — provide verified examples Existing relationships with procurement, licensing, or marketing decision-makers at major consumer brands in Africa Strong negotiation skills and understanding of licensing deal structures, royalties, and minimum guarantees Ability to represent Ubongo professionally and passionately in high-stakes commercial conversations Highly Desirable Experience brokering children's entertainment or media IP licenses Network of contacts in toy & games, apparel, food & beverage, and publishing sectors Existing connections with licensing agents, retail chains, and consumer goods companies operating in Africa Experience at or with licensing industry bodies (LIMA/Licensing International) 7. EVALUATION CRITERIA Evaluation Criterion Weight Max Score Track Record: Deals Closed & Revenue Generated 35% 35 Existing Relationships & Network Relevance 25% 25 Commercial Proposal & Deal Structure 20% 20 Proposed Strategy & Target Categories 15% 15 References & Testimonials 5% 5 8. PROPOSAL REQUIREMENTS Proposals must include: Broker Profile: company/individual overview, credentials, and representative client list Track Record: verified list of at least 3 licensing deals brokered — including licensee, product category, deal value (or range), and outcome Proposed Strategy: target categories, geographies, outreach approach, and timeline for first deal closure Network Summary: overview of relevant existing relationships with major brands (brands need not be named if confidential) Commercial Proposal: clearly articulated fee structure (commission, retainer, or hybrid) with full transparency on terms References: minimum 2 client references from relevant licensing engagements 9. SUBMISSION DETAILS Submission Deadline: 19th June 2026 (EAT) Submission Method: Email to Subject Line: RFP Response: Brand Broker — IP Licensing Questions Deadline: 17th June 2026 Questions Contact: Ubongo values confidentiality and understands the sensitive nature of commercial networks. Proposers are not required to name specific brand contacts but should demonstrate the depth and relevance of their network. Equal Employment Opportunity UBONGO provides equal opportunities to all bidders and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by the laws of the country we are operating in. Job Scam Warning Our organization upholds a strict commitment to a fair, unbiased hiring process through BambooHR or very qualified recruitment agencies and shortlisting decisions are based solely on candidates' qualifications, skills and experience relevant to the position. Beware of any individuals claiming to have influence over our hiring decisions or requesting favors in exchange for guaranteed shortlisting or employment opportunities. Such actions are against our policies and do not reflect our organization's values. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Investment Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project
items.summary: Are you knowledgeable about investments and eager to shape the future of AI?
items.description: Are you knowledgeable about investments and eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from simple conversational tools into systems capable of analyzing financial markets, interpreting investment strategies, and supporting decision-making across asset classes. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can help improve financial literacy, strengthen portfolio analysis, and support investors and analysts worldwide. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI. We’re looking for individuals with familiarity in areas such as equity and fixed-income markets, portfolio management, asset allocation, derivatives, valuation methods, financial modeling, risk management, behavioral finance, and macroeconomic influences on markets. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics such as fundamental and technical analysis, portfolio construction, diversification strategies, market cycles, performance evaluation, and investment research—documenting failure modes so we can strengthen model reasoning and analytical accuracy. On a typical day, you will engage the model with investment scenarios, analytical questions, and market-based reasoning tasks; verify factual correctness and financial logic; assess the validity of investment reasoning; capture reproducible error traces; and provide structured feedback to improve prompts, evaluation frameworks, and analytical depth. You may also help identify where models oversimplify market behavior or misinterpret financial data. A background in finance, economics, accounting, business, or a related field is preferred but not required. Experience in asset management, brokerage, research, financial planning, or related roles is valuable, and entry-level candidates with foundational knowledge of investments and strong analytical skills are encouraged to apply. Clear, metacognitive communication—explicitly articulating reasoning and decision processes (“showing your work”)—is essential. Ready to turn your knowledge of investments into the knowledge foundation for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and help train systems that support investors, analysts, and financial professionals worldwide. We offer a pay range of $6 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly. Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product. As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product. You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions. With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results. You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries. Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build. What are we looking for in you? You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work. Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn . You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks. You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning . You think along, question things and keep building new solutions. You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset. You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test. You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework . Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus. You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies. You have a very good command of English , for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset. You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET , so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration. You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central. Twikey offers you: An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first. The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room. An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel! A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere. A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise , shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine. Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed! A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower. A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose. The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast! A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-senior-java-developer

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Wyoming, United States URL: http://orchard.co About Orchard 'Orchard' began as the in-house creator programme behind 'In Print We Trust'. That programme took the brand to over a billion views a month and the 13th most-mentioned fashion brand on TikTok UK, and put thousands of creators on contract. We have now launched it as a business in its own right, selling guaranteed organic views with product placement to brands. This is how brands grow now. Celsius, Bloom, Cal AI and Polymarket became big because thousands of creators had the product in their videos at the same time. The business is at multi six-figures in its first month operating from inbound. You'll build the sales side from scratch: pipeline, pricing, contracts, the first hires. About the role What brands buy is simple: a number of views, at one CPM, guaranteed. You'll take the machine and find every way it can be sold. Some we can see: white-label it to agencies; sell it to labels as sound seeding; sell it to retailers and CPG brands as launch momentum; sell managed supply to creator platforms in the markets they can't cover. Some we can't see, and that's where you step in. Perhaps you've got a way in at an AI lab that buys creator footage by the thousand hours, or another channel we aren't even aware of yet. This is a high-ownership opportunity to build/run sales/growth. So you need to have built revenue from a standing start before, at an agency, a platform or your own company, and have hired and run people who sell. Requirements You MUST be DTC/ecommerce/Meta native. You are comfortable being first: no marketing team, no SDR, a product whose packaging you will change. You have extreme agency and can be scrappy/inventive. You've personally closed $100K+ sized deals with agencies, brands or platforms, and you've hired or managed people who sell. Experience selling to SaaS, ecommerce, DTC, retail and founder-led companies. You know the UK and US agency and creator world well enough to get 20 meetings from your own contacts in month one. Benefits £65,000 - £95,000 base + commission Unlimited PTO 6% pension contribution Travel budget for meetings, US trips included Remote first, with a London desk when you want one To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/orchard-founding-head-of-sales

items.description: Summary ​The Vice President of Sales plays a vital role in building Lirio’s market traction within Lirio’s target market of regional and national health plans. This position can be located remotely and reports directly to the Chief Growth Officer. The Vice President of Sales will be responsible for uncovering new opportunities, generating pipeline, achieving sales goals, expanding existing accounts, building a world-class brand in-market, and partnering with internal departments to drive outcomes for Lirio’s prospects, clients, and partners.​​ The right candidate understands that healthcare enterprise sales are complex and will be able to demonstrate their experience in cultivating relationships with key executive decision-makers across multiple levels and functions to drive deals to close. We are looking for a strategic and creative contributor who understands that acting as a value-added partner is critical to the sale. We aren’t selling widgets - we’re fundamentally changing the way healthcare is delivered in the U.S. - so clearly demonstrating the ability to consultatively sell will be critical.​ This role requires 25-50% travel.​ Essential Job Duties Drive new sales with target Life Science accounts by developing strategies that drive top of funnel activity and efficiently moving prospects through each stage of the sales funnel to close Understand the network synergy between Life Science, health systems, payers, consultants, and other influencers and harnesses that influence to create leverage in driving deals forward Work cross-functionally internally to identify and solve gaps that will help move deals forward faster Generate interest in Lirio by building relationships with C-Level executives in target accounts. Update and maintain sales pipeline in company CRM (Salesforce). Responsible for earning a “trusted advisor” relationship with prospective clients by focusing on key issues and strategic initiatives, keeping Lirio relevant in the eyes of the executive team. Qualifications: 10+ years of relevant sales experience, preferably in earlier-stage virtual/digital health companies or as a clinician working with Life Science organizations Proven success at cultivating highly collaborative relationships across key account functions, including Product, Clinical, National Accounts, Network, Legal and more Experience selling AI/ML solutions at an early-stage healthcare technology company. Experience working with both SMB, Biotech and large Pharma Experience with complex contract negotiations within Life Science procurement processes. Comfortability working independently Superb project management, organizational, communication, meeting prep, and follow-up skills Strong public speaking skills and a willingness to present in front of large audiences when needed Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment A firm understanding and fluency in healthcare economics and trends, specifically across enterprise health systems and health plans Fluency in relationship-building, particularly with key decision-makers Ability to flex between virtual and in-person sales calls when necessary Prior experience with ZoomInfo, Hubspot & Salesforce preferred Benefits Medical (HSA available) Dental Vision Short-term & long-term disability (company-paid) Life & AD&D (company-paid) 401K with company match 10 paid holidays + holiday week company closure Flexible time off policy Work from home Estimated Salary Rage $180-200k base, + incentives

items.description: About GameChanger: We believe in the life-changing impact youth sports have on and off the field. Sports encourage leadership, teamwork, responsibility, and confidence – important life lessons that have the power to propel our youth toward meaningful futures. We recognize that without coaches, parents, and volunteers, organized youth sports could not exist. By building the first and best place to experience the youth sports moments important to our community, we are helping families elevate the next generation through youth sports. So if you love sports and their community-building potential, or building cool products is your sport, GameChanger is the team for you. We are a remote-first, dynamic tech company based in New York City, and we are solving some of the biggest challenges in youth sports today. The Position: We’re looking for a diligent, detail-oriented person to work with our Quality Assurance (QA) team & Release team to manually test new versions of our app before they are released to the public. Note: This role is a contract position that can be done remotely during and outside regular office hours. The expectation is up 20 hours a week, and will be paid at $22 an hour. What You’ll Do: Execute regression test cases on the Alpha & Beta versions of our app Execute regression test cases on staging version of website Execute feature test cases Responsible for documenting issues using a bug-tracking system Communicate issues found, concerns, and feedback to QA Team and Developers Be available to work every day during work hours for 4 to 6 hours per day Maintain existing test cases in Testrail by informing lead QAs when test cases are outdated so that they can be updated Who You Are: Experience using our apps Sports knowledge iOS / Android mobile platform familiarity Web familiarity Great communication skills Detail-oriented QA background We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. The target hourly rate for this position is $22 an hour. *DICK’S Sporting Goods has company-wide practices to monitor and protect us from compliance and monetary implications as it pertains to employer state tax liabilities. Due to said guidelines put in place, we are unable to hire in AK, DE, HI, IA, LA, MS, MT, OK, and SC. IMPORTANT NOTICE: All official recruitment communications from GameChanger will come from an email address ending in @gc.com and/or no-reply@ashby.hq.com. If you receive communication from any other domain, please be cautious, as it is likely fraudulent.

The ideal candidate is highly active and responsive, managing regional website updates, executing end-to-end campaigns, and serving as the primary point of contact for regional marketing technology (Martech) requests. items.description: Job Title Project Monitoring Officer Location Global Position Type Paid - Regular Job Description The Project Monitoring Officer plays a critical role in supporting SIL's expanding Resource Development strategy by ensuring the effective coordination, monitoring, and reporting of projects that support organizational and staff fundraising efforts. As SIL continues to grow its network of donors, grantors, and funding partners, this position serves as a central hub for collecting and managing project information, facilitating collaboration across departments, and ensuring that project proposals and reports meet the highest standards of quality, accuracy, and donor compliance. This globally focused role is responsible for overseeing the systematic collection, analysis, tracking, and reporting of project data to support grant management, fundraising initiatives, and strategic decision-making. The Project Monitoring Officer works closely with project leaders, fundraisers, and organizational stakeholders to develop compelling proposals, monitor project progress, measure outcomes, and provide timely reporting that strengthens donor relationships and demonstrates impact. Additionally, the position serves as a key liaison between SIL and ETEN Alliance, fostering strong partnership engagement, coordinating cross-functional initiatives, and ensuring alignment of shared goals and reporting requirements. The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, relationship-oriented, and motivated by supporting successful fundraising outcomes that enable SIL to advance its mission and expand its global impact. Responsibilities Project Intake, Proposal Development, and Stakeholder Coordination Serve as the primary point of contact for Areas, SCOs, and project leaders regarding project intake, proposal development, and reporting requirements. Manage project intake processes to ensure submitted projects have appropriate leadership endorsement, align with organizational priorities, demonstrate funding potential, and support measurable outcomes. Review and strengthen project concept notes, project descriptions, impact statements, and budgets to meet donor and funding partner expectations. Coordinate with project leaders and stakeholders to gather information necessary for proposal development and donor communications. Facilitate ongoing communication regarding project expectations, reporting requirements, accountability measures, and funding opportunities. Collaborate with internal departments to collect project stories, impact narratives, testimonials, and related content for donor reports, annual reports, websites, email campaigns, and stewardship communications. Project Registry and Reporting Management Maintain a comprehensive project registry and filing system that serves as the central repository for project information, proposals, reports, donor requirements, and related documentation. Manage project tracking systems, including funding coordination, proposal status, reporting schedules, and project documentation. Maintain reporting calendars and proactively communicate reporting deadlines to project leaders and funding recipients. Coordinate the collection, review, and submission of financial and narrative reports in accordance with donor agreements and organizational requirements. Support the development, formatting, editing, and distribution of project proposals and progress reports using approved organizational templates and standards. Ensure project files remain current, organized, and accessible to authorized stakeholders. Track donor requirements, reporting obligations, giving page support needs, and process improvements to enhance operational effectiveness. Funding Administration Support Coordinate project-related donation processing activities with gift administration and finance teams. Support accurate allocation of project funding, indirect cost recovery, and funding transfers. Maintain project funding records and update project tracking systems accordingly. Communicate project awards, funding decisions, reporting expectations, and compliance requirements to project recipients. Monitor project financial activity to support accurate reporting and donor accountability. Alliance Partnership Management Serve as a primary liaison between related partners. Maintain regular communication and engagement processes that support strong partner relationships and coordinated action. Represent SIL priorities, constraints, and outcomes in partnership discussions while ensuring partner expectations are clearly communicated internally. Establish and maintain systems to track funded activities, grant commitments, deliverables, and reporting obligations. Curate, validate, manage, and analyze project and operational data associated with funded activities. Generate reports, dashboards, and data insights to support grant reporting, organizational learning, performance evaluation, and strategic decision-making. Facilitate proposal development, grant reporting, project implementation tracking, and compliance monitoring across multiple departments and partner organizations. Ensure partnership commitments, deliverables, and reporting requirements are completed accurately and on schedule. Skills and Abilities Strong project coordination and project management capabilities while managing multiple priorities Excellent organizational, planning, and deadline-management skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders across multiple countries, cultures, and departments. Proficiency in preparing, editing, formatting, and reviewing proposals, reports, and project documentation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. Competence in data collection, tracking, reporting, and analysis. Demonstrated initiative, follow-through, and commitment to continuous improvement. Education Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Nonprofit Management or related field preferred Travel Requirements Occasional domestic and international travel may be required, including attendance at approved in-person meetings, training events, and partner engagements. Weekly Hours 40 Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Headquarters: Macedonia / Georgia / Moldova / Romania / Greece / Croatia / Kosovo / Serbia URL: http://belkins.io In 2017, Belkins started as an appointment-setting agency with just one service offering. Fast-forward to today, and we've transformed into Belkins Group — a vibrant ecosystem of services and products that define the cutting-edge landsc
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Macedonia / Georgia / Moldova / Romania / Greece / Croatia / Kosovo / Serbia URL: http://belkins.io In 2017, Belkins started as an appointment-setting agency with just one service offering. Fast-forward to today, and we've transformed into Belkins Group — a vibrant ecosystem of services and products that define the cutting-edge landscape of the SalesTech and MarTech industries. For seven years running, we’ve been the top appointment-setting agency, achieving amazing results across 50+ industries worldwide. Our results speak for themselves: with over 1,000 clients and a global portfolio, we’ve set up more than 200,000 appointments, delivering a $10 return for every $1 spent. We’re experts in B2B appointment setting, providing essential services for companies ready to take their growth to the next level. By diving deep into lead research and using customized, omnichannel strategies, we turn opportunities into real success. Joining Belkins means signing up for a journey of unstoppable growth and success, driven by curiosity, dedication, and a commitment to excellence. We are looking for a results-driven SDR to join our intake pod - the team that runs new clients through their first three months at Belkins. Each pod is built around an Account Strategist who owns client strategy through the pilot, supported by a Delivery Lead, Content Strategist, Researcher, and Email Deliverability Specialist. This structure means the technical side of outreach is handled for you - your focus is on calling and converting prospect responses into booked appointments. You will work across multiple pilot-stage client projects at once (typically 3-4), running high-volume cold calling via power dialer and personally managing all replies from automated email and LinkedIn campaigns. Because every account is brand new, the meetings you book in the first weeks carry extra weight - they're often a client's first real proof that the engagement is working. Things You’ll Be Doing: Cold Calling Running outbound calling campaigns via power dialer (Koncert) across multiple (3-4) pilot-stage client projects at once - every account brand-new, so there's no history to lean on and no slow ramp-up; Handling objections live, on the call, and steering each conversation toward a booked appointment, not just working through a script; Tracking connect rate and call-to-meeting conversion, flagging performance issues to your Account Strategist before they become a pattern - with only three months on the clock, a slow week can't go unnoticed. Reply Handling — Email & LinkedIn Personally owning every reply that comes in from automated email (Reply.io / Inbox AI) and LinkedIn (Expandi) campaigns -responding within 4–8 working hours, handling objections in writing, and nurturing prospects until they convert into confirmed meetings; Scheduling appointments and sharing meeting details with the team via Slack. Campaign Oversight & Reporting Monitoring key metrics across every project - connect rate, reply rate, conversion rate - as your own numbers, not someone else's dashboard. Feeding structured feedback to Research, Content, and EDS so lead quality and messaging actually improve, not just flagging that something isn't working. Keeping CRM hygiene tight in HubSpot and sharing a weekly recap your Account Strategist can actually use. What You Bring: 2+ years of outbound SDR experience with a strong cold calling background ; Fluent English - written and spoken - comfortable working across US and European time zones; Metrics-driven: you track your dials, connect rates, and conversion numbers and know how to improve them; Strong objection handling and a consistent track record of landing next steps; Comfortable working brand-new accounts with no track record yet, and able to manage multiple pilot-stage client projects in parallel without losing quality or pace; Reliable CRM hygiene and disciplined follow-up across all open threads; Self-starting and proactive - you hold your pace without needing external pressure. How We Hire: Recruiter Interview (~30 minutes) — with Yuliia or Inna. Practical Task (~60–90 minutes) — a written exercise covering outbound thinking, objection handling, and lead prioritization. Hiring Manager Interview (~45–60 minutes) — a conversation with the SDR Enablement Manager covering the details of your work, performance analytics, and a live cold-call roleplay. Final Interview (~60 minutes) — with the Managing Director and HR Business Partner to assess company fit and explore your values and working style. Offer & Onboarding — if it's a yes, we move fast. *We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process. Final decisions are made by humans. Contact us for information on data processing. At Belkins, we care deeply about our team members, and we prove it through: Competitive Pay: Your dedication deserves more than recognition; it deserves compensation that matches your expertise. Remote-First Flexibility: We’ve transitioned to a fully remote environment so you can work where you're most productive. Our flexible hours help you stay agile and focused. Professional Growth: We’re a launchpad for your career. Through regular feedback, 1:1s, internal mobility, and knowledge-sharing, your growth is enabled and celebrated. We also maintain an internal wiki for insights and a library of the latest business books to keep you sharp. Well-being focus: Your mental health is a priority. We offer mental health lectures and support for your overall well-being. Recharge Time: We prioritize your rest with 20 paid vacation days, parental leave, fully covered sick days, and unlimited days off for unexpected needs. Global Sync: We align with U.S. holidays to keep our global teams in sync. Memorable Team Experiences: Work hard, play hard — even from a distance. Our online team-building events and all-hands gatherings bring humor, memes, and a lively atmosphere that makes teamwork genuinely fun. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/belkins-sales-development-representative-intake-pod

Schedule, organize and facilitate client campaign initiatives across all agency channels; hold regular internal meetings to effectively guide client conversation to ensure clarity and productivity. Communicate with clients on a regular basis including weekly or monthly calls to review campaign performance, recommending omni-channel marketing strategies and campaign optimizations to continuously improve results. Oversee implementation, delivery, and execution of program promise; manage client expectations by providing timing and budget implications of scope change requests. Oversee forecasting, invoicing, scope management, and overall account profitability while ensuring financial performance aligns with agency goals. Maintain and improve account profitability through effective forecasting, resource planning, scope management, and identification of organic growth opportunities. Develop cross-channel insights and recommendations to solve larger business problems and improve key performance metrics; organize logistics for, narrative and key insights for quarterly and annual business reviews. Strong understanding of data and data insights to allow for testing strategies in audience identification, channel selection, and creative messaging. Core responsibility to collaborate and oversee agency standards on key marketing service deliverables for mid to large agency accounts in the form of PowerPoints, POV’s and performance reports from excel to dashboard technologies to optimize, retain or upsell business. Identify, develop, and help close strategic upsell and cross-sell opportunities in partnership with Sales and agency leadership when appropriate. Demonstrate curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning within the evolving data-driven marketing landscape. Who you are: 8 years + experience managing digital marketing programs, with proven results in Paid Search, SEO and/or social media initiatives. 4+ years of financial services experience required (including banking or credit unions), from either client-side or vendor/agency-side work. 4+ years of experience in agency environment required. Demonstrated excellence in building and maintaining profitable client relationships. Experienced in compiling, documenting, and communicating client requirements to internal stakeholders (in digital marketing, direct mail or creative services). Must have experience overseeing implementation or managing and executing multi-channel marketing campaigns as main client point of contact. Experience managing, training, and developing a growing group of direct reports; effectively delegating tasks and responsibilities to increase team capacity. Strong written and verbal communication skills, a positive attitude, and the ability to thrive in a collaborative and fast-paced environment. Ability to influence others, both with the client and within the internal Amsive organization. Strong grasp and demonstrated application of marketing and communication principles. Strong project management and organization skills, ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and inspire trust with team members; experience using Asana preferred. Strong understanding of applying data and insights for use in audience, channel and creative testing strategies. This includes but is not limited to the use of predictive modeling and segmentation to optimize both campaign results and a learning agenda. Advanced knowledge of web analytics and digital marketing tools, including Google Analytics and Google Ads Keyword Planner preferred. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially PowerPoint and Excel. Future-minded individual with a strong desire to contribute to an emerging leader in the omni-channel marketing space.
