items.title: Travel Expert | Reviewer
items.summary: We’re recruiting Travel professionals and experienced trip planners to review and improve realistic travel scenarios used to train AI travel assistants.
items.description: We’re recruiting Travel professionals and experienced trip planners to review and improve realistic travel scenarios used to train AI travel assistants. Your job isn’t to “write itineraries.” It’s to think like a real trip planner and spot what makes a travel situation real, feasible, and decision-changing — then upgrade weak scenarios so they actually test the model. ‼️ AI is not allowed. If we spot AI use, we’ll block the application. ⚠️ This application form must be completed entirely in English. 🚨 READ ALL THE DESCRIPTION BELOW TO UNDERSTAND THE APPLICATION FORM. WHO CAN APPLY Travel professionals and experienced trip planners 3+ years of relevant travel planning experience (professional or high-volume personal) English level: Advanced / Fluent (required) WHAT YOU’LL DO IN THE APPLICATION (QUICK SCREENING TEST) You will review two pre-generated travel tasks . For each task, you’ll answer simple 1–5 ratings and give a short justification. Then, for the 2nd task , you’ll rewrite it to make it stronger . WHAT “STRONG” MEANS (SIMPLE DEFINITION) A strong task includes one decisive feasibility constraint that can flip the plan if ignored (missed train, missed check-in, closed attraction, wrong station, etc.). We call this a Knife : A Knife is a constraint that changes what itinerary is actually viable . Quick test: if you remove it, the “best plan” would meaningfully change. Examples of Knives in Travel Last train / last entry / check-in cutoff times Closures and holidays that change what’s possible Ambiguous locations (airport/station names that can be confused) Sequential dependencies (if A slips, B becomes impossible) Mobility constraints that change routing feasibility WHAT YOU WILL RATE (1–5) IN THE FORM You’ll give 3 ratings per task: Overall Quality (1–5) How clear and testable the task is (can you judge PASS/FAIL)? Knife / Hidden Context Strength (1–5) Is there a decisive feasibility constraint — or is the “hidden context” just extra color that doesn’t change the plan? Checklist Quality (1–5) Does the checklist truly test feasibility + the Knife with clear criteria? (Strong checklists include verification steps and forbid inventing logistics, written as PASS/FAIL — not “be helpful.”) You’ll also write a short justification (2–4 bullets) explaining your ratings. WHAT YOU WILL REWRITE (FOR THE 2ND TASK ONLY) You will rewrite these parts to make the task stronger: Scenario (3rd person) — more realistic + naturally sets up the feasibility risk Prompt (user message) — natural, human, does not reveal the Knife Hidden Context (1–3 bullets) — must include exactly 1 decisive Knife Checklist (4–6 items) — each item must be PASS/FAIL, covering: feasibility/verification (minimum unknowns to check) the Knife (the decision-flipping constraint) no invented logistics (no made-up schedules/hours/availability) branching plan (Plan A / Plan B) when feasibility depends on one missing answer safety only when there is real risk Checklist item example: PASS if it flags what must be verified (tickets/hours/cutoffs) before committing; FAIL if it confidently invents times or availability. Important: Don’t “leak” the Knife in the prompt (no “IMPORTANT”, no all-caps, no “the key detail is…”). IF SELECTED (PROJECT WORK) You’ll review batches of pre-generated travel scenarios: Rating realism and feasibility risk Identifying weak or missing constraints (Knives) Improving tasks so they better represent real travel moments where wrong advice causes missed connections, wasted money, or ruined plans COMPENSATION Payment will be US$ 30 per approved task, converted and paid in your local currency. Each task takes approximately 40 minutes, which corresponds to an effective rate of about US$ 45 per hour. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR You can recognize what’s realistic vs. generic in travel planning You understand what truly flips feasibility (cutoffs, closures, dependencies, ambiguous locations) You can upgrade a “fine” scenario into a strong feasibility test without making it artificial Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Keep Growing with Nutrafol We’re a growing company. Everything we do, we do to help people grow into the best version of themselves. As the pioneers of hair wellness, we create clinically tested products for hair growth and provide support for people at every step of their hair journey. Our multi-factorial approach targets key root causes of hair thinning using a patented blend of standardized vitamins, minerals and natural ingredients – and is recommended by over 7,500 physicians and hair professionals for trusted, reliable results. We never settle, and are continuously challenging existing treatments and methodologies to advance the frontier of hair science. As we help our customers grow, we grow too – by embracing individuality and differences, leading by example, and empowering ourselves and others with our passion for wellness and innovation. Keep growing. It’s our mantra. Our commitment to helping anybody and everybody committed to realizing their own potential to grow. About You: The Director, Brand Marketing, Nutrafol will build and launch the brand story for new product innovations! Nutrafol is the #1 dermatologist-recommended hair growth supplement brand and the pioneer of the hair wellness category. We’re in the process of developing new product innovation that extends our focus from the inside-out to the outside-in. Your job is to make the range unmistakably Nutrafol - why it exists, who it’s for, how it fits the routine she’s already in, and why she should believe it works. You’ll set strategy within the Nutrafol masterbrand platform, reporting to the SVP, Brand. You’ll partner closely with Product Development, who owns formulation, claims substantiation, and the Unilever R&D and Supply relationship. You bring the consumer into that work: the insight that shapes what we make and the plan that gets it into her hands. This is a builder’s role. You’ll start six to twelve months ahead of launch, while formulation is underway and the range is still taking shape - early enough that your read on the consumer changes what we make. Responsibilities: Brand and Consumer Own the brand strategy, positioning, and narrative, and make sure it strengthens the Nutrafol masterbrand rather than sitting beside it Hold the deepest understanding of the consumer - where she overlaps with the supplement customer, where she doesn’t, and what she’s already buying and believing Run the primary and secondary research that answers those questions; turn competitive and category analysis into a point of view, not a deck Identify the insights and tensions that shape both the launch and the next wave of innovation Own naming for the range and individual SKUs, working with Creative, with Legal and Product Development holding sign-off on trademark availability and claims risk Product Partnership Bring consumer insight and brand POV into the product pipeline - feed the proposition, format, and range decisions that Product Development owns Deliver a ranked consumer-priority claims input ahead of study protocol design, so Product Development and R&D can prioritize what gets tested and substantiated Own how approved claims show up in market — which ones lead, how they’re expressed, how they ladder to the story Shape the launch range and wave sequencing as a required consumer input into Product Development’s range recommendation Protect the brand across every consumer-facing touchpoint, holding the line on the dermatologist-recommended credibility and the subscription model that built us Launch and Go-To-Market Build the launch plan across DTC, Amazon, and Pro in partnership with Growth, Marketplaces, CX, and Pro Marketing Accountable for launch readiness and in-market performance against the agreed product availability date, which Product Development owns Own new product innovation pricing above an agreed margin floor set annually with Finance Lead the annual and quarterly brand plan for new product innovation, with clear priorities and a roadmap the cross-functional team can work from Brief and collaborate with Creative; lead ideation on campaign, content, and social narrative Set the brand direction for partnerships, collaborations, and any external voices attached to the range Manage the new product innovation brand marketing budget Leadership without authority Keep a cross-company group moving to one plan - and know which decisions are yours, which are Product’s, and which need both Own the consumer, positioning, and go-to-market sections of Unilever leadership updates, delivered from one shared plan alongside Product Development Give clear, executive-ready updates to Nutrafol leadership Surface risks and dependencies early rather than reporting them after the fact Track performance post-launch and use what you learn to sharpen the range and inform what comes next Build trust fast across teams who’ve never worked on a launch like this Requirements: 8–12 years of brand management, brand marketing, or innovation marketing at a high-growth brand; hair care, beauty, or science-led consumer health preferred. DTC experience is required Track record taking a product from concept to market alongside R&D, regulatory, and supply chain - you don’t need to have run formulation, but you need to know how to be a good partner to the people who do Proven ability to build integrated brand strategies and launch campaigns across digital, social, CRM, retail media, and direct response Strong commercial and go-to-market instincts across DTC, e-commerce, and omnichannel, including pricing Comfortable at the seam between an entrepreneurial brand and a large matrixed organization, and able to align partners across both without formal authority Fluent in segmentation and in both quantitative and qualitative consumer insight Sharp judgment on claims, positioning, and premium experience Entrepreneurial and self-directed - you’ll be hands-on doing the work, not just directing it Exceptional written and verbal communication Low ego, high ownership, and the kind of energy that makes a dispersed team want to be in the room Nutrafol takes into consideration a wide range of factors in final compensation decisions, including but not limited to: skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, qualifications and education, and other business and organizational needs. The listed range is applicable only to the annual base salary and does not include additional perks, benefits, or applicable bonus eligibility comprising the total compensation package. Salary Range: $160,000—$180,000 USD Perks & Benefits Fully remote work experience Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision package, including FSA program 401K with employer match Quarterly Bonus Program Flexible PTO Two company-wide wellness breaks every day Free lunch on us every Tuesday and Thursday via Seamless/Grubhub Monthly wellness stipend Monthly internet stipend Monthly cell phone stipend Annual learning & development stipend Free meditation app membership (Headspace) Free Nutrafol subscription Pet insurance discounts and benefits California residents may review our CCPA notice here.

You will work closely with enterprise-level customers helping translate complex technical ideas into clear, compelling messaging for global audiences. This role is ideal for a writer who enjoys turning strategic insights into powerful creative ideas while crafting high-performing copy across digital platforms.

items.title: Lead Creative Strategist (Performance Marketing)
items.summary: Superside is hiring a Creative Strategist, Performance Marketing to lead the strategic thinking behind our clients' highest-volume, highest-velocity creative programs. You'll sit at the intersection of data and creative, turning performance signals from paid social, OOH, and programmatic campaigns into sharp, testable creative direction — while acting as a trusted strategic partner to the clients whose business results depend on it. You'll run strategy across a portfolio of accounts at once, each producing a high volume of creative every month, and you'll be the person both the client and the creative team turn to when they need to know not just what to make next, but why.

items.title: Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst
items.summary: Position Type : Full-time Location: Philippines (Remote) Schedule: Mon-Fri, EST About the Company Our client is a global leader in swimming pool technology, specializing in robotic pool cleaners, pool safety products, water treatment solutions, and related pool equipment for residential and commercial customers. With a strong international presence and a network of distributors, subsidiaries, and partners across multiple markets, our client serves customers worldwide through a variety of sales and distribution channels. About the Role Our client is looking for a Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst to monitor online marketplaces and digital channels across North America and Europe. The role focuses on identifying unauthorized sellers, marketplace and distribution violations, misuse of brand assets, and other compliance issues. You will conduct online research, analyze seller and product data, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports that provide actionable insights to the business. Responsibilities Monitor Amazon, eBay, Walmart, BestBuy, Home Depot, AliExpress, Temu, and other major marketplaces. Research products and identify new or unauthorized sellers. Classify sellers and verify their authorization status. Identify MAP, distribution, territory, and marketplace compliance issues. Monitor unauthorized use of logos, images, trademarks, and product content. Collect evidence such as URLs, screenshots, seller information, and product details. Maintain accurate seller databases and internal records. Prepare daily reports and monthly Voice of Consumer reports. Build and maintain dashboards tracking brand-protection metrics. Identify opportunities to improve research and reporting processes. Competencies and Qualifications Must-Have 3+ years of experience in data analysis, online research, e-commerce, compliance, or a related field. Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables. Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy. Strong written English and reporting skills. Ability to work independently and follow SOPs. Familiarity with Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces. Nice-to-Have Brand protection or marketplace compliance experience. Experience with PROWL, Helium 10, Salesforce, or similar tools. Knowledge of MAP, distribution, or channel compliance. Experience with dashboards and reporting. Experience using AI research and translation tools. Key Qualities Detail-oriented Analytical Investigative Highly organized What We Offer 100% Remote Work â Work from anywhere in the Philippines. Career Growth Opportunities â Gain hands-on experience, and continuous learning. Collaborative & Innovative Team â Work alongside skilled professionals who value excellence. Application Process We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and weâre here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible. The interview process includes a Recruiter Interview, Client Interview, and Assessment. As part of the process, candidates complete a hands-on task during the technical interview. Throughout each stage, we keep you informed and provide feedback as quickly as possible, ensuring you feel valued and supported throughout your journey with us. items.description: HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com , General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024). HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations. HackerOne Values HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is Customer Obsessed and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We Default to Disclosure by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners Win Together by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability. Vice President, Go-To-Market (GTM) Operations Remote Location: Boston, MA; Seattle, WA; San Francisco Bay Area; Austin, TX; or Washington, DC Position Summary HackerOne, a global leader in security solutions, is transforming into an AI-native, product-driven company — and our go-to-market engine must evolve accordingly. We are seeking a strategic and systems-oriented VP of Go-to-Market Operations to lead the transformation and build of a modern, intelligence-powered revenue organization. The Vice President Go-to-Market Operations will architect the operating system that powers HackerOne transformation - connecting strategy, data, AI, and execution to create a predictable, scalable, and efficient revenue engine. Revenue Operations, GTM Strategy, Commissions, Revenue Enablement, and GTM Systems functions are within the scope of the VP. Reporting to the CEO, and as a key member of the Revenue Leadership Team, you will be responsible for building an AI-first operating infrastructure that connects strategy to execution through data, automation, and predictive insight. You will move the organization from reactive reporting to real-time revenue intelligence — embedding AI into forecasting, territory design, pipeline management, and productivity optimization. The ideal candidate has led organizational transformation at scale and designed systems that create durable operating leverage high-growth SaaS or cybersecurity environments. This is not simply a process optimization role — it is a mandate to reimagine how revenue teams operate in an AI-native enterprise. At HackerOne, we embrace a Flexible Work approach that gives us the freedom to do our best work while also fostering the connections and community that make us stronger. Reflecting this philosophy, this is a remote role targeted for candidates within ~50 miles of Boston, MA; Seattle, WA; San Francisco Bay Area; Austin, TX; or Washington, DC. We believe this balance of proximity and flexibility gives Hackeronies the chance to occasionally come together – fostering collaboration, connection, and in-person moments that enrich our culture – while still preserving the benefits of remote work. What You Will Do Architect an AI-Native Revenue Operating Model Design and implement a scalable, AI-enabled GTM operating framework that transforms out GTM motion and drives predictable growth. Institutionalize AI-driven workflows across pipeline management, forecasting, territory planning, and customer lifecycle orchestration Embed automation and intelligence into systems, dashboards, and daily operating rhythms Establish global standards for data hygiene, tooling adoption, and workflow consistency Build the infrastructure to enable a global enterprise focused revenue organization in a product value and data-centric motion Transformational Leadership & Planning Lead transformation initiatives around revenue planning, pricing, process improvement and enablement across the organization Partner with Finance and Revenue leadership to drive long-range and annual planning, including quota design, territory alignment, capacity modeling, and incentive optimization Translate corporate strategy into measurable GTM execution plans Work with product leadership to operationalize pricing and packaging and enablement to support evolving product strategy and optimize revenue performance Design commission and incentive structures that reward value creation, product adoption, and long-term customer success Revenue Intelligence & Predictive Analytics Elevate Revenue Operations into a forward-looking intelligence engine: Implement predictive forecasting models leveraging AI and advanced analytics Build executive-level dashboards that connect pipeline health, win rates, sales velocity, CAC, LTV, and retention to strategic outcomes Drive scenario planning and sensitivity modeling to inform strategic decisions Establish leading indicators for growth, churn risk, and expansion opportunities Institutionalize data-driven insights and decision-making across Sales, Customer Success, Channel, and Marketing Operational Excellence & Systems Architecture Own the GTM systems roadmap (CRM, analytics platforms, AI tooling) Modernize and integrate revenue tech stack for scalability, interoperability, and automation Optimize end-to-end revenue processes to reduce friction and increase productivity Ensure operational readiness for strategic initiatives including new product launches, pricing changes, and international expansion Drive operational rigor in forecasting cadence, QBRs, and weekly revenue rhythms Revenue Enablement & Productivity Lead cross-functional enablement execution with Sales, PMM, and Product to align enablement initiatives with product strategy and market positioning Institutionalize a data-informed enablement roadmap tied to measurable productivity outcomes Ensure sales methodology and value-based selling frameworks are reinforced through analytics and coaching tools Develop performance scorecards that empower frontline leaders with actionable insights Outcomes & Impact Success in this role will be defined by: Revenue forecast accuracy ±5% Higher ARR per seller/ Improved pipeline conversion Shorter, more efficient sales cycles Increased pipeline conversion and improved retention/expansion rates A single executive revenue dashboard used consistently by the ELT and Board Minimum Qualifications 12+ years of experience in strategic and revenue operations, including 5+ years leading Global GTM Operations Proven experience scaling GTM operations in high-growth SaaS or cybersecurity companies Demonstrated success modernizing revenue tech stacks and embedding AI or advanced analytics into GTM workflows Domain knowledge in revenue operations, GTM strategy, marketing operations, and incentive design Strong financial acumen with experience in capacity modeling, forecasting, and IPO readiness Exceptional analytical rigor with ability to translate complex data into strategic insight Exceptional first-principles problem-solving Executive presence and experience influencing C-level and Board stakeholders Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred Preferred Qualifications Experience operating in AI-native or product-led growth environments Experience building predictive You'll also lead and scale the QA program that measures their success. It's fast-moving work inside a practice built with modern, AI-powered tools. What You’ll Do Care protocols. Write, update, and refine the clinical protocols behind Wheel's care programs. Integrate them across all our partners, scale them effectively, and translate them into the logic our platform runs on. Quality Assurance. Lead Wheel's clinical QA program. Integrate AI to enable further scale, and turn its findings into feedback the network can act on. Outcomes and iteration. Develop the frameworks and procedures that track patient and clinical outcomes across these care programs, and use that data to improve care over time. Patient safety. Manage clinical patient-safety escalation protocols and active escalations, keeping Wheel's clinical standards consistent and on target. Who You Are MD or DO from an accredited institution, board-certified in Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, or Emergency Medicine. Primary care experience preferred. Substantial clinical practice experience, including virtual care or telemedicine. Prior clinical leadership experience managing teams directly in telehealth, digital health, or a high-volume virtual practice. Hands-on experience with clinical quality assurance — building, running, or auditing a QA program. Experience authoring and maintaining clinical protocols. Basic proficiency with AI tools & software You're energized by where medicine is heading — new evidence, new modalities, new models of care — and you want to help build the next version of it. You want to work closely with product and engineering as clinical tooling gets built. You reach for the data. You're at home reasoning from dashboards, cohorts, and outcomes, and you'd rather measure than guess. Active medical license in good standing in one or more states. Able to pass NCQA credentialing and Wheel's standardized background checks. Nice to have Don't let these stand in your way—they’re just added bonuses! If you meet most of the core requirements, we encourage you to apply. Experience integrating AI or automation into clinical quality or protocol workflows. Comfort with EHR configuration, clinical decision support, or point-of-care tooling. Multi-state licensure. ABOM Certification or expertise in cardio-metabolic conditions. Salary and Perks Pay Range: $250,000 - $290,000 plus a 15% bonus. items.summary: About MonetizeMoreMonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally.
items.description: About MonetizeMore MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration . We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on. About the Role The company is seeking an experienced, systems-driven Business Operations Manager to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end-to-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes. The Business Operations Manager will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data- and AI-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems. Core Responsibilities 1. Process Kaizen & SOP Governance Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented. 2. Project Management & Visibility Own and maintain BE's project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond BE, building the foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into BL L10s. 3. Product Rollout Support Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go-live. Work closely with the incoming Group PM to formalize this process as a repeatable model. 4. Cross-Departmental & Enterprise Client Enablement Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross-functional commitments visible and actioned. 5. Data & Spreadsheet Management Own data pulls and spreadsheet-based reporting for BE initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable models that others can use without re-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role, not incidental. Who You Are The Experienced Operator: You have 4+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high-data-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC). The Systems Builder: You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably. Data- and AI-Fluent: You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work. Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process. Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly. What We Offer True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle. Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!
items.description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About the role The CFO’s mission is to continue building upon Grüns ' already strong finance and data function — evolving it into a best-in-class engine that empowers the entire organization to make faster, smarter decisions. Leading a team of three strong leaders, this role is about leading the strong teams below them to democratize financial intelligence across the Grüns organization: self-serve dashboards, on-demand reporting, and real-time visibility that puts decision-making power in the hands of every team member. The CFO is a relentless, collaborative business partner, never satisfied with where the business is on revenue scale or profitability, always pushing for the next point of EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and driving efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. They will ensure Grüns scales with confidence while meeting all external requirements seamlessly in the background. This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL. What success looks like: If we look ahead a year from now, the right person in this role would have: Leveraged what we’ve built so far, found areas for improvement, and fully operationalized a goal accountability framework that keeps business initiatives tied to financial outcomes, ensuring the leadership team is consistently tracking toward revenue and profitability targets. Driven meaningful EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and improved LTV:CAC efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. Delivered self-serve dashboards, templatized reporting, and real-time P&L visibility across functions so every team has the data access they need without relying on ad-hoc requests. Business decisions are democratized and exponentially quicker. Created the conditions for a high-performing, motivated team empowering vs. micromanaging, actively developing leaders, and driving strong results and performance without burnout. Built the systems and processes to meet all external reporting and compliance requirements seamlessly, keeping the team focused on growth. We're looking for someone with: Relentless Growth Mindset: Always asking what it takes to get to the next level, whether that's another point of margin, better efficiency, or a faster path to revenue growth - a genuine internal drive to make the business the best it can be. Finding new opportunities across the business and proposing these opportunities to the CEO and functional leads. Integrity and Business-First Thinking: Prioritizes the truth over “looking good”. Navigates competing stakeholder interests honestly and thoroughly rather than taking the path of least resistance. Empowering Leadership: Leads by giving people the tools, clarity, and confidence to make great decisions vs. controlling the work directly. Actively develops their functional leaders, makes their team better than they were before. Drives sustainable high performance. Paper Wall Pusher: Treats perceived constraints as hypotheses, not facts. When told something takes six weeks or "this is how it's done," they ask why and push for faster, smarter, or different. Actively hunts for process bloat and inherited ways of working to find improvements. AI-Native Operator: Uses AI natively in their own workflow and actively builds AI fluency into the team's operating model. Sees AI as a core lever for scaling the function's impact without scaling headcount. Direct, but kind: Direct and honest in every conversation, saying what needs to be said, even when it's uncomfortable. Deeply committed to the business and the people in it. Experience: 10+ years leadership experience in a high-growth, profitable businesses; some level of physical inventory experience (CPG, retail, e-commerce, or similar) is a must Experience leading the functions in scope - finance, accounting, data, and BizOps functions Experience within a high-growth company that is adapting to public company practices Compensation & Benefits: At Grüns , we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary is $350,000 + incentive compensation, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team. A bit about us... At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you. Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all. So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious. What we care about... Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation. Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: All Other Remote Headquarters: Remote - USA At Counterpart Health (CPH), we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant (CA). By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions. We're seeking a Commercial Partnerships & Operations Director to shape and drive key commercial initiatives and strategic partnerships. Reporting to the VP of Commercial Innovations & Partnerships, you'll partner closely with CPH leadership, owning a portfolio of high-impact initiatives and external partnerships. This role is a senior individual contributor who is a highly organized, analytical, and execution-focused operator who can move fluidly between the details of execution and the strategic context, bringing forward recommendations and insights that shape leadership decisions. You'll lead cross-functional programs, keep priorities on track, align stakeholders, manage external relationships, and deliver the insights and materials needed to support strategic decisions and accelerate Counterpart Health's growth and execution capabilities. As a Commercial Partnerships & Operations Director, you will: Lead high-priority commercial initiatives: Own the execution of high priority cross-functional programs by defining project plans, tracking milestones, mitigating risks, resolving dependencies, and ensuring timely delivery of strategic outcomes. Drive cross-functional execution: Lead efforts across Commercial, Product, Engineering, Clinical, Operations, Legal, and external partners to align stakeholders, maintain momentum, and deliver on commitments. Manage strategic partnerships: Own key external partnerships by establishing governance, aligning strategic objectives, driving executive engagement, resolving risks, and ensuring successful execution throughout the partnership lifecycle. Deliver business insights: Develop and lead analytical models, dashboards, and performance trackers to monitor results, generate insights, and inform commercial decision-making. Prepare executive communications: Develop executive-level presentations, reports, and recommendations that frame strategic options, clarify tradeoffs, and guide decisions by leadership and external partners. Strengthen program execution: Translate enterprise commercial priorities into actionable plans with defined owners, timelines, deliverables, and accountability while proactively identifying and resolving execution risks. Enhance operational effectiveness: Design and implement scalable processes, tools, templates, and reporting mechanisms that improve coordination, visibility, and execution across the Commercial Innovations & Partnerships team. Serve as a trusted operator: Serve as a trusted commercial advisor by anticipating enterprise risks, challenging assumptions, recommending solutions, and maintaining alignment across multiple high-stakes initiatives. Success in this Role Looks Like: In the first 90 days: Build a strong understanding of CPH's commercial strategy, products, partnerships, and operating model. Establish relationships across internal teams and external partners. Take ownership of key initiatives and establish greater strategic clarity, accountability, visibility, and execution discipline. In the first 6 months: Independently own a portfolio of commercial initiatives and strategic partnership workstreams. Implement effective project management processes and reporting frameworks.Deliver high-quality analyses and recommendations that influence executive decision-making and drive progress. At the end of your first year: Become a trusted execution partner to the VP of Commercial Innovations & Partnerships and the CPH leadership team. Successfully lead multiple complex initiatives from planning through execution.Strengthen partnership performance, enhance cross-functional execution, and scale the Commercial Innovations & Partnerships function. You should get in touch if: 6–10 years of experience in healthcare consulting, a healthcare technology company, or a similar execution-focused role in a high-growth healthcare organization. Strong preference for candidates with experience in Medicare, Medicare Advantage, value-based care, payer-provider dynamics, healthcare operations, and roles such as business operations, program management, partnerships, or cross-functional execution. Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and competing priorities; experience in a Project Management Office (PMO) or dedicated program management role is a plus. Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with a track record of bringing structure, accountability, and execution to complex initiatives. Experience managing external partner or customer relationships, including coordinating meetings, driving follow-ups, and ensuring successful execution. Strong analytical skills with advanced proficiency in AI tools, Excel, and Google Sheets, including experience building financial models, dashboards, trackers, and other reporting tools. Excellent written and visual communication skills, with the ability to create executive-ready presentations and synthesize complex information into clear, actionable insights. Strong knowledge of Medicare and Medicare Advantage, value-based care, healthcare operations, and payer-provider dynamics. Ability to thrive in fast-paced environments, manage multiple priorities, and adapt to changing business needs while maintaining a high standard of quality. Demonstrated ability to influence and drive results through strong organization, collaboration, communication, and execution rather than formal authority. Benefits Overview : Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews. Additional Perks: Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities Reimbursement for office setup expenses Monthly cell phone & internet stipend Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams Paid parental leave for all new parents And much more! About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions. Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care. With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software. Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. items.description: Keep Growing with Nutrafol We’re a growing company. Everything we do, we do to help people grow into the best version of themselves. As the pioneers of hair wellness, we create clinically tested products for hair growth and provide support for people at every step of their hair journey. Our multi-factorial approach targets key root causes of hair thinning using a patented blend of standardized vitamins, minerals and natural ingredients – and is recommended by over 7,500 physicians and hair professionals for trusted, reliable results. We never settle, and are continuously challenging existing treatments and methodologies to advance the frontier of hair science. As we help our customers grow, we grow too – by embracing individuality and differences, leading by example, and empowering ourselves and others with our passion for wellness and innovation. Keep growing. It’s our mantra. Our commitment to helping anybody and everybody committed to realizing their own potential to grow. About the Role The Product Commercialization Manager supports the execution of Nutrafol’s product innovation pipeline. This role helps turn product strategy into category-leading beauty/ topical products in the market - one of the company’s highest-priority growth bets - all delivered on time, on budget, and at the quality bar our customers expect. Reporting to the Sr. Product Commercialization Manager this role is the day-to-day project owner for Topicals Innovation, partnering across Marketing, R&D, Creative, RA/QA, Clinical, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, Sales, and external manufacturing partners to bring structure, pace, and clarity to a fast-moving roadmap. As our topicals ambitions grow, you may also be asked to take on additional product development projects. This role is built for someone who wants their scope to expand alongside a growing business. You will also help maintain and improve the systems, processes, and tools that support our product development engine, using project management platforms, AI-enabled tools, and automation to support speed, transparency, and efficiency. If you’re energized by turning plans into flawless execution and you want real ownership of a high-visibility project rather than a slice of many, this role offers that runway, with a clear path to take on more as you grow. Responsibilities: Project Execution & Timeline Management Own the timeline and delivery of the topicals innovation program and, as capacity allows, additional product development projects, helping ensure each initiative meets the defined scope, quality, timeline, and budget requirements Build and maintain project plans, critical paths, and milestone schedules from concept through commercialization for topicals initiatives Own stage-gate execution for topicals projects by coordinating kickoff, milestone, risk, and post-mortem reviews, and tracking decisions, owners, and next steps Identify and flag risks, dependencies, and blockers on topicals timelines to leadership before they impact in-market dates Resource & Capacity Coordination Track resourcing across teams supporting topicals innovation to inform prioritization Help maintain capacity views that flag bottlenecks specific to the topicals roadmap and support trade-off conversations with the Sr. Manager Support translation of the topicals strategic roadmap into a phased, resourced execution plan Stakeholder Communication & Visibility Track and communicate topicals project progress with clear, timely updates for the project team and cross-functional stakeholders Own the cadence of topicals status updates, readouts, and launch readiness reports Maintain a single source of truth for topicals project status, decisions, risks, and changes Tools & Continuous Improvement Use project management tools and platforms (e.g., Asana, Smartsheet, Monday, Wrike, Airtable, Jira) to run topicals projects, consistent with standards set for the function Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support status reporting, risk detection, document generation, meeting summarization, and resource forecasting Contribute to dashboards and reporting that turn topicals project data into actionable insight on cycle time, on-time delivery, scope changes, and resource utilization Apply project management standards, templates, RACI models, and stage-gate playbooks established for the broader product development function Cross-Functional Partnership Serve as the day-to-day operational partner for Topicals Innovation to Product Development & Marketing Partner with R&D, Creative, Regulatory, Clinical, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, Sales, and external vendors/co-manufacturers to align topicals timelines and deliverables Support a culture of accountability, clarity, and forward momentum on the topicals project team Requirements: Bachelor’s degree required 3–5+ years of project or program management experience, ideally including cross-functional product development experience in a CPG, beauty, wellness, healthcare, or consumer goods environment Familiarity with FDA, FTC, and regulatory considerations relevant to supplements, wellness, beauty, or healthcare product development is a plus CAPM, PMP, or comparable certification a plus (not required) Experience supporting or delivering multi-workstream product launches on time, on budget, and within scope Working knowledge of PM tools (Asana, Smartsheet, Monday, Wrike, Airtable, Jira, MS Project, etc.) Interest or experience in leveraging AI, automation, and productivity technologies to streamline workflows and reporting Solid understanding of project planning, resource coordination, risk tracking, and budget tracking Strong problem-solving skills and ability to keep projects moving in the face of ambiguity Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to work across both strategic and tactical stakeholders Strong organizational skills Ability to thrive in an entrepreneurial, fast-moving environment Nutrafol takes into consideration a wide range of factors in final compensation decisions, including but not limited to: skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, qualifications and education, and other business and organizational needs. The listed range is applicable only to the annual base salary and does not include additional perks, benefits, or applicable bonus eligibility comprising the total compensation package. Salary Range: $100,000—$120,000 USD Perks & Benefits Fully remote work experience Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision package, including FSA program 401K with employer match Quarterly Bonus Program Flexible PTO Two company-wide wellness breaks every day Free lunch on us every Tuesday and Thursday via Seamless/Grubhub Monthly wellness stipend Monthly internet stipend Monthly cell phone stipend Annual learning & development stipend Free meditation app membership (Headspace) Free Nutrafol subscription Pet insurance discounts and benefits California residents may review our CCPA notice here.

items.description: Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide! Vonage Communications APIs: As an emerging leader in the $10B+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees, and partners through transformative communications experiences. For example, Vonage API solutions empower organizations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure. This allows them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel — including voice, video, and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock, and much more. Why this role matters Vonage is currently looking for a Deal Desk Analyst, based in Mexico who will provide direct support & guidance to the Sales Teams in all commercial aspects of deals with existing and prospective customers, including pricing quotations. The candidate will lead the commercial execution of complex, high-value deals and act as a strategic advisor responsible for bringing together Sales, Marketing, Operations, Product, Finance, and Legal team members to develop and execute Vonage’s pricing strategy. Your contribution will be essential to win deals, increase Vonage market share and grow the revenue stream. Your key responsibilities: Work with the Sales Teams in building price quotes for customers, including our largest and most strategic accounts Analyze deal margins and competitive positioning to ensure we are winning deals and market share without sacrificing long-term financial health. Actively collaborate with Operations, Finance, Legal, Product and Pricing teams to optimize the on-boarding experience of customers Help drive the adoption of CPQ, the Sales self-service quoting tool in SFDC. Transform raw deal data into actionable insights, identifying pricing trends and competitive shifts to influence Vonage’s global pricing strategy. Streamline and improve business practices, including tools, templates and processes, to increase the efficiency of the Deal Desk team Train and advise Sales and any other stakeholders on pricing, quoting, on-boarding process and commercial best practices Define and manage projects to deliver further operational efficiencies and deal velocity. What you'll bring Desired Skills and Experience Bachelor’s degree required; Business, Economics, Finance or Accounting undergrad majors preferred 4+ years in a Strategic Deal Desk, Sales Operations, or Commercial Finance role within a fast-paced SaaS or Telecom environment. Proficiency in Salesforce (SFDC), Tableau and CPQ environments. Strong analytical skills Excellent communication skills Problem solving Excellent Excel skills and data manipulation Fluent in English Personal Characteristics You are a self-starter, an initiator Customer-focused - Always thinks first about the needs of their internal customers. You are delivery-focused You are curious and informed - Stays on top of the latest in product, pricing, and industry news You are structured in your approach You have an innovative mindset and consistently challenge existing norms to drive improvement You have a team first mentality and put the company objectives ahead of your own Comfortable in a fast pace, global & multicultural environment How you'll benefit Medical Insurance Group Life Insurance Meal Card (Pluxee Tienda Card) Volunteer Time (VTO) Ericsson Care Line Additional benefits and perks will be shared and discussed with you by the recruiter during the interview process. #LI-ML1 There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you. To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice . Who we are: Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today. Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

We deliver insights at critical points of care for better decisions - from streamlining prior authorizations to delivering comprehensive medication histories to facilitating messages between p
items.description: Software Engineering Surescripts serves the nation through simpler, trusted health intelligence sharing, in order to increase patient safety, lower costs and ensure quality care. We deliver insights at critical points of care for better decisions - from streamlining prior authorizations to delivering comprehensive medication histories to facilitating messages between providers. Job Summary: The Principal Infrastructure Engineer is crucial to ensuring the stability, efficiency and security of the products we operate as crucial components of the nation's healthcare ecosystem. As a member of our Operations team, a Principal Infrastructure Engineer is expected to have knowledge and experience spanning many disciplines with the ability to lead, communicate and execute as a subject matter expert on specific topics or systems. This role may be called upon to troubleshoot deeply technical problems, architect a solution for a new cloud-native application or write an Ansible module to support deployment of new security tooling. At the Principal level, our Platform Engineers are expected to be able to speak on a broad variety of topics and successfully lead projects both internal to our Systems or Operations teams as well as in collaboration with diverse groups of technical and non-technical team members. This position has a specific focus on systems performance tuning and analysis that is becoming even more crucial as we begin operations in Google Cloud Platform. Sizing, tuning troubleshooting and performance monitoring now draw a direct line to the budget as we transition to the minute-by-minute pricing models of the cloud. Knowing where we can gain efficiency and where we cannot sacrifice performance has become a crucial part of our architectural discussion and on-going operational health. Responsibilities: Participate in development of strategic goals and plans for new and existing systems infrastructure. Research, design, architect, and implement new technologies and solutions that span on-premise and cloud platforms in a method consistent with our security policies and infrastructure-as-code principals. Implement performance tuning strategies to optimize system performance, resource utilization, and overall efficiency. Collaborate with other teams to design and implement scalable and resilient infrastructure solutions. Assist in support of issues impacting the performance or reliability of production transactions. Recommend/implement policies, procedures, and technologies to ensure system security through secure system access, monitoring and control. Participate as necessary in routine security evaluations. Implement automation solutions for system provisioning, configuration management, and performance tuning. Ensure compliance with policies, standards, licensing agreements, configuration guidelines, and best-practices for maintaining regulatory compliance. Ensure all systems and processes are well-documented and comply with internal policies and industry standards. Qualifications: Basic Requirements: Bachelor's degree in IT, computer science, information sciences or related field or equivalent experience 8+ years of experience in systems engineering role Experience in a production operation environment with high uptime requirements. Familiarity with configuration management tools (Ansible preferred). Knowledge of virtualization and containerization technologies - Vmware (vSphere / ESXi 8x) and Kubernetes preferred Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Powershell, Python, Perl). Experience with performance, logging and monitoring tools (Zenoss, Splunk, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, etc.) Strong background in system metrics analysis and monitoring. Experience working in cloud environments (GCP preferred) Preferred Qualifications: Experience operating in an environment with sensitive health data Experience with RedHat, RockyOS and Windows Certifications like RHCE or Google Cloud Architect/Engineer Understanding of network operations, network troubleshooting and the ability to understand the output of packet captures Experience as a Team Lead, or non-people manager leadership role. Surescripts embraces flexibility through its Flexible Hybrid Work model for most positions. This model allows employees to work virtually while still utilizing our offices as collaboration centers. With alignment and agreement from your leadership, you can come and go from the office as needed. To be considered for employment, applicants must have a valid U.S. work authorization allowing work without restrictions with Surecripts in the U.S. At this time, we are unable to provide support or provide sponsorship for immigration benefits such as work visas. Additionally, we do not participate in academic training programs or work-study programs through an academic institution that require employer endorsement of F-1/CPT or F-1/STEM. What You're Like You're relentless in getting stuff done. You apply your expertise in an Agile/DevOps world with other talented people. You're curious about new technology and use your curiosity as fuel to deliver meaningful solutions. And you're into incremental efforts that ultimately reap huge results. What We're Like We're a smart team that loves to work toward a common goal: delivering innovative, industry-leading solutions that improve patient care. We pride ourselves on quality work grounded in transparency and accountability. Our goal is to make a positive impact on healthcare, be it on quality, cost, or patient safety. What the Work is Like Is your thinking cap on? (Do they still make those?) Here, our challenge is to connect disparate, cross-functional skills to create the desired result. We focus on important milestones, work to understand diverse technologies and develop relationships with various groups of people with varied perspectives. Why Wait? Apply Now We're a midsize company. This means you're not just another employee ID number. Here, you can build real relationships and feel supported by truly awesome people with diverse backgrounds and talents in an innovative and collaborative work culture. We strive to create an environment where you can be yourself, share your ideas and work your way. We offer opportunities for employee development, as well as competitive compensation packages and extensive benefits. At Surescripts, base pay is one part of our Total Rewards Package (which may also include bonus, benefits etc.) and is determined within a range. The base pay range for this position is $161,600 - $197,600 per year. Your base pay may vary within or outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including (but not limited to) your qualifications, skills, experience, and location. Benefits include, but are not limited to, comprehensive healthcare (including infertility coverage), generous paid time off including paid childbirth and parental leave and mental health days, pet insurance, and 401(k) with company match and immediate vesting. To learn more, review the Keep You and Yours Healthy , Balancing Work and Life , and Where Talent Takes Shape links under the Better Benefits. Better Work. Better Life section of our careers site. Physical and Mental Requirements While performing duties of this job, an employee may be required to perform any, or all of the following: attend meetings in and out of the office, travel, communicate effectively (both orally and in writing), and be able to effectively use computers and other electronic and standard office equipment with, or without, a reasonable accommodation. Additionally, this job requires certain mental demands, including the ability to use judgement, withstand moderate amounts of stress and maintain attention to detail with, or without, a reasonable accommodation. Surescripts is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, marital status, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, parental status, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. #LI-REMOTE

items.title: Fraud Analyst
items.summary: Who are we? TripledotStudios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.
items.description: Who are we? Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world. We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios. Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users. Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others. We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games. Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started. The role is working within our studio: PuzzlePlay Puzzleplay is Tripledot’s new player rewards platform, designed to make playing our games even more fun and engaging. By playing our casual, free to play mobile games, users can earn points, complete challenges, and win real prizes. It’s our way of giving back to players and rewarding them for doing what they already love. Puzzleplay is a key part of our growth strategy, combining smart engagement mechanics with high-quality game content. Role Overview Puzzleplay at Tripledot Studios is looking for a data analyst to own the fraud side of its user segmentation work. The team is building a system that combines fraud and activity signals to understand users and inform revenue-share decisions. You'll work with the analyst responsible for gameplay signals, alongside product and data colleagues, to keep that system useful as fraud patterns change. Fraud patterns keep changing, so you'll regularly revisit the signals behind the segments and help the product team decide which verification methods make sense in each market. This role is open to candidates based in Europe; Warsaw is preferred, where several of the people you'll work with are based. Key Responsibilities Review fraud signals regularly, adding, removing and refining them to distinguish suspicious activity from legitimate users. Signals under consideration include IP spoofing, VPN use and unusual play patterns. Own the fraud-related segments of the user segmentation system, from deciding how signals should be interpreted to monitoring how well the categories work over time. Work with the product team on fraud verification tools for different markets. The team currently uses FaceTec for facial verification and may need other methods, such as ID scanning or phone verification, in other countries. Investigate users flagged for manual review, including ambiguous cases in the Tremendous queue, and look for ways to improve the review process. Identify gaps in the available signals and recommend third-party tools for the product roadmap where they would help. Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Hands-on experience using data to investigate fraud and shape detection or prevention decisions, not just working alongside a fraud team. Experience designing or improving fraud signals, user segments or review processes, with an interest in how those decisions change as tactics evolve. The ability to work with product and other teams to turn analysis into operational fraud controls. Originally posted on Himalayas

Where you could make an impact We’d love to connect with people across: Product: Product Management & Product Operations Marketing & Growth: User Acquisition, Performance Marketing & Product Marketing Data & Analytics: Product, Marketing & Business Analytics, BI Engineering: Backend, Frontend, DevOps & AI Automation Design & Creative: Product Design, Motion Design & Creative Production Customer Experience: Customer Care, Support Operations & Automation People & Business Operations: Talent Acquisition, People Operations & Finance What you can expect 🌍 Remote collaboration Work with an international team that brings different experiences and perspectives. 🚀 Ownership and impact Take responsibility for meaningful challenges and see how your work shapes our products. 🧠 AI in everyday work Explore tools and approaches that help us build, learn, and improve. 🤝 Room to contribute Share ideas, ask questions, and work across teams to make things better. items.title: Risk Operations Analyst - SSO
items.summary: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
items.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team Strategic Supportability Operations (SSO) sits within Risk Operations and User Policy Operations. Our team is focused on protecting and advancing Stripe 's business, brand, and mission by deploying industry-leading supportability solutions that instill user and partner trust in Stripe , while enabling progressive and sustainable business growth. Unlike other Risk Operations teams, SSO handles the most complex, high-stakes, and ambiguous user business cases—ones that require deep investigation, custom risk analysis, and creative problem-solving at the intersection of user experience, compliance, financial partner requirements, and Stripe 's growth ambitions. What you’ll do As a Risk Operations Analyst on the Strategic Supportability Operations team, you will investigate and assess complex, gray-area user business cases that require deep risk judgment and tailored solutions. You will go beyond standard procedures to understand the full risk profile of users, develop custom recommendations, and collaborate across internal teams to drive cohesive, well-reasoned decisions. You will also play a key role in identifying patterns across individual cases to improve our processes, policies, and detection systems at scale—bridging tactical case work with strategic, systemic impact across Risk Operations. Responsibilities Investigate complex, high-risk, and gray-area user business cases, applying deep risk knowledge to make sound, non-binary judgments Navigate ambiguity confidently—develop custom, evidence-based solutions where standard frameworks do not fully apply Identify and escalate systemic trends across cases, proposing scalable solutions to cross-functional stakeholders Collaborate across Risk Operations, User Support, Risk Partnerships, Legal, Compliance, and Product to develop holistic risk mitigation strategies Engage directly with users—in both positive and sensitive conversations—always maintaining a Users First mindset while balancing regulatory and financial partner requirements Communicate complex risk findings clearly to internal partners, financial partners, and Stripe leadership Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of SSO processes, decision frameworks, and tooling Build and maintain documentation, procedures, and playbooks to support team scalability and knowledge management Identify gaps in current systems, policies, and strategies and recommend enhancements through a collaborative approach with stakeholders Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements 5+ years of experience in risk management, compliance, fraud, financial operations, or a closely related field in a fast-moving environment Demonstrated ability to navigate gray-area and non-binary decision-making in complex risk environments Strong critical thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize multiple data sources into a coherent risk narrative Experience collaborating cross-functionally on complex problems and driving alignment across teams with competing priorities Ability to engage directly with users—including in difficult or sensitive conversations—with empathy, clarity, and professionalism Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate complex risk findings to varied audiences Comfort with ambiguity and fast-paced, constantly evolving environments Track record of identifying systemic problems from individual case patterns and driving process improvements Deep empathy for entrepreneurs and businesses, and genuine motivation to solve problems that empower them The ability and desire to challenge the status quo as a creative thinker who considers problems from a user perspective while being pragmatic and solutions-oriented Preferred requirements Familiarity with compliance or financial partnership relationship management Experience with risk assessment and mitigation strategies in a fintech or payments environment Working knowledge of data analysis and AI tools to quantify risk & inform decisions Background in regulatory compliance within financial services Experience developing scalable operational frameworks or playbooks in an ambiguous, high-stakes environment Knowledge of payment processing systems and associated risks Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior Internal Auditor
items.summary: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social casino company in the world.
items.description: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social casino company in the world. We’re building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer's interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically. Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, the new Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality.
