items.summary: Qohash is building the zero copy data security control layer, enterprises need to adopt AI safely.
items.description: Qohash is building the zero copy data security control layer, enterprises need to adopt AI safely. Our platform, Qostodian, helps large organizations discover, classify, govern, and remediate sensitive unstructured data across their most critical data sources without moving or copying the data. This zero copy architecture reduces exposure, preserves data sovereignty, and allows enterprises to secure data directly where it lives. This matters because AI adoption is increasing the risk, complexity, and urgency of enterprise data security. Before organizations can safely deploy AI agents, copilots, retrieval systems, or automated workflows, they need to know where sensitive data lives, who and what can access it, and how to enforce controls at scale. Company culture is at our core Our 5 core values are more than just words, they are a way of life for us. We know that companies with a strong culture and a higher purpose perform better in the long run. Do our values speak to you? Pursuit of excellence Resilience Mission focus Accountability Embracing conflict About the team We are standing up a new team for the QSIDS ( Qohash Sensitive Information Detection System) launch, dedicated to the detection engine. A central focus of this team is the integration of embedded AI, machine learning models that run directly on the device and in-system. It is about high-performance, low-resource, on-device inference, embedded into the detection engine itself. The engine is built in Go, with a strong emphasis on performance and minimal resource footprint. Who you are You're a hands-on Go developer who likes living close to the metal - profiling hot paths, trimming allocations, and making concurrent systems behave predictably under load. You enjoy integration work: wiring components, native libraries, and models into a coherent engine, and making the seams disappear. You take pride in owning what you ship, watching how it behaves in production and iterating to keep it fast and reliable. You bring strong engineering fundamentals, write tests as a matter of course, and collaborate naturally, helping the team converge on quality decisions. You're comfortable with the pace and ambiguity of a startup, and you care about the outcome, not just the code. What you will do Design and build a highly efficient cross-platform detection engine for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Integrate embedded machine learning models into the engine for on-device inference, and own the runtime, bindings, and data paths that make them work in-system. Collaborate closely with machine learning and systems colleagues to turn models into production-ready components. Optimize end to end for latency, memory footprint, and CPU — profiling, benchmarking, and tuning both engine code and model execution. Own features all the way to production including instrumenting, monitoring, and iterating to keep them reliable. Collaborate with stakeholders to define milestones and ensure timelines align with development needs. Participate in discussions on technological choices and decisions regarding product development. Resolve anomalies and problems as soon as they arise. Help onboard and train colleagues as the team grows. Communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. What your resume shows Must Haves 7+ years' experience building and shipping production software in Go Strong systems programming fundamentals - memory management, concurrency, profiling, and software optimization in performance-sensitive, resource-constrained environments Hands-on track record owning code post-deployment: instrumenting, debugging, and iterating on live systems A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience) Nice to Haves Experience embedding ML models for on-device inference (a strong asset for this role) Experience with Rust, C/C++ or another low-level systems language Experience building, training, or optimizing machine learning models, including compression, quantization, and tuning for low-latency inference Bilingual (French and English) Experience working in a startup environment What's in it for you? The goal is an MRD that engineering can design against: every requirement quantified, prioritized per segment and traceable to specific client discussions and use cases. your role Market & Application Research Build a deep understanding of our analog AI hardware, its capabilities and limitations, together with our team. Research the global smart sensor and Edge AI landscape and identify relevant market segments, applications and customer groups. Analyze emerging applications for intelligent and autonomous sensors. Investigate industry trends, technology adoption and customer requirements. Identify high-value use cases where local or edge AI processing provides tangible benefits. Identify opportunities where GEMESYS’s Analog Edge AI architecture creates differentiated value, also beyond sensors. Research competing technologies and alternative solutions, with the support of our engineers. Customer & Stakeholder Requirements Identify and structure customer pain points and unmet needs. Translate qualitative customer requirements into measurable product requirements. Define functional and non-functional requirements for smart sensor systems. Classify these requirements into categories, so that the engineering teams can make trade-offs. Source and conduct customer, expert and partner interviews through your own network, and run the market validation independently. Share your findings with management, and join selected customer and investor meetings where they add value. Market Requirements Document You own the development of a comprehensive MRD, including: Market overview, segmentation and competitive landscape Target applications and use cases Customer personas and stakeholders, where relevant Customer pain points and unmet needs Market and technology trends and their future projections Alternative technology approaches Market and product specification requirements for our Analog Edge AI ASIC: power, energy modes, bandwidth, area, process nodes, target ASP and further parameters, prioritized per segment and traceable to specific client discussions and use cases Product opportunity areas Recommendations for product and technology development Regulatory and industry considerations Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with GEMESYS’s technical teams to understand the capabilities and limitations of the underlying analog AI hardware. Lead our in-house market analysis team and resources efficiently, so that they support your work and build their own skill set. Translate technical capabilities into customer and application value propositions. Facilitate discussions between technical, commercial and management stakeholders. Challenge our existing assumptions with customer and market evidence. Ensure that product requirements are traceable to actual market needs. Guide future product roadmap decisions. Deliverables You are responsible for producing a professional MRD. Every requirement specified in it is prioritized for each segment and traceable to specific client discussions and use cases. what you bring Experience in technical marketing, product marketing or application engineering for semiconductors, sensors or embedded systems. Solid understanding of sensor signal chains, low-power electronics and embedded AI, deep enough to discuss architecture trade-offs with chip designers. Extensive experience developing Market Requirements Documents, Product Requirements Documents, market studies or comparable strategic or technical documentation. An established network in smart sensors, Edge AI or semiconductors that gives you direct access to potential customers, domain experts and industry partners, without relying on GEMESYS contacts. Proven ability to independently source, schedule and conduct customer and expert interviews, and to run market validation end to end. Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear market and customer requirements. Experience researching technology markets and competitive landscapes. Excellent strategic, analytical and structured thinking skills. Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders. Ability to independently conduct research, identify information gaps and develop well-supported conclusions. Domain experience Must have (at least one of the following) Smart sensors Edge AI / TinyML Embedded AI Good to have Analog computing Neuromorphic computing Memristive technology Nice to have Automotive sensing Autonomous systems Wearables or medical devices Originally posted on Himalayas

Key Responsibilities Lead assigned client projects and workstreams from planning through delivery. Maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, and deliverables. Monitor project progress and proactively identify and resolve risks or challenges. Manage multiple workstreams and priorities simultaneously. Build strong relationships with client stakeholders and develop a deep understanding of their business and objectives. Lead client meetings, project discussions, and status updates. Experience working with financial services and/or insurance clients ; life insurance experience strongly preferred. Experience managing projects, workstreams, timelines, and multiple stakeholders. Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities. Ability to take ownership and work independently while effectively leading a supporting team. Strong proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel ; experience with research and analytics platforms is a plus. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, client-focused consulting environment. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote URL: http://onthegosystems.com At OnTheGoSystems, the company behind WPML , Toolset , and PTC , we’re looking for a hands-on, AI-native marketer who wants to take ownership of marketing and help shape how we do it. AI is a core part of how we work. We’re looking for someone who already uses AI agents, automation, integrations, and structured workflows to get real marketing work done – and can show us what they’ve achieved with them. This is also a technical role . We’ve built our own analytics, newsletter, and marketing automation systems, so you should be comfortable working with technical tools, setting up a local development environment, and using tools like Claude to help you navigate technical tasks. You won’t be joining an established marketing team or following a fixed playbook. You’ll have the freedom to talk to our clients, understand our business, find the strongest opportunities, and decide what marketing should focus on next. What You’ll Work On Several areas currently need an owner: SEO / GEO / AEO Content and collaborations with partners, authors, and bloggers Marketing to existing customers, including retention and expansion Paid advertising Client analytics Other marketing opportunities you identify You’ll work hands-on, from identifying an opportunity through execution, measurement, and improvement. Your First Weeks We don’t expect you to arrive with all the answers. We want you to understand the business first and then decide what should be done. You’ll: Learn our products, industry, competitors, and ecosystem. Speak directly with customers to understand their needs and how they see our products. Look at our data, existing activities, and opportunities. Identify where marketing can have the biggest impact. Build a concrete plan for the areas you propose to own and explain why. What We’re Looking For You already use AI agents, automation, and advanced AI workflows in your everyday work and can show us concrete results. You’re hands-on and comfortable with the technical side of marketing. You’re curious and take time to understand customers and the business before proposing solutions. You can work across different areas of marketing and turn ideas into action. You understand how marketing connects to business results. You have experience marketing technical products, ideally software, SaaS, WordPress, or similar. You work independently and can move things forward without detailed instructions. You’re comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change and not everything is defined in advance. Why Join Us OnTheGoSystems is a profitable, self-funded product company growing since 2007. WPML powers more than 1.5 million websites worldwide. You’ll have real ownership and the freedom to help build our marketing approach, work directly with our CEO and product teams, experiment with AI, and turn your ideas into real marketing initiatives. We care about the people we work with and want to support them beyond their day-to-day work. Along with the flexibility of working remotely, we offer perks and benefits that support both work and life. If you’re excited about building marketing with AI, getting hands-on, and having the freedom to shape what comes next, we’d love to hear from you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-head-of-marketing-1

items.description: Design Headquarters: Hurst, TX URL: http://bbemarketing.com/ We’re looking for a creative, curious designer who can turn entertainment and sports industry data into compelling social content. You’ll come up with ideas, identify relevant news, create graphics, write captions, and check the information before it’s published. Our audience includes entertainment and sports professionals. We need someone who understands what would make these people stop, read, share, or join the conversation. What You’ll Do Generate original content ideas. Find interesting angles in our data and industry developments, including infographics, comparisons, agency breakdowns, rankings, and recurring series. Bring ideas proactively and experiment with new formats. Create the graphics yourself. Design clear, engaging infographics, carousels, and news graphics that communicate information effectively and look polished on social media. Choose the right news stories. Review incoming industry news and decide which stories matter to our audience, why they matter, and how we should present them. Write the copy. Create headlines, on-graphic text, hooks, and captions in clear, confident English suited to an industry-professional audience. Review researchers’ work. Check the data and supporting sources provided by our research team. Verify names, agency relationships, dates, totals, percentages, and other details. Flag inconsistencies and work with researchers to resolve them. Own the final quality check. Make sure the graphic and caption match the verified data, the headline is supported, and the finished post is accurate and easy to understand. Manage the content calendar. Balance planned content with timely responses to relevant industry news. Learn from performance. Review what resonates with our audience and use those insights to improve future content. What We’re Looking For A strong graphic design portfolio, especially infographics, editorial graphics, social media carousels, or other information-focused content. The ability to take a post from initial idea through design, caption writing, and final review. Strong creative and editorial judgment. You can look at a dataset or news story, identify an interesting angle, and explain why our audience would care. Excellent written English, including the ability to make complex information clear and concise. Strong attention to detail and comfort working with spreadsheets, checking percentages, and reviewing sources. Proficiency in the design tools needed to produce polished graphics and organized, editable files. Initiative and curiosity. You regularly bring forward ideas, explore possibilities, and improve concepts through feedback. Strong organization, reliable communication, and the ability to manage deadlines independently. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/bbe-marketing-inc-senior-graphic-designer

items.title: Creative (Graphic Designer)
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our global creative team. You'll create standout visual work for some of the world's most ambitious brands: from brand identity and campaign design to digital and social assets. You’ll be working alongside creative leads, project managers, and clients across a wide range of industries. This is a hands-on design role built for the way design actually gets made today. You'll spend most of your time designing, building concepts, refining visual systems, and pushing craft, using today's leading AI creative tools as a core part of your process, not an afterthought. We're looking for designers who already treat tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, and Seedance as part of their everyday kit, and who know when to reach for them and when strong traditional craft is what the work actually needs.

items.title: Creative (Motion Design)
items.summary: Superside is looking for a motion designer with the creativity, technical expertise, and innovation mindset to push the boundaries of motion design. You’ll work with top global brands, crafting high-impact motion graphics, animated digital ads, Lottie animations, and more, all while collaborating with a world-class, globally distributed team of creatives. This is a high-ownership role where you’ll contribute to cutting-edge projects, explore new animation technologies, and help shape Superside’s creative motion capabilities.
